2182def normalize_post_field_statistics_config(post_cfg: dict) -> dict:
2183 """!
2184 @brief Validate and canonicalize the field_statistics block of post.yml.
2185
2186 @details The recipe names windows rather than redescribing them, because the
2187 window definitions already reach the post-processor through the run's
2188 solver control. Validation therefore covers the recipe's own choices
2189 only; a name no window matches is caught in C against the resolved list,
2190 which is the only place the real set is known.
2191
2192 @param[in] post_cfg Parsed post-processing configuration.
2193 @return Value returned by `normalize_post_field_statistics_config()`.
2194 """
2195 raw = (post_cfg or {}).get("field_statistics")
2196 if raw is None:
2197 return {"windows": [], "source_step": None, "outputs": [], "formats": []}
2198 if not isinstance(raw, dict):
2199 raise ValueError("'field_statistics' must be a mapping.")
2200
2201 windows = raw.get("windows")
2202 if not isinstance(windows, list) or not windows:
2203 raise ValueError("'field_statistics.windows' must be a non-empty list of window names.")
2204 cleaned = []
2205 for entry in windows:
2206 if not isinstance(entry, str) or not entry.strip():
2207 raise ValueError("'field_statistics.windows' entries must be non-empty window names.")
2208 name = entry.strip()
2209 # Each window writes its own file, so a repeat would overwrite its own output.
2210 if name in cleaned:
2211 raise ValueError(f"field statistics recipe lists window '{name}' more than once.")
2212 cleaned.append(name)
2213
2214 label = ", ".join(cleaned)
2215 source_step = raw.get("source_step")
2216 if source_step is not None:
2217 if not isinstance(source_step, int) or isinstance(source_step, bool) or source_step < 0:
2218 raise ValueError(
2219 f"field statistics recipe for [{label}]: 'source_step' must be a non-negative "
2220 f"integer (got {source_step!r})."
2221 )
2222
2223 outputs = raw.get("outputs", list(POST_FIELD_STATISTICS_OUTPUTS))
2224 if not isinstance(outputs, list) or not outputs:
2225 raise ValueError(f"field statistics recipe for [{label}]: 'outputs' must be a non-empty list.")
2226 unknown = [item for item in outputs if item not in POST_FIELD_STATISTICS_OUTPUTS]
2227 if unknown:
2228 raise ValueError(
2229 f"field statistics recipe for [{label}]: unknown outputs {unknown}. "
2230 f"Available outputs: {list(POST_FIELD_STATISTICS_OUTPUTS)}."
2231 )
2232 if len(set(outputs)) != len(outputs):
2233 raise ValueError(f"field statistics recipe for [{label}]: 'outputs' lists a duplicate.")
2234
2235 formats = raw.get("formats", ["vtk"])
2236 if not isinstance(formats, list) or not formats:
2237 raise ValueError(f"field statistics recipe for [{label}]: 'formats' must be a non-empty list.")
2238 unknown = [item for item in formats if item not in POST_FIELD_STATISTICS_FORMATS]
2239 if unknown:
2240 raise ValueError(
2241 f"field statistics recipe for [{label}]: unknown formats {unknown}. "
2242 f"Available formats: {list(POST_FIELD_STATISTICS_FORMATS)}."
2243 )
2244 if len(set(formats)) != len(formats):
2245 raise ValueError(f"field statistics recipe for [{label}]: 'formats' lists a duplicate.")
2246
2247 return {
2248 "windows": cleaned,
2249 "source_step": source_step,
2250 "outputs": list(outputs),
2251 "formats": list(formats),
2252 }
2253
2254
2255def _post_window_derived_field_count(window_cfg: dict, outputs: list) -> int:
2256 """!
2257 @brief Count the derived fields one window would produce for a set of outputs.
2258
2259 @details Mirrors the resolution the C derivation performs, so a recipe that would
2260 produce an empty file is refused before the run rather than after it. Each
2261 output resolves against what the window accumulated: a window keeping only
2262 first moments has no stresses, RMS, or turbulent kinetic energy to give.
2263
2264 @param[in] window_cfg Normalized window definition from monitor.yml.
2265 @param[in] outputs Requested output kinds.
2266 @return Value returned by `_post_window_derived_field_count()`.
2267 """
2268 fields = window_cfg.get("fields", []) or []
2269 covariances = window_cfg.get("covariances", []) or []
2270 with_second = [f for f in fields if "second" in (f.get("moments") or [])]
2271 total = 0
2272 for kind in outputs:
2273 if kind == "mean":
2274 total += len(fields)
2275 elif kind == "reynolds_stress":
2276 for entry in with_second:
2277 dof = STATISTICS_ELIGIBLE_FIELDS[entry["field"]]["components"]
2278 total += 6 if dof == 3 else 1
2279 elif kind == "rms":
2280 for entry in with_second:
2281 total += STATISTICS_ELIGIBLE_FIELDS[entry["field"]]["components"]
2282 elif kind == "tke":
2283 total += sum(1 for entry in with_second
2284 if STATISTICS_ELIGIBLE_FIELDS[entry["field"]]["components"] == 3)
2285 elif kind == "flux":
2286 total += len(covariances)
2287 return total
2288
2289
2290def _post_requests_field_statistics(post_cfg: dict) -> bool:
2291 """!
2292 @brief Return whether the current post recipe derives accumulated field statistics.
2293 @param[in] post_cfg Argument passed to `_post_requests_field_statistics()`.
2294 @return Value returned by `_post_requests_field_statistics()`.
2295 """
2296 try:
2297 return bool(normalize_post_field_statistics_config(post_cfg)["windows"])
2298 except ValueError:
2299 # Malformed configuration is reported by validation, not by this predicate.
2300 return False
2301
2302
2303def get_post_field_statistics_artifacts(post_cfg: dict, run_dir: str):
2304 """!
2305 @brief Predict the per-window statistics artifacts a recipe will produce.
2306 @details Returns one entry per window and format, so resume tracking can tell a
2307 half-finished window from a completed one.
2308 @param[in] post_cfg Parsed post-processing configuration.
2309 @param[in] run_dir Run directory the outputs are written under.
2310 @return List of (kind, path_prefix) tuples; kind is 'vtk' or 'csv'.
2311 """
2312 config = normalize_post_field_statistics_config(post_cfg)
2313 if not config["windows"]:
2314 return []
2315 io_cfg = post_cfg.get("io", {}) or {}
2316 output_dir_abs = _post_output_directory_abs(run_dir, post_cfg)
2317 prefix = io_cfg.get("output_filename_prefix", "Field")
2318 artifacts = []
2319 for window in config["windows"]:
2320 base = os.path.join(output_dir_abs, f"{prefix}_statistics_{window}")
2321 if "vtk" in config["formats"]:
2322 artifacts.append(("vtk", base))
2323 if "csv" in config["formats"]:
2324 artifacts.append(("csv", base + ".csv"))
2325 return artifacts
2326
2327
2328def build_post_recipe_config(post_cfg: dict, monitor_cfg=None) -> dict:
2329 """!
2330 @brief Build the flat key=value mapping consumed by the C post-processor.
2331 @param[in] post_cfg Argument passed to `build_post_recipe_config()`.
2332 @param[in] monitor_cfg Optional parsed monitor YAML configuration dictionary.
2333 @return Value returned by `build_post_recipe_config()`.
2334 """
2335 c_config = {}
2336
2337 c_config['startTime'] = get_post_run_control_value(post_cfg, 'start_step', 0)
2338 c_config['endTime'] = get_post_run_control_value(post_cfg, 'end_step', 0)
2339 c_config['timeStep'] = get_post_run_control_value(post_cfg, 'step_interval', 1)
2340
2341 eulerian_pipeline_parts = []
2342 if post_cfg.get('global_operations', {}).get('dimensionalize', False):
2343 eulerian_pipeline_parts.append('DimensionalizeAllLoadedFields')
2344
2345 for task in post_cfg.get('eulerian_pipeline', []):
2346 task_name = task.get('task')
2347 if task_name == 'q_criterion':
2348 eulerian_pipeline_parts.append('ComputeQCriterion')
2349 elif task_name == 'normalize_field':
2350 field = task.get('field', 'P')
2351 eulerian_pipeline_parts.append(f'NormalizeRelativeField:{field}')
2352 ref_point = task.get('reference_point', [1, 1, 1])
2353 c_config['reference_ip'] = ref_point[0]
2354 c_config['reference_jp'] = ref_point[1]
2355 c_config['reference_kp'] = ref_point[2]
2356 elif task_name == 'nodal_average':
2357 in_field = task.get('input_field')
2358 out_field = task.get('output_field')
2359 if in_field and out_field:
2360 eulerian_pipeline_parts.append(f'CellToNodeAverage:{in_field}>{out_field}')
2361
2362 if eulerian_pipeline_parts:
2363 c_config['process_pipeline'] = ";".join(eulerian_pipeline_parts)
2364
2365 lagrangian_pipeline_parts = []
2366 for task in post_cfg.get('lagrangian_pipeline', []):
2367 task_name = task.get('task')
2368 if task_name == 'specific_ke':
2369 in_field = task.get('input_field')
2370 out_field = task.get('output_field')
2371 if in_field and out_field:
2372 lagrangian_pipeline_parts.append(f'ComputeSpecificKE:{in_field}>{out_field}')
2373 if lagrangian_pipeline_parts:
2374 c_config['particle_pipeline'] = ";".join(lagrangian_pipeline_parts)
2375
2376 statistics_pipeline_parts = get_post_statistics_task_tokens(post_cfg)
2377 statistics_output_prefix = None
2378 stats_cfg = post_cfg.get('statistics_pipeline')
2379 if isinstance(stats_cfg, dict):
2380 statistics_output_prefix = stats_cfg.get('output_prefix')
2381
2382 if statistics_pipeline_parts:
2383 c_config['statistics_pipeline'] = ";".join(statistics_pipeline_parts)
2384 statistics_output_prefix = resolve_post_statistics_output_prefix(post_cfg, monitor_cfg)
2385 elif statistics_output_prefix is None:
2386 statistics_output_prefix = post_cfg.get('statistics_output_prefix')
2387 if statistics_output_prefix:
2388 c_config['statistics_output_prefix'] = statistics_output_prefix
2389
2390 io = post_cfg.get('io', {})
2391 field_statistics = normalize_post_field_statistics_config(post_cfg)
2392 if field_statistics["windows"]:
2393 c_config['field_statistics_windows'] = ",".join(field_statistics["windows"])
2394 c_config['field_statistics_outputs'] = ",".join(field_statistics["outputs"])
2395 c_config['field_statistics_formats'] = ",".join(field_statistics["formats"])
2396 # An omitted source step means each processed step derives from its own
2397 # bundle, which is what turns a multi-step recipe into a convergence history.
2398 if field_statistics["source_step"] is not None:
2399 c_config['field_statistics_source_step'] = field_statistics["source_step"]
2400
2401 c_config['output_prefix'] = io.get('output_directory', 'viz') + '/' + io.get('output_filename_prefix', 'Field')
2402 c_config['particle_output_prefix'] = io.get('output_directory', 'viz') + '/' + io.get('particle_filename_prefix', 'Particle')
2403 c_config['output_particles'] = io.get('output_particles', False)
2404 c_config['particle_output_freq'] = io.get('particle_subsampling_frequency', 1)
2405 c_config['output_fields_instantaneous'] = ",".join(io.get('eulerian_fields', []))
2406 c_config['particle_fields_instantaneous'] = ",".join(io.get('particle_fields', []))
2407 input_extensions = get_post_input_extensions(post_cfg)
2408 if isinstance(input_extensions, dict):
2409 for extension_name in ('eulerian', 'particle'):
2410 extension = input_extensions.get(extension_name)
2411 if extension and str(extension).strip().lstrip('.').lower() != 'dat':
2412 raise ValueError(
2413 f"post input extension '{extension_name}' must be 'dat'; "
2414 "committed checkpoint payload names are fixed."
2415 )
2416
2417 source_directory = get_post_source_directory_template(post_cfg, default=None)
2418 if source_directory is not None:
2419 c_config['source_directory'] = source_directory
2420
2421 # Spectra run in the conductor's Python stage, but the recipe fingerprint is
2422 # computed over this mapping, so the block has to be represented here or a
2423 # changed spectra recipe would resume against stale lineage. The C
2424 # post-processor accepts and ignores the key.
2425 spectra = normalize_post_spectra_config(post_cfg)
2426 if spectra["tasks"]:
2427 c_config['spectra_signature'] = compute_post_spectra_signature(spectra)
2428
2429 return c_config
2430
2431
2432def normalize_post_recipe_signature(recipe_cfg: dict) -> dict:
2433 """!
2434 @brief Normalize post recipe settings into a stable signature mapping.
2435 @param[in] recipe_cfg Argument passed to `normalize_post_recipe_signature()`.
2436 @return Value returned by `normalize_post_recipe_signature()`.
2437 """
2438 signature = {}
2439 for key, value in (recipe_cfg or {}).items():
2440 if key in POST_RECIPE_SIGNATURE_EXCLUDED_KEYS or value is None:
2441 continue
2442 if isinstance(value, bool):
2443 text = 'true' if value else 'false'
2444 else:
2445 text = str(value).strip()
2446 if text.lower() in {'true', 'false'}:
2447 text = text.lower()
2448 if text:
2449 signature[str(key)] = text
2450 return signature
2451
2452
2453def compute_post_recipe_fingerprint(recipe_cfg: dict) -> "tuple[dict, str]":
2454 """!
2455 @brief Return normalized recipe signature plus SHA-256 fingerprint.
2456 @param[in] recipe_cfg Argument passed to `compute_post_recipe_fingerprint()`.
2457 @return Value returned by `compute_post_recipe_fingerprint()`.
2458 """
2459 signature = normalize_post_recipe_signature(recipe_cfg)
2460 payload = json.dumps(signature, sort_keys=True, separators=(',', ':')).encode('utf-8')
2461 return signature, hashlib.sha256(payload).hexdigest()
2462

2464def parse_post_recipe_file(post_recipe_path: str):
2465 """!
2466 @brief Parse an existing generated post.run file into a key/value mapping.
2467 @param[in] post_recipe_path Argument passed to `parse_post_recipe_file()`.
2468 @return Value returned by `parse_post_recipe_file()`.
2469 """
2470 if not post_recipe_path or not os.path.isfile(post_recipe_path):
2471 return None
2472 recipe_cfg = {}
2473 with open(post_recipe_path, 'r', encoding='utf-8', errors='replace') as f:
2474 for raw_line in f:
2475 line = raw_line.strip()
2476 if not line or line.startswith('#') or '=' not in line:
2477 continue
2478 key, value = line.split('=', 1)
2479 recipe_cfg[key.strip()] = value.strip()
2480 return recipe_cfg

2556def _iter_post_steps(start_step: int, end_step: int, step_interval: int):
2557 """!
2558 @brief Yield configured post-processing steps inclusively.
2559 @param[in] start_step Argument passed to `_iter_post_steps()`.
2560 @param[in] end_step Argument passed to `_iter_post_steps()`.
2561 @param[in] step_interval Argument passed to `_iter_post_steps()`.
2562 """
2563 if step_interval <= 0 or end_step < start_step:
2564 return
2565 step = start_step
2566 while step <= end_step:
2567 yield step
2568 step += step_interval
2569
2570
2571def resolve_post_requested_window(post_cfg: dict, case_cfg: dict = None) -> "tuple[int, int, int]":
2572 """!
2573 @brief Resolve post requested start/end/interval, expanding end=-1 via case.yml when available.
2574 @param[in] post_cfg Argument passed to `resolve_post_requested_window()`.
2575 @param[in] case_cfg Optional case configuration for end-step expansion.
2576 @return Value returned by `resolve_post_requested_window()`.
2577 """
2578 start_step = int(get_post_run_control_value(post_cfg, 'start_step', 0) or 0)
2579 end_step = int(get_post_run_control_value(post_cfg, 'end_step', 0) or 0)
2580 step_interval = int(get_post_run_control_value(post_cfg, 'step_interval', 1) or 1)
2581 if end_step < 0 and case_cfg:
2582 case_run = case_cfg.get('run_control', {}) or {}
2583 case_start = int(case_run.get('start_step', 0) or 0)
2584 case_total = int(case_run.get('total_steps', 0) or 0)
2585 end_step = case_start + case_total
2586 return start_step, end_step, step_interval

2589def prepare_effective_post_config(post_cfg: dict, resolved_source_dir: str, start_step: int = None, end_step: int = None) -> dict:
2590 """!
2591 @brief Return a copy of post_cfg with resolved source dir and optional effective bounds.
2592 @param[in] post_cfg Argument passed to `prepare_effective_post_config()`.
2593 @param[in] resolved_source_dir Argument passed to `prepare_effective_post_config()`.
2594 @param[in] start_step Argument passed to `prepare_effective_post_config()`.
2595 @param[in] end_step Argument passed to `prepare_effective_post_config()`.
2596 @return Value returned by `prepare_effective_post_config()`.
2597 """
2598 effective_cfg = copy.deepcopy(post_cfg)
2599 if not isinstance(effective_cfg.get('source_data'), dict):
2600 effective_cfg['source_data'] = {}
2601 effective_cfg['source_data']['directory'] = resolved_source_dir
2602 rc = effective_cfg.setdefault('run_control', {})
2603 if start_step is not None:
2604 rc['start_step'] = int(start_step)
2605 if end_step is not None:
2606 rc['end_step'] = int(end_step)
2607 return effective_cfg

2610def _scan_post_vtk_steps(prefix_path: str, extension: str) -> "set[int]":
2611 """!
2612 @brief Collect step numbers from VTK files named with a prefix, step suffix, and extension.
2613 @param[in] prefix_path Output path prefix before the numeric step suffix.
2614 @param[in] extension VTK file extension to match without its leading dot.
2615 @return Set of step numbers represented by matching files in the prefix directory.
2616 """
2617 directory = os.path.dirname(prefix_path)
2618 if not os.path.isdir(directory):
2619 return set()
2620 basename = os.path.basename(prefix_path)
2621 pattern = re.compile(rf'^{re.escape(basename)}_(\d+)\.{re.escape(extension)}$')
2622 steps = set()
2623 for name in os.listdir(directory):
2624 match = pattern.match(name)
2625 if match:
2626 steps.add(int(match.group(1)))
2627 return steps
2628
2629
2630def _scan_post_statistics_csv_steps(csv_path: str) -> "set[int]":
2631 """!
2632 @brief Scan step ids from the first CSV column of a statistics artifact.
2633 @param[in] csv_path Argument passed to `_scan_post_statistics_csv_steps()`.
2634 @return Value returned by `_scan_post_statistics_csv_steps()`.
2635 """
2636 if not os.path.isfile(csv_path):
2637 return set()
2638 steps = set()
2639 with open(csv_path, 'r', encoding='utf-8', errors='replace', newline='') as f:
2640 reader = csv.reader(f)
2641 for row in reader:
2642 if not row:
2643 continue
2644 head = str(row[0]).strip().lower()
2645 if head in {'step', 'timestep', 'time_step'}:
2646 continue
2647 step_val = _parse_int_loose(row[0])
2648 if step_val is not None:
2649 steps.add(step_val)
2650 return steps
2651
2652
2653def collect_post_completion_families(run_dir: str, post_cfg: dict, monitor_cfg=None) -> "list[set[int]]":
2654 """!
2655 @brief Collect per-family completed-step sets for the current post recipe.
2656 @param[in] run_dir Argument passed to `collect_post_completion_families()`.
2657 @param[in] post_cfg Argument passed to `collect_post_completion_families()`.
2658 @param[in] monitor_cfg Optional parsed monitor YAML configuration dictionary.
2659 @return Value returned by `collect_post_completion_families()`.
2660 """
2661 io_cfg = post_cfg.get('io', {}) or {}
2662 output_dir_abs = _post_output_directory_abs(run_dir, post_cfg)
2663 families = []
2664
2665 if _post_requests_eulerian_output(post_cfg):
2666 prefix = os.path.join(output_dir_abs, io_cfg.get('output_filename_prefix', 'Field'))
2667 families.append(_scan_post_vtk_steps(prefix, 'vts'))
2668
2669 if _post_requests_particle_output(post_cfg):
2670 prefix = os.path.join(output_dir_abs, io_cfg.get('particle_filename_prefix', 'Particle'))
2671 families.append(_scan_post_vtk_steps(prefix, 'vtp'))
2672
2673 for stats_path in get_post_statistics_output_artifacts(post_cfg, run_dir, monitor_cfg):
2674 families.append(_scan_post_statistics_csv_steps(stats_path))
2675
2676 # Each window and format is its own family, so a run that produced the Eulerian
2677 # fields but not the statistics is not mistaken for a completed step.
2678 for kind, path in get_post_field_statistics_artifacts(post_cfg, run_dir):
2679 if kind == 'vtk':
2680 families.append(_scan_post_vtk_steps(path, 'vts'))
2681 else:
2682 families.append(_scan_post_statistics_csv_steps(path))
2683
2684 return families
2685
2686
2687def detect_post_completed_frontier(run_dir: str, post_cfg: dict, monitor_cfg, start_step: int, end_step: int, step_interval: int) -> dict:
2688 """!
2689 @brief Detect the highest contiguous fully completed post step for the current recipe.
2690 @param[in] run_dir Argument passed to `detect_post_completed_frontier()`.
2691 @param[in] post_cfg Argument passed to `detect_post_completed_frontier()`.
2692 @param[in] monitor_cfg Argument passed to `detect_post_completed_frontier()`.
2693 @param[in] start_step Argument passed to `detect_post_completed_frontier()`.
2694 @param[in] end_step Argument passed to `detect_post_completed_frontier()`.
2695 @param[in] step_interval Argument passed to `detect_post_completed_frontier()`.
2696 @return Value returned by `detect_post_completed_frontier()`.
2697 """
2698 families = collect_post_completion_families(run_dir, post_cfg, monitor_cfg)
2699 frontier = None
2700 if families:
2701 for step in _iter_post_steps(start_step, end_step, step_interval):
2702 if all(step in family for family in families):
2703 frontier = step
2704 else:
2705 break
2706 return {
2707 'frontier_step': frontier,
2708 'artifact_family_count': len(families),
2709 }
2710
2711
2712def _nearest_step(steps: "set[int]", target: int):
2713 """!
2714 @brief Return the complete source step nearest to a target step.
2715 @param[in] steps Candidate step numbers.
2716 @param[in] target Target step number.
2717 @return Nearest candidate, or None when no candidates exist.
2718 """
2719 if not steps:
2720 return None
2721 return min(steps, key=lambda step: (abs(step - target), step))
2722

2733def _scan_complete_source_steps(source_dir: str, monitor_cfg: dict, post_cfg: dict) -> "tuple[set[int], dict]":
2734 """!
2735 @brief Scan source artifacts and return steps with every file required by the recipe.
2736 @param[in] source_dir Source output root directory.
2737 @param[in] monitor_cfg Parsed monitor configuration.
2738 @param[in] post_cfg Parsed post-processing configuration.
2739 @return Tuple of complete source steps and source path metadata.
2740 """
2741 del monitor_cfg
2742 require_particles = _post_needs_particle_source(post_cfg)
2743 complete_steps = _scan_committed_checkpoint_steps(
2744 source_dir, require_particles=require_particles
2745 )
2746 return complete_steps, {
2747 'source_dir': os.path.abspath(source_dir),
2748 'require_particles': require_particles,
2749 }

2751
2752def _expected_source_paths_for_step(step: int, source_scan: dict, post_cfg: dict) -> "list[str]":
2753 """!
2754 @brief Build required source file paths for a single post-processing step.
2755 @param[in] step Requested step number.
2756 @param[in] source_scan Metadata returned by `_scan_complete_source_steps()`.
2757 @param[in] post_cfg Parsed post-processing configuration.
2758 @return Required source artifact paths.
2759 """
2760 del post_cfg
2761 bundle = _checkpoint_bundle_path(source_scan['source_dir'], step)
2762 paths = [os.path.join(bundle, 'checkpoint.meta'), os.path.join(bundle, 'COMMITTED')]
2763 if source_scan.get('require_particles'):
2764 paths.append(os.path.join(bundle, 'particles', 'position.dat'))
2765 return paths

2767
2768def detect_post_source_frontier(source_dir: str, monitor_cfg: dict, post_cfg: dict, start_step: int, end_step: int, step_interval: int) -> dict:
2769 """!
2770 @brief Detect the highest contiguous fully available source step for live post-processing.
2771 @param[in] source_dir Argument passed to `detect_post_source_frontier()`.
2772 @param[in] monitor_cfg Argument passed to `detect_post_source_frontier()`.
2773 @param[in] post_cfg Argument passed to `detect_post_source_frontier()`.
2774 @param[in] start_step Argument passed to `detect_post_source_frontier()`.
2775 @param[in] end_step Argument passed to `detect_post_source_frontier()`.
2776 @param[in] step_interval Argument passed to `detect_post_source_frontier()`.
2777 @return Value returned by `detect_post_source_frontier()`.
2778 """
2779 diagnostic = {
2780 'first_requested_step': start_step,
2781 'first_incomplete_step': None,
2782 'missing_files_for_first_incomplete_step': [],
2783 'closest_complete_step_to_start': None,
2784 'closest_complete_step_to_end': None,
2785 }
2786 if step_interval <= 0 or end_step < start_step or not os.path.isdir(source_dir):
2787 return {
2788 'frontier_step': None,
2789 'diagnostic': diagnostic,
2790 }
2791
2792 complete_steps, source_scan = _scan_complete_source_steps(source_dir, monitor_cfg, post_cfg)
2793 diagnostic['closest_complete_step_to_start'] = _nearest_step(complete_steps, start_step)
2794 diagnostic['closest_complete_step_to_end'] = _nearest_step(complete_steps, end_step)
2795
2796 frontier = None
2797 for step in _iter_post_steps(start_step, end_step, step_interval):
2798 try:
2799 validate_committed_checkpoint(
2800 source_dir, step,
2801 require_particles=source_scan.get('require_particles', False),
2802 )
2803 except ValueError:
2804 expected_paths = _expected_source_paths_for_step(step, source_scan, post_cfg)
2805 diagnostic['first_incomplete_step'] = step
2806 diagnostic['missing_files_for_first_incomplete_step'] = [
2807 os.path.relpath(path, source_dir) for path in expected_paths if not os.path.isfile(path)
2808 ]
2809 if not diagnostic['missing_files_for_first_incomplete_step']:
2810 diagnostic['missing_files_for_first_incomplete_step'] = [
2811 os.path.relpath(_checkpoint_bundle_path(source_dir, step), source_dir)
2812 + ' (invalid bundle)'
2813 ]
2814 break
2815 frontier = step
2816 return {
2817 'frontier_step': frontier,
2818 'diagnostic': diagnostic,
2819 }
2820
2821
2822def persist_post_resume_state(run_dir: str, plan: dict, last_successful_requested_end_step=None):
2823 """!
2824 @brief Persist post resume lineage metadata for future --continue runs.
2825 @param[in] run_dir Argument passed to `persist_post_resume_state()`.
2826 @param[in] plan Argument passed to `persist_post_resume_state()`.
2827 @param[in] last_successful_requested_end_step Argument passed to `persist_post_resume_state()`.
2828 @return Value returned by `persist_post_resume_state()`.
2829 """
2830 state_path = get_post_resume_state_path(run_dir)
2831 payload = {
2832 'schema_version': POST_RESUME_SCHEMA_VERSION,
2833 'run_id': plan.get('run_id'),
2834 'recipe_fingerprint': plan.get('recipe_fingerprint'),
2835 'recipe_signature': plan.get('recipe_signature'),
2836 'requested_start_step': plan.get('requested_start_step'),
2837 'requested_end_step': plan.get('requested_end_step'),
2838 'step_interval': plan.get('step_interval'),
2839 'source_directory': plan.get('source_data_directory'),
2840 'resume_match_source': plan.get('resume_match_source'),
2841 'last_successful_requested_end_step': last_successful_requested_end_step,
2842 'updated_at': datetime.now().isoformat(),
2843 }
2844 write_json_file(state_path, payload)
2845 return state_path
2846
2847
2848def _build_post_lock_wrapper_source() -> str:
2849 """!
2850 @brief Return the Python wrapper used to hold an exclusive post-stage lock.
2851 @return Value returned by `_build_post_lock_wrapper_source()`.
2852 """
2853 return """#!/usr/bin/env python3
2854import argparse
2855import fcntl
2856import json
2857import os
2858import socket
2859import subprocess
2860import sys
2861import time
2862
2863
2864def main():
2865 parser = argparse.ArgumentParser(description='PICurv post-stage lock wrapper')
2866 parser.add_argument('--lock-file', required=True)
2867 parser.add_argument('--metadata-file', required=True)
2868 parser.add_argument('--run-dir', required=True)
2869 parser.add_argument('--recipe-fingerprint', required=True)
2870 parser.add_argument('command', nargs=argparse.REMAINDER)
2871 args = parser.parse_args()
2872
2873 command = list(args.command or [])
2874 if not command or command[0] != '--':
2875 parser.error("expected '-- <command ...>' after wrapper arguments")
2876 command = command[1:]
2877
2878 os.makedirs(os.path.dirname(args.lock_file), exist_ok=True)
2879 fd = os.open(args.lock_file, os.O_RDWR | os.O_CREAT, 0o644)
2880 try:
2881 fcntl.flock(fd, fcntl.LOCK_EX | fcntl.LOCK_NB)
2882 except BlockingIOError:
2883 owner = None
2884 try:
2885 with open(args.metadata_file, 'r', encoding='utf-8') as handle:
2886 owner = json.load(handle)
2887 except Exception:
2888 owner = None
2889 if owner:
2890 print(
2891 f"[FATAL] Post stage already active for {args.run_dir} "
2892 f"(pid={owner.get('pid')}, host={owner.get('host')}, started_at={owner.get('started_at')}).",
2893 file=sys.stderr,
2894 )
2895 else:
2896 print(f"[FATAL] Post stage already active for {args.run_dir}.", file=sys.stderr)
2897 return 2
2898
2899 metadata = {
2900 'pid': os.getpid(),
2901 'host': socket.gethostname(),
2902 'started_at': time.strftime('%Y-%m-%dT%H:%M:%S%z'),
2903 'run_dir': args.run_dir,
2904 'recipe_fingerprint': args.recipe_fingerprint,
2905 'command': command,
2906 }
2907 with open(args.metadata_file, 'w', encoding='utf-8') as handle:
2908 json.dump(metadata, handle, indent=2, sort_keys=True)
2909 handle.write('\\n')
2910
2911 try:
2912 result = subprocess.run(command)
2913 return int(result.returncode)
2914 finally:
2915 try:
2916 os.remove(args.metadata_file)
2917 except FileNotFoundError:
2918 pass
2919 os.close(fd)
2920
2921
2922if __name__ == '__main__':
2923 raise SystemExit(main())
2924"""
2925
2926
2927def ensure_post_lock_wrapper(run_dir: str) -> str:
2928 """!
2929 @brief Ensure the lock wrapper exists for a run directory and return its path.
2930 @param[in] run_dir Argument passed to `ensure_post_lock_wrapper()`.
2931 @return Value returned by `ensure_post_lock_wrapper()`.
2932 """
2933 paths = get_post_lock_paths(run_dir)
2934 wrapper_path = paths['wrapper_path']
2935 content = _build_post_lock_wrapper_source()
2936 existing_content = None
2937 os.makedirs(os.path.dirname(wrapper_path), exist_ok=True)
2938 if os.path.isfile(wrapper_path):
2939 with open(wrapper_path, 'r', encoding='utf-8', errors='replace') as f:
2940 existing_content = f.read()
2941 if existing_content != content:
2942 with open(wrapper_path, 'w', encoding='utf-8') as f:
2943 f.write(content)
2944 os.chmod(wrapper_path, 0o755)
2945 return wrapper_path
2946
2947
2948def build_post_locked_command(run_dir: str, recipe_fingerprint: str, wrapped_command: list, create_wrapper: bool = True) -> "tuple[list, dict]":
2949 """!
2950 @brief Wrap a postprocessor command behind the run-dir-scoped lock wrapper.
2951 @param[in] run_dir Argument passed to `build_post_locked_command()`.
2952 @param[in] recipe_fingerprint Argument passed to `build_post_locked_command()`.
2953 @param[in] wrapped_command Argument passed to `build_post_locked_command()`.
2954 @param[in] create_wrapper Argument passed to `build_post_locked_command()`.
2955 @return Value returned by `build_post_locked_command()`.
2956 """
2957 lock_paths = get_post_lock_paths(run_dir)
2958 wrapper_path = ensure_post_lock_wrapper(run_dir) if create_wrapper else lock_paths['wrapper_path']
2959 command = [
2960 wrapper_path,
2961 '--lock-file', lock_paths['lock_file'],
2962 '--metadata-file', lock_paths['metadata_file'],
2963 '--run-dir', run_dir,
2964 '--recipe-fingerprint', recipe_fingerprint,
2965 '--',
2966 ] + list(wrapped_command)
2967 return command, lock_paths

2970def build_post_execution_plan(
2971 run_dir: str,
2972 run_id: str,
2973 case_cfg: dict,
2974 monitor_cfg: dict,
2975 post_cfg: dict,
2976 continue_requested: bool = False,
2977 allow_source_frontier_scan: bool = True,
2978) -> dict:
2979 """!
2980 @brief Resolve post resume/source-availability behavior into one execution plan.
2981 @param[in] run_dir Argument passed to `build_post_execution_plan()`.
2982 @param[in] run_id Argument passed to `build_post_execution_plan()`.
2983 @param[in] case_cfg Argument passed to `build_post_execution_plan()`.
2984 @param[in] monitor_cfg Argument passed to `build_post_execution_plan()`.
2985 @param[in] post_cfg Argument passed to `build_post_execution_plan()`.
2986 @param[in] continue_requested Argument passed to `build_post_execution_plan()`.
2987 @param[in] allow_source_frontier_scan Argument passed to `build_post_execution_plan()`.
2988 @return Value returned by `build_post_execution_plan()`.
2989 """
2990 requested_start_step, requested_end_step, step_interval = resolve_post_requested_window(post_cfg, case_cfg)
2991 resolved_source_dir = _resolve_post_source_directory_preview(run_dir, monitor_cfg, post_cfg)
2992 resolved_post_cfg = prepare_effective_post_config(post_cfg, resolved_source_dir)
2993 recipe_cfg = build_post_recipe_config(resolved_post_cfg, monitor_cfg)
2994 recipe_signature, recipe_fingerprint = compute_post_recipe_fingerprint(recipe_cfg)
2995
2996 state_path = get_post_resume_state_path(run_dir)
2997 state_payload = _read_json_if_exists(state_path)
2998 state_match = bool(isinstance(state_payload, dict) and state_payload.get('recipe_fingerprint') == recipe_fingerprint)
2999
3000 legacy_post_run_path = os.path.join(run_dir, 'config', 'post.run')
3001 legacy_recipe_cfg = parse_post_recipe_file(legacy_post_run_path)
3002 legacy_recipe_signature = normalize_post_recipe_signature(legacy_recipe_cfg or {}) if legacy_recipe_cfg else None
3003 legacy_match = bool(legacy_recipe_signature and legacy_recipe_signature == recipe_signature)
3004
3005 resume_recipe_match = False
3006 resume_match_source = None
3007 resume_bootstrapped = False
3008 if continue_requested:
3009 if state_match:
3010 resume_recipe_match = True
3011 resume_match_source = 'state'
3012 elif not state_payload and legacy_match:
3013 resume_recipe_match = True
3014 resume_match_source = 'legacy_post_run'
3015 resume_bootstrapped = True
3016
3017 completion_info = detect_post_completed_frontier(
3018 run_dir,
3019 resolved_post_cfg,
3020 monitor_cfg,
3021 requested_start_step,
3022 requested_end_step,
3023 step_interval,
3024 )
3025 completed_frontier_step = completion_info['frontier_step']
3026 if completion_info['artifact_family_count'] == 0 and state_match:
3027 completed_frontier_step = _parse_int_loose(state_payload.get('last_successful_requested_end_step'))
3028
3029 if continue_requested and resume_recipe_match and completed_frontier_step is not None:
3030 effective_start_step = completed_frontier_step + step_interval
3031 else:
3032 effective_start_step = requested_start_step
3033
3034 source_frontier_step = None
3035 source_frontier_diagnostic = None
3036 source_frontier_deferred = not allow_source_frontier_scan
3037 skip_reason = None
3038 if effective_start_step > requested_end_step:
3039 skip_reason = 'already-complete-window'
3040 effective_end_step = requested_end_step
3041 elif allow_source_frontier_scan:
3042 source_frontier_info = detect_post_source_frontier(
3043 resolved_source_dir,
3044 monitor_cfg,
3045 resolved_post_cfg,
3046 effective_start_step,
3047 requested_end_step,
3048 step_interval,
3049 )
3050 source_frontier_step = source_frontier_info['frontier_step']
3051 source_frontier_diagnostic = source_frontier_info['diagnostic']
3052 if source_frontier_step is None or source_frontier_step < effective_start_step:
3053 if continue_requested and resume_recipe_match and completed_frontier_step is not None:
3054 skip_reason = 'already-caught-up-to-current-source-frontier'
3055 else:
3056 skip_reason = 'nothing-available-yet'
3057 effective_end_step = None
3058 else:
3059 effective_end_step = min(requested_end_step, source_frontier_step)
3060 else:
3061 effective_end_step = requested_end_step
3062
3063 effective_post_cfg = None
3064 if skip_reason is None:
3065 effective_post_cfg = prepare_effective_post_config(
3066 post_cfg,
3067 resolved_source_dir,
3068 start_step=effective_start_step,
3069 end_step=effective_end_step,
3070 )
3071
3072 return {
3073 'run_id': run_id,
3074 'continue_requested': bool(continue_requested),
3075 'requested_start_step': requested_start_step,
3076 'requested_end_step': requested_end_step,
3077 'step_interval': step_interval,
3078 'source_data_directory': resolved_source_dir,
3079 'recipe_config': recipe_cfg,
3080 'recipe_signature': recipe_signature,
3081 'recipe_fingerprint': recipe_fingerprint,
3082 'resume_state_path': state_path,
3083 'resume_state_payload': state_payload,
3084 'resume_recipe_match': resume_recipe_match,
3085 'resume_match_source': resume_match_source,
3086 'resume_bootstrapped': resume_bootstrapped,
3087 'completed_frontier_step': completed_frontier_step,
3088 'source_frontier_step': source_frontier_step,
3089 'source_frontier_diagnostic': source_frontier_diagnostic,
3090 'source_frontier_deferred': source_frontier_deferred,
3091 'effective_start_step': effective_start_step,
3092 'effective_end_step': effective_end_step,
3093 'skip_reason': skip_reason,
3094 'resolved_post_cfg': resolved_post_cfg,
3095 'effective_post_cfg': effective_post_cfg,
3096 'lock_paths': get_post_lock_paths(run_dir),
3097 }
3098

3100def needs_restart_source(case_cfg: dict, solver_cfg: dict) -> bool:
3101 """!
3102 @brief Return True when the solver requires restart data from disk.
3103 @details Correctly identifies that analytical + init + start_step > 0 does NOT
3104 need a restart source (C code never reads from restart_dir in that case).
3105 @param[in] case_cfg Parsed case YAML dictionary.
3106 @param[in] solver_cfg Parsed solver YAML dictionary.
3107 @return True if a restart source (--restart-from or --continue) is required.
3108 """
3109 try:
3110 start_step = int(case_cfg.get("run_control", {}).get("start_step", 0) or 0)
3111 except (TypeError, ValueError):
3112 start_step = 0
3113 eulerian_source = str(
3114 (solver_cfg.get("operation_mode", {}) or {}).get("eulerian_field_source", "solve")
3115 ).strip().lower()
3116 particle_restart_mode = str(
3117 (case_cfg.get("models", {}).get("physics", {}).get("particles", {}) or {}).get("restart_mode", "init")
3118 ).strip().lower()
3119 euler_needs = (eulerian_source == "load") or (eulerian_source == "solve" and start_step > 0)
3120 particle_needs = (particle_restart_mode == "load")
3121 return euler_needs or particle_needs
3122

3148def compute_physical_case_identity(case_cfg: dict) -> str:
3149 """!
3150 @brief Compute the hidden identity used to guard in-place continuation.
3151 @details Run length/timestep controls and particle load-vs-init policy do
3152 not define the physical case. All other case.yml content does.
3153 @param[in] case_cfg Parsed case configuration.
3154 @return Lowercase SHA-256 identity of normalized physical-case content.
3155 """
3156 normalized = copy.deepcopy(case_cfg)
3157 if isinstance(normalized, dict):
3158 normalized.pop("run_control", None)
3159 particles = (((normalized.get("models") or {}).get("physics") or {}).get("particles"))
3160 if isinstance(particles, dict):
3161 particles.pop("restart_mode", None)
3162 payload = json.dumps(
3163 normalized, sort_keys=True, separators=(",", ":"), ensure_ascii=False
3164 ).encode("utf-8")
3165 return hashlib.sha256(payload).hexdigest()
3166
3167
3168def validate_continue_case_identity(run_dir: str, case_cfg: dict) -> None:
3169 """!
3170 @brief Reject in-place continuation when the physical case has changed.
3171 @param[in] run_dir Existing run directory being continued.
3172 @param[in] case_cfg Newly requested case configuration.
3173 @return None.
3174 """
3175 saved_case_path = os.path.join(run_dir, "config", "case.yml")
3176 if not os.path.isfile(saved_case_path):
3177 raise ValueError(f"--continue run is missing its saved case.yml: {saved_case_path}")
3178 saved_case = read_yaml_file(saved_case_path)
3179 if compute_physical_case_identity(saved_case) != compute_physical_case_identity(case_cfg):
3180 raise ValueError(
3181 "--continue cannot change the physical case. Change only run_control, "
3182 "solver.yml, monitor.yml, or post.yml; use --restart-from for a new case branch."
3183 )

3186def populate_restart_directory(source_output: str, target_restart: str, start_step: int, monitor_cfg: dict):
3187 """!
3188 @brief Copy checkpoint files for a specific step from source output to target restart.
3189 @param[in] source_output Path to the source output directory containing checkpoint data.
3190 @param[in] target_restart Path to the target restart directory to populate.
3191 @param[in] start_step The step number whose checkpoint files should be copied.
3192 @param[in] monitor_cfg Parsed monitor YAML dictionary (for subdirectory names).
3193 @return Exact path to the copied committed checkpoint bundle.
3194 """
3195 del monitor_cfg
3196 source = validate_committed_checkpoint(source_output, start_step)["bundle"]
3197 checkpoints_root = os.path.join(os.path.abspath(target_restart), "checkpoints")
3198 destination = os.path.join(
3199 checkpoints_root, f"step_{start_step:0{CHECKPOINT_STEP_WIDTH}d}"
3200 )
3201 if os.path.isdir(destination):
3202 validate_committed_checkpoint(destination, start_step)
3203 print(f"[INFO] Reusing committed restart bundle: {destination}")
3204 return destination
3205
3206 os.makedirs(checkpoints_root, exist_ok=True)
3207 temporary = os.path.join(
3208 checkpoints_root,
3209 f".step_{start_step:0{CHECKPOINT_STEP_WIDTH}d}.copying.{os.getpid()}",
3210 )
3211 if os.path.exists(temporary):
3212 raise ValueError(f"Restart staging path already exists: {temporary}")
3213 try:
3214 shutil.copytree(source, temporary)
3215 validate_committed_checkpoint(temporary, start_step)
3216 os.replace(temporary, destination)
3217 except Exception:
3218 if os.path.isdir(temporary):
3219 shutil.rmtree(temporary)
3220 raise
3221 print(f"[INFO] Copied committed restart bundle for step {start_step}: {destination}")
3222 return destination
3223

3249def detect_case_completion_status(run_dir: str, monitor_cfg: dict, target_final_step: int) -> dict:
3250 """!
3251 @brief Determine whether a study case is complete, partially complete, or empty.
3252 @param[in] run_dir Path to the case run directory.
3253 @param[in] monitor_cfg Parsed monitor YAML dictionary.
3254 @param[in] target_final_step The step number the case should reach for completion.
3255 @return Dictionary with keys 'last_step' (int or None), 'target_step' (int),
3256 and 'status' ('complete', 'partial', or 'empty').
3257 """
3258 output_dir = resolve_run_output_dir(run_dir, monitor_cfg)
3259 last_step = detect_last_checkpoint_step(output_dir)
3260 if last_step is not None and last_step >= target_final_step:
3261 status = "complete"
3262 elif last_step is not None:
3263 status = "partial"
3264 else:
3265 status = "empty"
3266 return {"last_step": last_step, "target_step": target_final_step, "status": status}

3269def validate_load_mode_step_range(source_output: str, start_step: int, total_steps: int, monitor_cfg: dict):
3270 """!
3271 @brief Validate that all required eulerian step files exist for "load" mode.
3272 @details Checks that ufield files exist for every step from start_step through
3273 start_step + total_steps (inclusive). Reports missing steps clearly.
3274 @param[in] source_output Path to the output directory containing eulerian data.
3275 @param[in] start_step First step that will be loaded.
3276 @param[in] total_steps Number of steps to run.
3277 @param[in] monitor_cfg Parsed monitor YAML dictionary (for subdirectory names).
3278 """
3279 missing = []
3280 for step in range(start_step, start_step + total_steps + 1):
3281 try:
3282 validate_eulerian_checkpoint(source_output, step, monitor_cfg)
3283 except ValueError:
3284 missing.append(step)
3285
3286 if missing:
3287 sample = missing[:3] + (["..."] if len(missing) > 6 else []) + missing[-3:]
3288 raise ValueError(
3289 f"Eulerian 'load' mode: {len(missing)} committed checkpoint(s) missing in {source_output}. "
3290 f"Missing steps include: {sample}"
3291 )
3292

3320def resolve_restart_source(args, case_cfg: dict, solver_cfg: dict, monitor_cfg: dict, run_dir: str):
3321 """!
3322 @brief Resolve the restart source directory based on --restart-from or --continue CLI flags.
3323 @details Implements the full restart resolution logic including smart resolution for
3324 --continue (checks restart/ first for user-curated data, falls back to output/)
3325 and direct reference for eulerian "load" mode.
3326 @param[in] args Parsed CLI arguments (must have restart_from, continue_run, run_dir attrs).
3327 @param[in] case_cfg Parsed case YAML dictionary.
3328 @param[in] solver_cfg Parsed solver YAML dictionary.
3329 @param[in] monitor_cfg Parsed monitor YAML dictionary.
3330 @param[in] run_dir Path to the current run directory.
3331 @return Tuple of (restart_source_dir, continue_mode) where restart_source_dir is the
3332 resolved path (or None) and continue_mode is a boolean.
3333 """
3334 try:
3335 start_step = int(case_cfg.get("run_control", {}).get("start_step", 0) or 0)
3336 except (TypeError, ValueError):
3337 start_step = 0
3338 try:
3339 total_steps = int(case_cfg.get("run_control", {}).get("total_steps", 0) or 0)
3340 except (TypeError, ValueError):
3341 total_steps = 0
3342
3343 eulerian_source = str(
3344 (solver_cfg.get("operation_mode", {}) or {}).get("eulerian_field_source", "solve")
3345 ).strip().lower()
3346
3347 particle_restart_mode = str(
3348 (case_cfg.get("models", {}).get("physics", {}).get("particles", {}) or {}).get("restart_mode", "init")
3349 ).strip().lower()
3350 particle_needs = (particle_restart_mode == "load")
3351
3352 requires_source = needs_restart_source(case_cfg, solver_cfg)
3353 restart_from = getattr(args, 'restart_from', None)
3354 continue_run = getattr(args, 'continue_run', False)
3355
3356 if restart_from and continue_run:
3357 raise ValueError("--restart-from and --continue are mutually exclusive.")
3358
3359 if continue_run and start_step <= 0:
3360 raise ValueError(
3361 "--continue with --solve requires run_control.start_step > 0; "
3362 "start_step=0 is a fresh start. Omit --continue to start a fresh run."
3363 )
3364
3365 if restart_from:
3366 # Statistics continuation is tied to --continue. A branch may follow a
3367 # different physical trajectory than the samples already collected, so the
3368 # specification requires an explicit opt-in that does not exist yet; without
3369 # it the windows would silently restart from zero and report a sample count
3370 # that describes a shorter average than the user expects.
3371 if normalize_field_statistics_config(monitor_cfg or {})["enabled"]:
3372 raise ValueError(
3373 "--restart-from cannot carry accumulated field statistics forward: the windows "
3374 "would silently restart from zero. Use --continue to resume a run in place, or "
3375 "set 'field_statistics.enabled: false' to branch without them."
3376 )
3377
3378 # === MODE 1: New run, restart from another run ===
3379 source_run = os.path.abspath(restart_from)
3380 if not os.path.isdir(source_run):
3381 raise ValueError(f"--restart-from run directory does not exist: {source_run}")
3382 source_monitor = read_monitor_from_run(source_run)
3383 source_output = resolve_run_output_dir(source_run, source_monitor)
3384 if not os.path.isdir(source_output):
3385 raise ValueError(f"Source output directory does not exist: {source_output}")
3386
3387 if not requires_source:
3388 # R7: analytical + init — warn that --restart-from is unused
3389 print(
3390 "[WARN] --restart-from specified but no data will be read "
3391 "(analytical + init does not need restart data).",
3392 file=sys.stderr,
3393 )
3394 return None, False
3395
3396 if eulerian_source == "load":
3397 # R3/R4/R5: Direct reference to source output
3398 validate_load_mode_step_range(source_output, start_step, total_steps, source_monitor)
3399 if particle_needs:
3400 validate_particle_checkpoint(source_output, start_step, source_monitor)
3401 return source_output, False
3402 else:
3403 # Copy one immutable bundle into the new run's restart staging area.
3404 target_restart = resolve_run_restart_dir(run_dir, monitor_cfg)
3405 restart_bundle = populate_restart_directory(
3406 source_output, target_restart, start_step, monitor_cfg
3407 )
3408 if particle_needs:
3409 validate_particle_checkpoint(restart_bundle, start_step, monitor_cfg)
3410 return restart_bundle, False
3411
3412 elif continue_run:
3413 # === MODE 2: Continue in-place ===
3414 continue_run_dir = getattr(args, 'run_dir', None)
3415 if not continue_run_dir:
3416 raise ValueError(RESTART_RUN_DIR_REQUIRED_MESSAGE)
3417 continue_run_dir = os.path.abspath(continue_run_dir)
3418 if not os.path.isdir(continue_run_dir):
3419 raise ValueError(f"--run-dir does not exist: {continue_run_dir}")
3420 validate_continue_case_identity(continue_run_dir, case_cfg)
3421
3422 source_output = resolve_run_output_dir(continue_run_dir, monitor_cfg)
3423 # Warn if start_step != last checkpoint
3424 last_step = detect_last_checkpoint_step(source_output)
3425 if last_step is not None and last_step != start_step:
3426 print(
3427 f"[WARN] start_step={start_step} but last checkpoint in output is step {last_step}.",
3428 file=sys.stderr,
3429 )
3430
3431 if eulerian_source == "load":
3432 # C3/C4: Direct reference to output/ (all euler steps there, can't copy)
3433 validate_load_mode_step_range(source_output, start_step, total_steps, monitor_cfg)
3434 if particle_needs:
3435 validate_particle_checkpoint(source_output, start_step, monitor_cfg)
3436 return source_output, True
3437 elif not requires_source:
3438 # C6: analytical + init — only log-append behavior, no data needed
3439 return None, True
3440 else:
3441 # In-place continuation reads the immutable committed bundle directly.
3442 checkpoint = validate_committed_checkpoint(
3443 source_output, start_step, require_particles=particle_needs
3444 )
3445 return checkpoint["bundle"], True
3446
3447 elif requires_source:
3448 raise ValueError(
3449 "Restart data required but no source specified. Use:\n"
3450 " --restart-from <run_dir> (new run from another run's data)\n"
3451 " --continue --run-dir <run_dir> (resume in same directory)"
3452 )
3453
3454 return None, False
3455
3456def absolutize_case_external_paths(case_cfg: dict, case_anchor_path: str):
3457 """!
3458 @brief Convert external grid/generator paths in case config to absolute paths.
3459 @param[in] case_cfg Argument passed to `absolutize_case_external_paths()`.
3460 @param[in] case_anchor_path Argument passed to `absolutize_case_external_paths()`.
3461 """
3462 grid_cfg = case_cfg.get("grid", {})
3463 if not isinstance(grid_cfg, dict):
3464 return
3465 mode = grid_cfg.get("mode")
3466 if mode == "file":
3467 source_file = grid_cfg.get("source_file")
3468 if isinstance(source_file, str):
3469 grid_cfg["source_file"] = resolve_path(case_anchor_path, source_file)
3470 legacy_cfg = grid_cfg.get("legacy_conversion", {})
3471 if isinstance(legacy_cfg, dict):
3472 script_path = legacy_cfg.get("script")
3473 if isinstance(script_path, str):
3474 legacy_cfg["script"] = resolve_path(case_anchor_path, script_path)
3475 elif mode == "grid_gen":
3476 gen = grid_cfg.get("generator", {})
3477 if isinstance(gen, dict):
3478 for key in ("script", "config_file"):
3479 val = gen.get(key)
3480 if isinstance(val, str):
3481 gen[key] = resolve_path(case_anchor_path, val)
3482 ic = (case_cfg.get("properties", {}) or {}).get("initial_conditions", {})
3483 if isinstance(ic, dict):
3484 if str(ic.get("mode", "")).strip().lower() == "file":
3485 source_file = ic.get("source_file")
3486 if isinstance(source_file, str):
3487 ic["source_file"] = resolve_path(case_anchor_path, source_file)
3488 elif str(ic.get("generator", "")).strip().lower() == "ic_gen":
3489 params = ic.get("params", {})
3490 if isinstance(params, dict):
3491 for key in ("script", "config_file"):
3492 value = params.get(key)
3493 if isinstance(value, str):
3494 params[key] = resolve_path(case_anchor_path, value)
3495 boundary_conditions = case_cfg.get("boundary_conditions", [])
3496 blocks = boundary_conditions if boundary_conditions and isinstance(boundary_conditions[0], list) else [boundary_conditions]
3497 for block in blocks:
3498 if not isinstance(block, list):
3499 continue
3500 for bc in block:
3501 if not isinstance(bc, dict) or str(bc.get("handler", "")).strip().lower() != "prescribed_flow":
3502 continue
3503 source = ((bc.get("params") or {}).get("source") or {})
3504 if not isinstance(source, dict):
3505 continue
3506 source_type = str(source.get("type", "")).strip().lower()
3507 if source_type == "file":
3508 keys = ("path",)
3509 elif source_type == "generated":
3510 keys = ("script",)
3511 elif source_type == "field_slice":
3512 keys = ("script", "field_file", "grid_file", "source_case")
3513 else:
3514 keys = ()
3515 for key in keys:
3516 value = source.get(key)
3517 if isinstance(value, str):
3518 source[key] = resolve_path(case_anchor_path, value)
3519
3520
3521def prepare_case_for_continuation(run_dir: str, case_id: str, last_step: int,
3522 target_final_step: int, cluster_cfg: dict):
3523 """!
3524 @brief Set up a partially-completed study case for continuation in-place.
3525 @details Updates the case config with new start_step/total_steps, sets particle
3526 restart_mode to 'load' if checkpoint exists, populates the restart
3527 directory, and regenerates the solver control file with continue_mode.
3528 Delegates all restart resolution to resolve_restart_source().
3529 @param[in] run_dir Path to the case run directory.
3530 @param[in] case_id The case identifier (e.g. 'case_0002').
3531 @param[in] last_step The last checkpoint step found in the output directory.
3532 @param[in] target_final_step The step number the case should reach for completion.
3533 @param[in] cluster_cfg Parsed cluster YAML dictionary (for num_procs, walltime guard).
3534 @return The absolute path to the regenerated control file.
3535 """
3536 config_dir = os.path.join(run_dir, "config")
3537 case_cfg = read_yaml_file(os.path.join(config_dir, "case.yml"))
3538 solver_cfg = read_yaml_file(os.path.join(config_dir, "solver.yml"))
3539 monitor_cfg = read_yaml_file(os.path.join(config_dir, "monitor.yml"))
3540
3541 remaining = target_final_step - last_step
3542 case_cfg["run_control"]["start_step"] = last_step
3543 case_cfg["run_control"]["total_steps"] = remaining
3544 print(f"[INFO] {case_id}: updating start_step={last_step}, total_steps={remaining}")
3545
3546 output_dir = resolve_run_output_dir(run_dir, monitor_cfg)
3547 particles_cfg = (case_cfg.get("models", {}).get("physics", {}) or {}).get("particles")
3548 checkpoint_has_particles = False
3549 try:
3550 checkpoint_has_particles = validate_committed_checkpoint(
3551 output_dir, last_step, require_particles=True
3552 )["has_particles"]
3553 except ValueError:
3554 checkpoint_has_particles = False
3555 if particles_cfg is not None and checkpoint_has_particles:
3556 current_mode = str(particles_cfg.get("restart_mode", "init")).strip().lower()
3557 if current_mode != "load":
3558 particles_cfg["restart_mode"] = "load"
3559 print(f"[INFO] {case_id}: setting particle restart_mode='load' (checkpoint found)")
3560
3561 write_yaml_file(os.path.join(config_dir, "case.yml"), case_cfg)
3562
3563 mock_args = argparse.Namespace(restart_from=None, continue_run=True, run_dir=run_dir)
3564 restart_source_dir, continue_mode = resolve_restart_source(
3565 mock_args, case_cfg, solver_cfg, monitor_cfg, run_dir
3566 )
3567
3568 source_files = {
3569 'Case': os.path.join(config_dir, "case.yml"),
3570 'Solver': os.path.join(config_dir, "solver.yml"),
3571 'Monitor': os.path.join(config_dir, "monitor.yml"),
3572 }
3573 monitor_files = prepare_monitor_files(run_dir, case_id, monitor_cfg, source_files)
3574 cluster_tasks = get_cluster_total_tasks(cluster_cfg)
3575 configs = {
3576 "case": case_cfg, "case_path": source_files['Case'],
3577 "solver": solver_cfg, "solver_path": source_files['Solver'],
3578 "monitor": monitor_cfg, "monitor_path": source_files['Monitor'],
3579 "walltime_guard_policy": resolve_walltime_guard_policy(cluster_cfg),
3580 }
3581 control_file = generate_solver_control_file(
3582 run_dir, case_id, configs, cluster_tasks, monitor_files,
3583 restart_source_dir=restart_source_dir, continue_mode=continue_mode,
3584 )
3585 print(f"[SUCCESS] {case_id}: regenerated control file for continuation")
3586 return control_file
3587

3589def is_valid_email(email: str) -> bool:
3590 """!
3591 @brief Lightweight email validation for scheduler notifications.
3592 @param[in] email Argument passed to `is_valid_email()`.
3593 @return Value returned by `is_valid_email()`.
3594 """
3595 if not isinstance(email, str):
3596 return False
3597 pattern = r"^[^@\s]+@[^@\s]+\.[^@\s]+$"
3598 return re.match(pattern, email.strip()) is not None

3600def normalize_statistics_task(task_name: str) -> str:
3601 """!
3602 @brief Normalizes user-facing statistics task names to C pipeline keywords.
3603 @param[in] task_name Task name from YAML.
3604 @return Canonical keyword accepted by C statistics pipeline.
3605 @throws ValueError if task is unsupported.
3606 """
3607 # Only implemented statistics kernels belong here.
3608 if task_name is None:
3609 raise ValueError("statistics task cannot be None")
3610 normalized = str(task_name).strip().lower().replace("-", "_").replace(" ", "_")
3611 if normalized != "msd":
3612 raise ValueError(f"Unsupported statistics task '{task_name}'. Currently supported: 'msd'.")
3613 return "ComputeMSD"

3615def _iter_nonempty_noncomment_lines(file_obj):
3616 """!
3617 @brief Yield (lineno, stripped_line) for non-empty, non-comment lines.
3618 @param[in] file_obj Argument passed to `_iter_nonempty_noncomment_lines()`.
3619 """
3620 for lineno, raw in enumerate(file_obj, start=1):
3621 line = raw.strip()
3622 if not line or line.startswith("#"):
3623 continue
3624 yield lineno, line
3625
3626PICGRID_FLOAT_FORMAT = ".17e"
3627
3628
3629def format_picgrid_coordinate(value: float) -> str:
3630 """!
3631 @brief Format a coordinate with round-trip-safe binary64 precision.
3632 @param[in] value Coordinate value.
3633 @return Formatted coordinate.
3634 """
3635 return format(value, PICGRID_FLOAT_FORMAT)
3636
3637
3638def validate_and_nondimensionalize_picgrid(source_grid: str, dest_grid: str, L_ref: float, expected_nblk: int = None) -> dict:
3639 """!
3640 @brief Validates PICGRID payload and writes a non-dimensionalized copy.
3641 @details Requires canonical PICGRID input with leading "PICGRID" token.
3642 Output is always written in canonical PICGRID format with header and per-block dims.
3643 @param[in] source_grid Input grid file path.
3644 @param[in] dest_grid Output grid file path.
3645 @param[in] L_ref Reference length for non-dimensionalization.
3646 @param[in] expected_nblk Optional expected block count.
3647 @return Summary dictionary with nblk, dims, and total_nodes.
3648 @throws ValueError on malformed grid.
3649 """
3650 if L_ref == 0.0:
3651 raise ValueError("length_ref must be non-zero when processing grid coordinates.")
3652 if not os.path.isfile(source_grid):
3653 raise ValueError(f"Grid file not found: {source_grid}")
3654
3655 with open(source_grid, "r") as fin:
3656 line_iter = _iter_nonempty_noncomment_lines(fin)
3657 try:
3658 _, first_token = next(line_iter)
3659 except StopIteration:
3660 raise ValueError(f"Grid file '{source_grid}' is empty.")
3661
3662 if first_token != "PICGRID":
3663 raise ValueError(
3664 f"Grid file '{source_grid}' must begin with the canonical PICGRID header token."
3665 )
3666 try:
3667 _, nblk_line = next(line_iter)
3668 except StopIteration:
3669 raise ValueError(f"Grid file '{source_grid}' missing block count after PICGRID header.")
3670
3671 try:
3672 nblk = int(nblk_line)
3673 except ValueError:
3674 raise ValueError(f"Invalid block count '{nblk_line}' in grid file '{source_grid}'.")
3675 if nblk <= 0:
3676 raise ValueError(f"Grid file '{source_grid}' has non-positive block count: {nblk}.")
3677 if expected_nblk is not None and nblk != expected_nblk:
3678 raise ValueError(
3679 f"Grid file block count mismatch: case expects {expected_nblk}, grid contains {nblk}."
3680 )
3681
3682 dims = []
3683 for bi in range(nblk):
3684 try:
3685 lineno, dim_line = next(line_iter)
3686 except StopIteration:
3687 raise ValueError(f"Grid file '{source_grid}' missing dimensions for block {bi}.")
3688 parts = dim_line.split()
3689 if len(parts) != 3:
3690 raise ValueError(
3691 f"Invalid dimensions line at {source_grid}:{lineno}. Expected 3 integers, got: '{dim_line}'."
3692 )
3693 try:
3694 im, jm, km = (int(parts[0]), int(parts[1]), int(parts[2]))
3695 except ValueError:
3696 raise ValueError(
3697 f"Invalid dimensions line at {source_grid}:{lineno}. Non-integer values: '{dim_line}'."
3698 )
3699 if im <= 0 or jm <= 0 or km <= 0:
3700 raise ValueError(
3701 f"Invalid block dimensions at {source_grid}:{lineno}: ({im}, {jm}, {km}). Must be > 0."
3702 )
3703 dims.append((im, jm, km))
3704
3705 total_nodes_expected = sum(im * jm * km for (im, jm, km) in dims)
3706 os.makedirs(os.path.dirname(dest_grid), exist_ok=True)
3707 with open(dest_grid, "w") as fout:
3708 fout.write("PICGRID\n")
3709 fout.write(f"{nblk}\n")
3710 for (im, jm, km) in dims:
3711 fout.write(f"{im} {jm} {km}\n")
3712
3713 total_nodes_seen = 0
3714 for lineno, coord_line in line_iter:
3715 parts = coord_line.split()
3716 if len(parts) != 3:
3717 raise ValueError(
3718 f"Invalid coordinate row at {source_grid}:{lineno}. Expected 3 floats, got: '{coord_line}'."
3719 )
3720 try:
3721 x = float(parts[0]) / L_ref
3722 y = float(parts[1]) / L_ref
3723 z = float(parts[2]) / L_ref
3724 except ValueError:
3725 raise ValueError(
3726 f"Invalid coordinate row at {source_grid}:{lineno}. Non-numeric values: '{coord_line}'."
3727 )
3728 total_nodes_seen += 1
3729 if total_nodes_seen > total_nodes_expected:
3730 raise ValueError(
3731 f"Grid file '{source_grid}' has more coordinates ({total_nodes_seen}) than expected ({total_nodes_expected})."
3732 )
3733 fout.write(
3734 f"{format_picgrid_coordinate(x)} {format_picgrid_coordinate(y)} "
3735 f"{format_picgrid_coordinate(z)}\n"
3736 )
3737
3738 if total_nodes_seen != total_nodes_expected:
3739 raise ValueError(
3740 f"Grid file '{source_grid}' has {total_nodes_seen} coordinates, expected {total_nodes_expected} from header."
3741 )
3742
3743 return {"nblk": nblk, "dims": dims, "total_nodes": total_nodes_expected}
3744
3745def read_picgrid_header_dimensions(source_grid: str, expected_nblk: int = None) -> list:
3746 """!
3747 @brief Read only the canonical PICGRID header dimensions.
3748 @param[in] source_grid Input grid file path.
3749 @param[in] expected_nblk Optional expected block count.
3750 @return List of (IM, JM, KM) node-count tuples.
3751 @throws ValueError on malformed header.
3752 """
3753 if not os.path.isfile(source_grid):
3754 raise ValueError(f"Grid file not found: {source_grid}")
3755
3756 with open(source_grid, "r") as fin:
3757 line_iter = _iter_nonempty_noncomment_lines(fin)
3758 try:
3759 _, first_token = next(line_iter)
3760 except StopIteration:
3761 raise ValueError(f"Grid file '{source_grid}' is empty.")
3762 if first_token != "PICGRID":
3763 raise ValueError(f"Grid file '{source_grid}' must begin with the canonical PICGRID header token.")
3764
3765 try:
3766 _, nblk_line = next(line_iter)
3767 nblk = int(nblk_line)
3768 except StopIteration:
3769 raise ValueError(f"Grid file '{source_grid}' missing block count after PICGRID header.")
3770 except ValueError:
3771 raise ValueError(f"Invalid block count '{nblk_line}' in grid file '{source_grid}'.")
3772 if nblk <= 0:
3773 raise ValueError(f"Grid file '{source_grid}' has non-positive block count: {nblk}.")
3774 if expected_nblk is not None and nblk != expected_nblk:
3775 raise ValueError(f"Grid file block count mismatch: case expects {expected_nblk}, grid contains {nblk}.")
3776
3777 dims = []
3778 for bi in range(nblk):
3779 try:
3780 lineno, dim_line = next(line_iter)
3781 except StopIteration:
3782 raise ValueError(f"Grid file '{source_grid}' missing dimensions for block {bi}.")
3783 parts = dim_line.split()
3784 if len(parts) != 3:
3785 raise ValueError(
3786 f"Invalid dimensions line at {source_grid}:{lineno}. Expected 3 integers, got: '{dim_line}'."
3787 )
3788 try:
3789 im, jm, km = (int(parts[0]), int(parts[1]), int(parts[2]))
3790 except ValueError:
3791 raise ValueError(
3792 f"Invalid dimensions line at {source_grid}:{lineno}. Non-integer values: '{dim_line}'."
3793 )
3794 if im <= 0 or jm <= 0 or km <= 0:
3795 raise ValueError(
3796 f"Invalid block dimensions at {source_grid}:{lineno}: ({im}, {jm}, {km}). Must be > 0."
3797 )
3798 dims.append((im, jm, km))
3799
3800 return dims
3801
3802def validate_and_nondimensionalize_picslice(source_slice: str, dest_slice: str, U_ref: float,
3803 expected_dims: tuple = None) -> dict:
3804 """!
3805 @brief Validate a canonical PICSLICE payload and write a solver-scale copy.
3806 @param[in] source_slice Input PICSLICE path.
3807 @param[in] dest_slice Output staged PICSLICE path.
3808 @param[in] U_ref Reference velocity for non-dimensionalization.
3809 @param[in] expected_dims Optional expected (n1, n2) slice dimensions.
3810 @return Summary dictionary with frame_count, dims, value_count, min_speed, max_speed.
3811 @throws ValueError on malformed slice.
3812 """
3813 if U_ref == 0.0:
3814 raise ValueError("velocity_ref must be non-zero when processing PICSLICE speeds.")
3815 if not os.path.isfile(source_slice):
3816 raise ValueError(f"PICSLICE file not found: {source_slice}")
3817
3818 with open(source_slice, "r") as fin:
3819 line_iter = _iter_nonempty_noncomment_lines(fin)
3820 try:
3821 _, first_token = next(line_iter)
3822 except StopIteration:
3823 raise ValueError(f"PICSLICE file '{source_slice}' is empty.")
3824 if first_token != "PICSLICE":
3825 raise ValueError(f"PICSLICE file '{source_slice}' must begin with the canonical PICSLICE header token.")
3826
3827 try:
3828 _, frame_line = next(line_iter)
3829 frame_count = int(frame_line)
3830 except StopIteration:
3831 raise ValueError(f"PICSLICE file '{source_slice}' missing frame count after PICSLICE header.")
3832 except ValueError:
3833 raise ValueError(f"Invalid frame count '{frame_line}' in PICSLICE file '{source_slice}'.")
3834 if frame_count != 1:
3835 raise ValueError(
3836 f"PICSLICE file '{source_slice}' has frame count {frame_count}; Phase 1 supports exactly 1."
3837 )
3838
3839 try:
3840 lineno, dim_line = next(line_iter)
3841 except StopIteration:
3842 raise ValueError(f"PICSLICE file '{source_slice}' missing slice dimensions.")
3843 parts = dim_line.split()
3844 if len(parts) != 2:
3845 raise ValueError(
3846 f"Invalid PICSLICE dimensions at {source_slice}:{lineno}. Expected 2 integers, got: '{dim_line}'."
3847 )
3848 try:
3849 n1, n2 = (int(parts[0]), int(parts[1]))
3850 except ValueError:
3851 raise ValueError(
3852 f"Invalid PICSLICE dimensions at {source_slice}:{lineno}. Non-integer values: '{dim_line}'."
3853 )
3854 if n1 <= 0 or n2 <= 0:
3855 raise ValueError(f"Invalid PICSLICE dimensions at {source_slice}:{lineno}: ({n1}, {n2}). Must be > 0.")
3856 if expected_dims is not None and (n1, n2) != tuple(expected_dims):
3857 raise ValueError(
3858 f"PICSLICE dimension mismatch for '{source_slice}': expected {tuple(expected_dims)}, found {(n1, n2)}."
3859 )
3860
3861 values = []
3862 for lineno, value_line in line_iter:
3863 parts = value_line.split()
3864 if len(parts) != 1:
3865 raise ValueError(
3866 f"Invalid PICSLICE value row at {source_slice}:{lineno}. Expected 1 float, got: '{value_line}'."
3867 )
3868 try:
3869 value = float(parts[0])
3870 except ValueError:
3871 raise ValueError(f"Invalid PICSLICE value at {source_slice}:{lineno}: '{value_line}'.")
3872 if not math.isfinite(value):
3873 raise ValueError(f"PICSLICE value at {source_slice}:{lineno} must be finite.")
3874 if value < 0.0:
3875 raise ValueError(f"PICSLICE value at {source_slice}:{lineno} must be nonnegative.")
3876 values.append(value)
3877
3878 expected_count = n1 * n2
3879 if len(values) != expected_count:
3880 raise ValueError(
3881 f"PICSLICE file '{source_slice}' has {len(values)} values, expected {expected_count} from dimensions {(n1, n2)}."
3882 )
3883
3884 os.makedirs(os.path.dirname(dest_slice), exist_ok=True)
3885 with open(dest_slice, "w") as fout:
3886 fout.write("PICSLICE\n")
3887 fout.write("1\n")
3888 fout.write(f"{n1} {n2}\n")
3889 for value in values:
3890 fout.write(f"{value / U_ref:.8e}\n")
3891
3892 return {
3893 "frame_count": frame_count,
3894 "dims": (n1, n2),
3895 "value_count": len(values),
3896 "min_speed": min(values) if values else 0.0,
3897 "max_speed": max(values) if values else 0.0,
3898 }
3899
3900def _face_artifact_token(face: str) -> str:
3901 """!
3902 @brief Convert a BC face token into a filesystem-friendly artifact token.
3903 @param[in] face Canonical face token such as -Zeta.
3904 @return Filesystem-friendly face token.
3905 """
3906 return face.replace("+", "pos").replace("-", "neg")

3908def _resolve_run_artifact_path(run_dir: str, configured_path: str, default_path: str,
3909 default_to_config_dir: bool = False) -> str:
3910 """!
3911 @brief Resolve a run artifact path with run-dir-relative defaults.
3912 @param[in] run_dir Run/precompute directory root.
3913 @param[in] configured_path Optional user-provided artifact path.
3914 @param[in] default_path Default path relative to run_dir.
3915 @param[in] default_to_config_dir If true, bare relative names are placed under config/.
3916 @return Absolute artifact path.
3917 """
3918 path = configured_path if configured_path else default_path
3919 if not isinstance(path, str) or not path.strip():
3920 raise ValueError("generated profile output_file must be a non-empty path when provided.")
3921 path = path.strip()
3922 if os.path.isabs(path):
3923 return os.path.abspath(path)
3924 if default_to_config_dir and os.path.dirname(path) == "":
3925 path = os.path.join("config", path)
3926 return os.path.abspath(os.path.join(run_dir, path))
3927
3928def _resolve_generator_script(configured_script: str, case_path: str, default_name: str) -> str:
3929 """!
3930 @brief Resolve an optional generator script override or repository default.
3931 @param[in] configured_script Optional absolute or case-relative script path.
3932 @param[in] case_path Current case.yml path used to anchor relative overrides.
3933 @param[in] default_name Repository generator filename under GENERATORS_PATH.
3934 @return Absolute generator script path.
3935 """
3936 if configured_script is None:
3937 return os.path.join(GENERATORS_PATH, default_name)
3938 if not isinstance(configured_script, str) or not configured_script.strip():
3939 raise ValueError(f"Generator script override for {default_name} must be a non-empty path.")
3940 script = configured_script.strip()
3941 if os.path.isabs(script):
3942 return os.path.abspath(script)
3943 case_dir = os.path.dirname(os.path.abspath(case_path)) if case_path else os.getcwd()
3944 return os.path.abspath(os.path.join(case_dir, script))

3946def _normalize_square_duct_poiseuille_params(params, field_name: str) -> dict:
3947 """!
3948 @brief Validate square-duct Poiseuille generator parameters.
3949 @param[in] params Generator params mapping.
3950 @param[in] field_name Human-readable YAML field name for diagnostics.
3951 @return Normalized params.
3952 """
3953 if params is None:
3954 params = {}
3955 if not isinstance(params, dict):
3956 raise ValueError(f"{field_name}.params must be a mapping when provided.")
3957 unknown = sorted(set(params.keys()) - {"bulk_velocity", "n_terms"})
3958 if unknown:
3959 raise ValueError(f"Unknown keys in {field_name}.params: {unknown}. Allowed: ['bulk_velocity', 'n_terms'].")
3960 bulk_velocity = _to_float(params.get("bulk_velocity", 1.0), f"{field_name}.params.bulk_velocity")
3961 if bulk_velocity <= 0.0:
3962 raise ValueError(f"{field_name}.params.bulk_velocity must be positive.")
3963 try:
3964 n_terms = int(params.get("n_terms", 101))
3965 except (TypeError, ValueError):
3966 raise ValueError(f"{field_name}.params.n_terms must be a positive odd integer.")
3967 if n_terms <= 0 or n_terms % 2 == 0:
3968 raise ValueError(f"{field_name}.params.n_terms must be a positive odd integer.")
3969 return {"bulk_velocity": bulk_velocity, "n_terms": n_terms}
3970
3971GENERATED_PROFILE_GENERATORS = {"square_duct_poiseuille"}
