3973def _normalize_field_slice_source(source, field_name: str) -> dict:
3974 """!
3975 @brief Validate a prescribed_flow field_slice source block.
3976 @param[in] source Source mapping from case.yml.
3977 @param[in] field_name Human-readable YAML path for diagnostics.
3978 @return Normalized source mapping.
3979 """
3980 allowed = {
3981 "type",
3982 "script",
3983 "field_file",
3984 "grid_file",
3985 "source_case",
3986 "velocity_scale",
3987 "source_block",
3988 "output_file",
3989 "slice",
3990 }
3991 unknown = sorted(set(source.keys()) - allowed)
3992 if unknown:
3993 raise ValueError(f"Unknown keys in {field_name}: {unknown}. Allowed: {sorted(allowed)}.")
3994 field_file = source.get("field_file")
3995 grid_file = source.get("grid_file")
3996 if not isinstance(field_file, str) or not field_file.strip():
3997 raise ValueError(f"{field_name}.field_file must be a non-empty path.")
3998 if not isinstance(grid_file, str) or not grid_file.strip():
3999 raise ValueError(f"{field_name}.grid_file must be a non-empty path.")
4000 if source.get("source_case") is None and source.get("velocity_scale") is None:
4001 raise ValueError(f"{field_name} requires source_case or velocity_scale.")
4002
4003 normalized = {
4004 "type": "field_slice",
4005 "field_file": field_file.strip(),
4006 "grid_file": grid_file.strip(),
4007 "slice": _normalize_field_slice_selector(source.get("slice"), f"{field_name}.slice"),
4008 }
4009 if source.get("script") is not None:
4010 script = source.get("script")
4011 if not isinstance(script, str) or not script.strip():
4012 raise ValueError(f"{field_name}.script must be a non-empty path when provided.")
4013 normalized["script"] = script.strip()
4014 if source.get("source_case") is not None:
4015 source_case = source.get("source_case")
4016 if not isinstance(source_case, str) or not source_case.strip():
4017 raise ValueError(f"{field_name}.source_case must be a non-empty path when provided.")
4018 normalized["source_case"] = source_case.strip()
4019 if source.get("velocity_scale") is not None:
4020 velocity_scale = _to_float(source.get("velocity_scale"), f"{field_name}.velocity_scale")
4021 if velocity_scale <= 0.0:
4022 raise ValueError(f"{field_name}.velocity_scale must be positive.")
4023 normalized["velocity_scale"] = velocity_scale
4024 if source.get("source_block") is not None:
4025 try:
4026 source_block = int(source.get("source_block"))
4027 except (TypeError, ValueError):
4028 raise ValueError(f"{field_name}.source_block must be a non-negative integer.")
4029 if source_block < 0:
4030 raise ValueError(f"{field_name}.source_block must be a non-negative integer.")
4031 normalized["source_block"] = source_block
4032 if source.get("output_file") is not None:
4033 output_file = source.get("output_file")
4034 if not isinstance(output_file, str) or not output_file.strip():
4035 raise ValueError(f"{field_name}.output_file must be a non-empty path when provided.")
4036 normalized["output_file"] = output_file.strip()
4037 return normalized
4038
4039def _normalize_field_slice_selector(slice_cfg, field_name: str) -> dict:
4040 """!
4041 @brief Validate the field_slice slice selector.
4042 @param[in] slice_cfg Slice selector mapping.
4043 @param[in] field_name Human-readable YAML path for diagnostics.
4044 @return Normalized selector mapping.
4045 """
4046 if not isinstance(slice_cfg, dict):
4047 raise ValueError(f"{field_name} must be a mapping.")
4048 orientation = str(slice_cfg.get("orientation", "opposite")).strip().lower()
4049 if orientation not in {"opposite", "same"}:
4050 raise ValueError(f"{field_name}.orientation must be 'opposite' or 'same'.")
4051 normal_tolerance = _to_float(slice_cfg.get("normal_tolerance", 0.99), f"{field_name}.normal_tolerance")
4052 if normal_tolerance <= 0.0 or normal_tolerance > 1.0:
4053 raise ValueError(f"{field_name}.normal_tolerance must be in the range (0, 1].")
4054
4055 if slice_cfg.get("face") is not None:
4056 unknown = sorted(set(slice_cfg.keys()) - {"face", "orientation", "normal_tolerance"})
4057 if unknown:
4058 raise ValueError(
4059 f"Unknown keys in {field_name}: {unknown}. "
4060 "Use either face or axis/index/normal, plus orientation/normal_tolerance."
4061 )
4062 face = str(slice_cfg.get("face", "")).strip()
4063 if face.lower() not in BC_FACE_MAP:
4064 raise ValueError(f"{field_name}.face must be one of {sorted(BC_FACE_MAP.values())}.")
4065 return {
4066 "face": BC_FACE_MAP[face.lower()],
4067 "orientation": orientation,
4068 "normal_tolerance": normal_tolerance,
4069 }
4070
4071 required = {"axis", "index", "normal"}
4072 missing = sorted(key for key in required if slice_cfg.get(key) is None)
4073 if missing:
4074 raise ValueError(f"{field_name} requires either face or axis/index/normal; missing {missing}.")
4075 unknown = sorted(set(slice_cfg.keys()) - {"axis", "index", "normal", "orientation", "normal_tolerance"})
4076 if unknown:
4077 raise ValueError(
4078 f"Unknown keys in {field_name}: {unknown}. "
4079 "Use either face or axis/index/normal, plus orientation/normal_tolerance."
4080 )
4081 axis = str(slice_cfg.get("axis", "")).strip()
4082 axis_map = {"xi": "Xi", "eta": "Eta", "zeta": "Zeta"}
4083 if axis.lower() not in axis_map:
4084 raise ValueError(f"{field_name}.axis must be one of Xi, Eta, Zeta.")
4085 normal = str(slice_cfg.get("normal", "")).strip()
4086 if normal.lower() not in BC_FACE_MAP:
4087 raise ValueError(f"{field_name}.normal must be one of {sorted(BC_FACE_MAP.values())}.")
4088 normal = BC_FACE_MAP[normal.lower()]
4089 if normal[1:].lower() != axis.lower():
4090 raise ValueError(f"{field_name}.normal must use the same axis as {field_name}.axis.")
4091 try:
4092 index = int(slice_cfg.get("index"))
4093 except (TypeError, ValueError):
4094 raise ValueError(f"{field_name}.index must be an integer.")
4095 if index < 0:
4096 raise ValueError(f"{field_name}.index must be non-negative.")
4097 return {
4098 "axis": axis_map[axis.lower()],
4099 "index": index,
4100 "normal": normal,
4101 "orientation": orientation,
4102 "normal_tolerance": normal_tolerance,
4103 }
4104
4105def generate_square_duct_poiseuille_picslice(output_path: str, dims: tuple, params: dict,
4106 target_grid: str = None, target_block: int = 0,
4107 target_face: str = None, script: str = None,
4108 case_path: str = None) -> dict:
4109 """!
4110 @brief Generate a dimensional canonical PICSLICE for square-duct Poiseuille flow.
4111 @param[in] output_path Path to write.
4112 @param[in] dims PICSLICE dimensions in face storage order (n1, n2).
4113 @param[in] params Normalized generator params.
4114 @param[in] target_grid Optional canonical target PICGRID for grid-aware sampling.
4115 @param[in] target_block Target block index when `target_grid` is provided.
4116 @param[in] target_face Target inlet face when `target_grid` is provided.
4117 @param[in] script Optional profile.gen-compatible script override.
4118 @param[in] case_path Current case.yml path used to anchor relative script overrides.
4119 @return Summary dictionary.
4120 """
4121 n1, n2 = tuple(dims)
4122 profilegen_script = _resolve_generator_script(script, case_path, "profile.gen")
4123 if not os.path.isfile(profilegen_script):
4124 raise ValueError(f"profile.gen script not found: {profilegen_script}")
4125 cmd = [
4126 sys.executable,
4127 profilegen_script,
4128 "square_duct_poiseuille",
4129 "--output",
4130 output_path,
4131 "--dims",
4132 str(n1),
4133 str(n2),
4134 "--bulk-velocity",
4135 str(float(params["bulk_velocity"])),
4136 "--n-terms",
4137 str(int(params["n_terms"])),
4138 ]
4139 if target_grid:
4140 cmd.extend([
4141 "--target-grid",
4142 target_grid,
4143 "--target-block",
4144 str(int(target_block)),
4145 f"--target-face={target_face}",
4146 ])
4147 result = subprocess.run(cmd, text=True, capture_output=True)
4148 if result.returncode != 0:
4149 details = (result.stderr or result.stdout or "").strip()
4150 raise ValueError(f"profile.gen failed with exit code {result.returncode}. Details:\n{details}")
4151 try:
4152 summary = json.loads((result.stdout or "").strip().splitlines()[-1])
4153 except (IndexError, json.JSONDecodeError) as exc:
4154 raise ValueError(f"profile.gen did not emit valid JSON summary. Output:\n{result.stdout}") from exc
4155 summary["dims"] = tuple(summary["dims"])
4156 return summary
4157
4158def generate_field_slice_picslice(output_path: str, expected_dims: tuple, source: dict,
4159 target_grid: str, target_face: str, target_block: int,
4160 case_path: str) -> dict:
4161 """!
4162 @brief Invoke profile.gen to extract a field_slice PICSLICE artifact.
4163 @param[in] output_path Path to write.
4164 @param[in] expected_dims Expected PICSLICE dimensions.
4165 @param[in] source Normalized field_slice source mapping.
4166 @param[in] target_grid Target canonical PICGRID path.
4167 @param[in] target_face Target inlet face token.
4168 @param[in] target_block Target block index.
4169 @param[in] case_path Path to current case.yml for relative source resolution.
4170 @return Summary dictionary from profile.gen.
4171 """
4172 case_dir = os.path.dirname(os.path.abspath(case_path)) if case_path else os.getcwd()
4173 field_file = _resolve_case_relative_path(source["field_file"], case_dir)
4174 source_grid = _resolve_case_relative_path(source["grid_file"], case_dir)
4175 velocity_scale = _resolve_field_slice_velocity_scale(source, case_dir)
4176 profilegen_script = _resolve_generator_script(source.get("script"), case_path, "profile.gen")
4177 if not os.path.isfile(profilegen_script):
4178 raise ValueError(f"profile.gen script not found: {profilegen_script}")
4179 n1, n2 = tuple(expected_dims)
4180 slice_cfg = source["slice"]
4181 cmd = [
4182 sys.executable,
4183 profilegen_script,
4184 "field-slice",
4185 "--output",
4186 output_path,
4187 "--field-file",
4188 field_file,
4189 "--source-grid",
4190 source_grid,
4191 "--target-grid",
4192 target_grid,
4193 "--source-block",
4194 str(int(source.get("source_block", 0))),
4195 "--target-block",
4196 str(int(target_block)),
4197 f"--target-face={target_face}",
4198 "--orientation",
4199 slice_cfg["orientation"],
4200 "--normal-tolerance",
4201 str(float(slice_cfg["normal_tolerance"])),
4202 "--velocity-scale",
4203 str(float(velocity_scale)),
4204 "--expected-dims",
4205 str(n1),
4206 str(n2),
4207 ]
4208 if "face" in slice_cfg:
4209 cmd.append(f"--slice-face={slice_cfg['face']}")
4210 else:
4211 cmd.extend([
4212 "--slice-axis",
4213 slice_cfg["axis"],
4214 "--slice-index",
4215 str(int(slice_cfg["index"])),
4216 f"--slice-normal={slice_cfg['normal']}",
4217 ])
4218 result = subprocess.run(cmd, text=True, capture_output=True)
4219 if result.returncode != 0:
4220 details = (result.stderr or result.stdout or "").strip()
4221 raise ValueError(f"profile.gen field-slice failed with exit code {result.returncode}. Details:\n{details}")
4222 try:
4223 summary = json.loads((result.stdout or "").strip().splitlines()[-1])
4224 except (IndexError, json.JSONDecodeError) as exc:
4225 raise ValueError(f"profile.gen field-slice did not emit valid JSON summary. Output:\n{result.stdout}") from exc
4226 summary["dims"] = tuple(summary["dims"])
4227 return summary
4228
4229def _resolve_case_relative_path(path_value: str, case_dir: str) -> str:
4230 """!
4231 @brief Resolve a path relative to the current case directory.
4232 @param[in] path_value Path from case.yml.
4233 @param[in] case_dir Current case directory.
4234 @return Absolute path.
4235 """
4236 if not isinstance(path_value, str) or not path_value.strip():
4237 raise ValueError("path value must be a non-empty string.")
4238 if os.path.isabs(path_value):
4239 return os.path.abspath(path_value)
4240 return os.path.abspath(os.path.join(case_dir, path_value))

4242def _resolve_field_slice_velocity_scale(source: dict, case_dir: str) -> float:
4243 """!
4244 @brief Resolve field_slice dimensional velocity scale.
4245 @param[in] source Normalized field_slice source mapping.
4246 @param[in] case_dir Current case directory.
4247 @return Positive velocity scale.
4248 """
4249 if source.get("velocity_scale") is not None:
4250 return float(source["velocity_scale"])
4251 source_case = _resolve_case_relative_path(source["source_case"], case_dir)
4252 source_case_cfg = read_yaml_file(source_case)
4253 try:
4254 velocity_scale = _to_float(
4255 source_case_cfg.get("properties", {}).get("scaling", {}).get("velocity_ref"),
4256 "source_case.properties.scaling.velocity_ref",
4257 )
4258 except AttributeError as exc:
4259 raise ValueError("source_case must contain properties.scaling.velocity_ref.") from exc
4260 if velocity_scale <= 0.0:
4261 raise ValueError("source_case.properties.scaling.velocity_ref must be positive.")
4262 return velocity_scale

4264def resolve_target_grid_for_field_slice(case_cfg: dict, case_path: str, run_dir: str) -> str:
4265 """!
4266 @brief Resolve the target canonical PICGRID path needed for field_slice normals.
4267 @param[in] case_cfg Parsed current case config.
4268 @param[in] case_path Current case.yml path.
4269 @param[in] run_dir Current run/precompute directory.
4270 @return Absolute target PICGRID path.
4271 """
4272 grid_cfg = case_cfg.get("grid", {}) or {}
4273 grid_mode = grid_cfg.get("mode")
4274 case_dir = os.path.dirname(os.path.abspath(case_path)) if case_path else os.getcwd()
4275 if grid_mode == "file":
4276 source_grid = grid_cfg.get("source_file")
4277 if not isinstance(source_grid, str) or not source_grid.strip():
4278 raise ValueError("grid.source_file is required for field_slice target-grid normals.")
4279 source_grid = _resolve_case_relative_path(source_grid, case_dir)
4280 if isinstance(grid_cfg.get("legacy_conversion"), dict) and run_dir:
4281 source_grid = convert_legacy_grid_with_gridgen(case_path, run_dir, grid_cfg, source_grid)
4282 return source_grid
4283 if grid_mode == "grid_gen":
4284 generator = grid_cfg.get("generator", {})
4285 output_file = generator.get("output_file", os.path.join("config", "grid.generated.picgrid"))
4286 candidate = output_file if os.path.isabs(output_file) else os.path.abspath(os.path.join(run_dir, output_file))
4287 if os.path.isfile(candidate):
4288 return candidate
4289 staged = os.path.join(run_dir, "config", "grid.run")
4290 if os.path.isfile(staged):
4291 return staged
4292 raise ValueError("field_slice requires the generated target PICGRID to exist before profile extraction.")
4293 raise ValueError(
4294 f"field_slice requires grid.mode 'file' or 'grid_gen' for target-grid normals; got '{grid_mode}'."
4295 )
4296
4297def resolve_target_grid_for_generated_profile(case_cfg: dict, case_path: str, run_dir: str) -> str:
4298 """!
4299 @brief Resolve an optional target canonical PICGRID for generated profile sampling.
4300 @param[in] case_cfg Parsed current case config.
4301 @param[in] case_path Current case.yml path.
4302 @param[in] run_dir Current run/precompute directory.
4303 @return Absolute target PICGRID path, or None when no canonical grid is available yet.
4304 """
4305 grid_mode = (case_cfg.get("grid", {}) or {}).get("mode")
4306 if grid_mode == "programmatic_c":
4307 return None
4308 return resolve_target_grid_for_field_slice(case_cfg, case_path, run_dir)

4310def write_profile_info(config_dir: str, summaries: list) -> str:
4311 """!
4312 @brief Write a profile.info summary for generated inlet profiles.
4313 @param[in] config_dir Run/precompute config directory.
4314 @param[in] summaries Generated profile summaries.
4315 @return Path to profile.info.
4316 """
4317 info_path = os.path.join(config_dir, "profile.info")
4318 os.makedirs(config_dir, exist_ok=True)
4319 with open(info_path, "w") as fout:
4320 fout.write("# PICurv generated profile summary\n")
4321 fout.write(f"profile_count = {len(summaries)}\n\n")
4322 for idx, summary in enumerate(summaries):
4323 dims = summary.get("dims", (0, 0))
4324 fout.write(f"[profile_{idx}]\n")
4325 fout.write(f"generator = {summary.get('generator')}\n")
4326 fout.write(f"block = {summary.get('block')}\n")
4327 fout.write(f"face = {summary.get('face')}\n")
4328 fout.write(f"dimensions = {dims[0]} {dims[1]}\n")
4329 if summary.get("bulk_velocity") is not None:
4330 fout.write(f"bulk_velocity = {summary.get('bulk_velocity'):.16e}\n")
4331 if summary.get("n_terms") is not None:
4332 fout.write(f"n_terms = {summary.get('n_terms')}\n")
4333 fout.write(f"mean_speed = {summary.get('mean_speed'):.16e}\n")
4334 if "area_mean_speed" in summary:
4335 fout.write(f"area_mean_speed = {summary.get('area_mean_speed'):.16e}\n")
4336 if "discrete_mean_speed" in summary:
4337 fout.write(f"discrete_mean_speed = {summary.get('discrete_mean_speed'):.16e}\n")
4338 fout.write(f"min_speed = {summary.get('min_speed'):.16e}\n")
4339 fout.write(f"max_speed = {summary.get('max_speed'):.16e}\n")
4340 if summary.get("umax_over_ubulk") is not None:
4341 fout.write(f"umax_over_ubulk = {summary.get('umax_over_ubulk'):.16e}\n")
4342 for key in (
4343 "normalization",
4344 "sampling",
4345 "area_weighted_mean_before_normalization",
4346 "area_weighted_mean_after_normalization",
4347 "total_inlet_area",
4348 "face_area_min",
4349 "face_area_max",
4350 "source_field",
4351 "source_grid",
4352 "target_grid",
4353 "source_block",
4354 "target_block",
4355 "target_face",
4356 "source_slice",
4357 "orientation",
4358 "normal_tolerance",
4359 "normal_dot",
4360 "velocity_scale",
4361 ):
4362 if key in summary:
4363 fout.write(f"{key} = {summary.get(key)}\n")
4364 fout.write(f"output_file = {summary.get('path')}\n\n")
4365 return info_path
4366
4367def run_grid_generator(case_path: str, run_dir: str, grid_cfg: dict) -> str:
4368 """!
4369 @brief Runs generators/grid.gen to produce a PICGRID file for this run.
4370 @param[in] case_path Path to case.yml (used for relative path resolution).
4371 @param[in] run_dir Run directory path.
4372 @param[in] grid_cfg The grid config section from case.yml.
4373 @return Absolute path to generated dimensional PICGRID file.
4374 @throws ValueError on invalid config or generator failure.
4375 """
4376 generator = grid_cfg.get("generator", {})
4377 if not isinstance(generator, dict):
4378 raise ValueError("grid.generator must be a mapping when grid.mode is 'grid_gen'.")
4379
4380 case_dir = os.path.dirname(os.path.abspath(case_path))
4381 gridgen_script = generator.get("script", os.path.join(GENERATORS_PATH, "grid.gen"))
4382 if not os.path.isabs(gridgen_script):
4383 gridgen_script = os.path.abspath(os.path.join(case_dir, gridgen_script))
4384 if not os.path.isfile(gridgen_script):
4385 raise ValueError(f"grid.gen script not found: {gridgen_script}")
4386
4387 config_file = generator.get("config_file")
4388 if not config_file:
4389 raise ValueError("grid.generator.config_file is required when grid.mode is 'grid_gen'.")
4390 if not os.path.isabs(config_file):
4391 config_file = os.path.abspath(os.path.join(case_dir, config_file))
4392 if not os.path.isfile(config_file):
4393 raise ValueError(f"grid.generator.config_file not found: {config_file}")
4394
4395 output_file = generator.get("output_file", os.path.join("config", "grid.generated.picgrid"))
4396 if not os.path.isabs(output_file):
4397 output_file = os.path.abspath(os.path.join(run_dir, output_file))
4398 os.makedirs(os.path.dirname(output_file), exist_ok=True)
4399
4400 grid_type = generator.get("grid_type")
4401 cli_args = generator.get("cli_args", [])
4402 if cli_args is None:
4403 cli_args = []
4404 if not isinstance(cli_args, list):
4405 raise ValueError("grid.generator.cli_args must be a list of CLI tokens.")
4406
4407 cmd = [sys.executable, gridgen_script, "-c", config_file]
4408 if grid_type:
4409 cmd.append(str(grid_type))
4410 cmd.extend([str(token) for token in cli_args])
4411 cmd.extend(["--output", output_file])
4412
4413 vts_file = generator.get("vts_file")
4414 if vts_file:
4415 if not os.path.isabs(vts_file):
4416 vts_file = os.path.abspath(os.path.join(run_dir, vts_file))
4417 os.makedirs(os.path.dirname(vts_file), exist_ok=True)
4418 cmd.extend(["--vts", vts_file])
4419
4420 stats_file = generator.get("stats_file")
4421 if stats_file:
4422 if not os.path.isabs(stats_file):
4423 stats_file = os.path.abspath(os.path.join(run_dir, stats_file))
4424 os.makedirs(os.path.dirname(stats_file), exist_ok=True)
4425 cmd.extend(["--stats-file", stats_file])
4426
4427 print(f"[INFO] Grid generator command: {' '.join(cmd)}")
4428 result = subprocess.run(cmd, cwd=case_dir, text=True, capture_output=True)
4429 if result.returncode != 0:
4430 stderr = (result.stderr or "").strip()
4431 stdout = (result.stdout or "").strip()
4432 details = stderr if stderr else stdout
4433 raise ValueError(
4434 f"grid.gen failed with exit code {result.returncode}. Details:\n{details}"
4435 )
4436 if result.stdout:
4437 print(result.stdout.strip())
4438 if result.stderr:
4439 print(result.stderr.strip())
4440
4441 if not os.path.isfile(output_file):
4442 raise ValueError(f"grid.gen did not produce expected output file: {output_file}")
4443
4444 return output_file

4447def convert_legacy_grid_with_gridgen(case_path: str, run_dir: str, grid_cfg: dict, source_grid: str) -> str:
4448 """!
4449 @brief Optionally convert a legacy file-grid payload to canonical PICGRID using grid.gen.
4450 @details Activated only when `grid.legacy_conversion.enabled` is true in case.yml.
4451 The converted output remains dimensional; standard nondimensionalization still
4452 occurs via validate_and_nondimensionalize_picgrid().
4453 @param[in] case_path Path to case.yml (for relative path resolution).
4454 @param[in] run_dir Current run directory.
4455 @param[in] grid_cfg Grid section from case.yml.
4456 @param[in] source_grid Absolute or relative path to the original grid file.
4457 @return Grid path that should be fed into validate_and_nondimensionalize_picgrid().
4458 @throws ValueError on invalid converter settings or failed conversion.
4459 """
4460 legacy_cfg = grid_cfg.get("legacy_conversion")
4461 if not isinstance(legacy_cfg, dict):
4462 return source_grid
4463
4464 enabled = legacy_cfg.get("enabled", True)
4465 if enabled is False:
4466 return source_grid
4467 if not isinstance(enabled, bool):
4468 raise ValueError("grid.legacy_conversion.enabled must be a boolean.")
4469
4470 raw_format = str(legacy_cfg.get("format", "legacy1d")).strip().lower()
4471 format_aliases = {
4472 "legacy1d": "legacy1d",
4473 "legacy_1d": "legacy1d",
4474 "les_flat_1d": "legacy1d",
4475 "les-flat-1d": "legacy1d",
4476 }
4477 command = format_aliases.get(raw_format)
4478 if command is None:
4479 raise ValueError(
4480 "grid.legacy_conversion.format must be one of "
4481 "['legacy1d', 'legacy_1d', 'les_flat_1d', 'les-flat-1d']."
4482 )
4483
4484 case_dir = os.path.dirname(os.path.abspath(case_path))
4485 gridgen_script = legacy_cfg.get("script", os.path.join(GENERATORS_PATH, "grid.gen"))
4486 if not isinstance(gridgen_script, str) or not gridgen_script.strip():
4487 raise ValueError("grid.legacy_conversion.script must be a non-empty string when provided.")
4488 if not os.path.isabs(gridgen_script):
4489 gridgen_script = os.path.abspath(os.path.join(case_dir, gridgen_script))
4490 if not os.path.isfile(gridgen_script):
4491 raise ValueError(f"grid.legacy_conversion.script not found: {gridgen_script}")
4492
4493 output_file = legacy_cfg.get("output_file", os.path.join("config", "grid.converted.picgrid"))
4494 if not isinstance(output_file, str) or not output_file.strip():
4495 raise ValueError("grid.legacy_conversion.output_file must be a non-empty string when provided.")
4496 if not os.path.isabs(output_file):
4497 output_file = os.path.abspath(os.path.join(run_dir, output_file))
4498 os.makedirs(os.path.dirname(output_file), exist_ok=True)
4499
4500 axis_columns = legacy_cfg.get("axis_columns", [0, 1, 2])
4501 if not isinstance(axis_columns, list) or len(axis_columns) != 3:
4502 raise ValueError("grid.legacy_conversion.axis_columns must be a 3-item list of non-negative integers.")
4503 try:
4504 axis_columns = [int(v) for v in axis_columns]
4505 except (TypeError, ValueError) as exc:
4506 raise ValueError("grid.legacy_conversion.axis_columns must contain integers.") from exc
4507 if any(v < 0 for v in axis_columns):
4508 raise ValueError("grid.legacy_conversion.axis_columns values must be >= 0.")
4509
4510 strict_trailing = legacy_cfg.get("strict_trailing", True)
4511 if not isinstance(strict_trailing, bool):
4512 raise ValueError("grid.legacy_conversion.strict_trailing must be a boolean.")
4513
4514 cli_args = legacy_cfg.get("cli_args", [])
4515 if cli_args is None:
4516 cli_args = []
4517 if not isinstance(cli_args, list):
4518 raise ValueError("grid.legacy_conversion.cli_args must be a list of CLI tokens.")
4519
4520 cmd = [
4521 sys.executable,
4522 gridgen_script,
4523 command,
4524 "--input",
4525 source_grid,
4526 "--output",
4527 output_file,
4528 "--axis-columns",
4529 str(axis_columns[0]),
4530 str(axis_columns[1]),
4531 str(axis_columns[2]),
4532 "--no-write-vtk",
4533 ]
4534 if strict_trailing:
4535 cmd.append("--strict-trailing")
4536 else:
4537 cmd.append("--allow-trailing")
4538 cmd.extend(str(token) for token in cli_args)
4539
4540 print(f"[INFO] Legacy grid conversion command: {' '.join(cmd)}")
4541 result = subprocess.run(cmd, cwd=case_dir, text=True, capture_output=True)
4542 if result.returncode != 0:
4543 stderr = (result.stderr or "").strip()
4544 stdout = (result.stdout or "").strip()
4545 details = stderr if stderr else stdout
4546 raise ValueError(
4547 f"legacy grid conversion failed with exit code {result.returncode}. Details:\n{details}"
4548 )
4549 if result.stdout:
4550 print(result.stdout.strip())
4551 if result.stderr:
4552 print(result.stderr.strip())
4553 if not os.path.isfile(output_file):
4554 raise ValueError(f"legacy grid conversion did not produce expected output file: {output_file}")
4555
4556 return output_file

4618def _normalize_prescribed_flow_source(source, field_name: str) -> dict:
4619 """!
4620 @brief Validate the structured source block for prescribed_flow BCs.
4621 @param[in] source Source mapping from case.yml.
4622 @param[in] field_name Human-readable YAML path for diagnostics.
4623 @return Normalized source mapping.
4624 @throws ValueError on invalid source contract.
4625 """
4626 if not isinstance(source, dict):
4627 raise ValueError(f"{field_name} must be a mapping with type: file, generated, or field_slice.")
4628 source_type = str(source.get("type", "")).strip().lower()
4629 if source_type == "file":
4630 path = source.get("path")
4631 if not isinstance(path, str) or not path.strip():
4632 raise ValueError(f"{field_name}.path must be a non-empty file path.")
4633 unknown = sorted(set(source.keys()) - {"type", "path"})
4634 if unknown:
4635 raise ValueError(f"Unknown keys in {field_name}: {unknown}. Allowed: ['path', 'type'].")
4636 return {"type": "file", "path": path.strip()}
4637
4638 if source_type == "generated":
4639 generator = str(source.get("generator", "")).strip().lower()
4640 if generator not in GENERATED_PROFILE_GENERATORS:
4641 raise ValueError(
4642 f"{field_name}.generator must be one of {sorted(GENERATED_PROFILE_GENERATORS)} "
4643 f"(got '{source.get('generator')}')."
4644 )
4645 unknown = sorted(set(source.keys()) - {"type", "generator", "script", "output_file", "params"})
4646 if unknown:
4647 raise ValueError(
4648 f"Unknown keys in {field_name}: {unknown}. "
4649 "Allowed: ['generator', 'output_file', 'params', 'script', 'type']."
4650 )
4651 normalized = {
4652 "type": "generated",
4653 "generator": generator,
4654 "params": _normalize_square_duct_poiseuille_params(source.get("params", {}), field_name),
4655 }
4656 output_file = source.get("output_file")
4657 if output_file is not None:
4658 if not isinstance(output_file, str) or not output_file.strip():
4659 raise ValueError(f"{field_name}.output_file must be a non-empty path when provided.")
4660 normalized["output_file"] = output_file.strip()
4661 script = source.get("script")
4662 if script is not None:
4663 if not isinstance(script, str) or not script.strip():
4664 raise ValueError(f"{field_name}.script must be a non-empty path when provided.")
4665 normalized["script"] = script.strip()
4666 return normalized
4667
4668 if source_type == "field_slice":
4669 return _normalize_field_slice_source(source, field_name)
4670
4671 raise ValueError(f"{field_name}.type must be 'file', 'generated', or 'field_slice'.")
4672
4673def _bc_profile_expected_dims(face: str, block_dims: tuple) -> tuple:
4674 """!
4675 @brief Return expected PICSLICE dimensions for a face and block node dimensions.
4676 @param[in] face Canonical BC face token.
4677 @param[in] block_dims (IM, JM, KM) node counts.
4678 @return (n1, n2) dimensions in profile storage order.
4679 """
4680 im, jm, km = block_dims
4681 if min(im, jm, km) < 2:
4682 raise ValueError(
4683 f"Block dimensions {block_dims} are too small for an inlet profile; each axis needs at least 2 nodes."
4684 )
4685 if face in {"-Xi", "+Xi"}:
4686 return (km - 1, jm - 1)
4687 if face in {"-Eta", "+Eta"}:
4688 return (km - 1, im - 1)
4689 if face in {"-Zeta", "+Zeta"}:
4690 return (jm - 1, im - 1)
4691 raise ValueError(f"Unsupported face '{face}' for prescribed_flow profile dimensions.")
4692
4693def resolve_grid_block_dimensions_for_profiles(case_cfg: dict, case_path: str, run_dir: str = None) -> list:
4694 """!
4695 @brief Resolve per-block node dimensions for prescribed inlet profile validation.
4696 @param[in] case_cfg Parsed case.yml configuration.
4697 @param[in] case_path Path to case.yml for relative path resolution.
4698 @param[in] run_dir Current run directory, used for optional generated grid outputs.
4699 @return List of (IM, JM, KM) node-count tuples.
4700 @throws ValueError when dimensions cannot be resolved.
4701 """
4702 num_blocks = int(case_cfg.get('models', {}).get('domain', {}).get('blocks', 1))
4703 grid_cfg = case_cfg.get("grid", {})
4704 grid_mode = grid_cfg.get("mode")
4705 case_dir = os.path.dirname(os.path.abspath(case_path)) if case_path else os.getcwd()
4706
4707 if grid_mode == "programmatic_c":
4708 settings = grid_cfg.get("programmatic_settings", {})
4709 dims_by_axis = []
4710 for key in ("im", "jm", "km"):
4711 raw = settings.get(key)
4712 if raw is None:
4713 raise ValueError(f"grid.programmatic_settings.{key} is required for prescribed_flow profiles.")
4714 if isinstance(raw, list):
4715 if len(raw) != num_blocks:
4716 raise ValueError(
4717 f"grid.programmatic_settings.{key} has {len(raw)} entries, expected {num_blocks} blocks."
4718 )
4719 values = raw
4720 else:
4721 values = [raw] * num_blocks
4722 try:
4723 values = [int(v) + 1 for v in values]
4724 except (TypeError, ValueError):
4725 raise ValueError(f"grid.programmatic_settings.{key} values must be positive integer cell counts.")
4726 if any(v <= 1 for v in values):
4727 raise ValueError(f"grid.programmatic_settings.{key} values must be positive integer cell counts.")
4728 dims_by_axis.append(values)
4729 return list(zip(dims_by_axis[0], dims_by_axis[1], dims_by_axis[2]))
4730
4731 if grid_mode == "file":
4732 source_grid = grid_cfg.get("source_file")
4733 if not isinstance(source_grid, str) or not source_grid.strip():
4734 raise ValueError("grid.source_file is required for file-grid prescribed_flow profile validation.")
4735 if not os.path.isabs(source_grid):
4736 source_grid = os.path.abspath(os.path.join(case_dir, source_grid))
4737 if isinstance(grid_cfg.get("legacy_conversion"), dict) and run_dir:
4738 source_grid = convert_legacy_grid_with_gridgen(case_path, run_dir, grid_cfg, source_grid)
4739 return read_picgrid_header_dimensions(source_grid, expected_nblk=num_blocks)
4740
4741 if grid_mode == "grid_gen":
4742 generator = grid_cfg.get("generator", {})
4743 output_file = generator.get("output_file", os.path.join("config", "grid.generated.picgrid"))
4744 candidates = []
4745 if run_dir:
4746 candidates.append(output_file if os.path.isabs(output_file) else os.path.abspath(os.path.join(run_dir, output_file)))
4747 candidates.append(os.path.join(run_dir, "config", "grid.run"))
4748 for candidate in candidates:
4749 if os.path.isfile(candidate):
4750 return read_picgrid_header_dimensions(candidate, expected_nblk=num_blocks)
4751 raise ValueError(
4752 "prescribed_flow profile dimension validation for grid.mode='grid_gen' requires an existing generated "
4753 "PICGRID output. Run or stage the grid first, or use grid.mode='file' with the generated .picgrid."
4754 )
4755
4756 raise ValueError(f"Unsupported grid.mode '{grid_mode}' for prescribed_flow profile validation.")
4757
4758def materialize_generated_prescribed_flow_profiles(run_dir: str, case_cfg: dict, case_path: str,
4759 profile_grid_dims: list = None) -> list:
4760 """!
4761 @brief Generate dimensional PICSLICE artifacts for generated/field_slice prescribed_flow sources.
4762 @param[in] run_dir Run/precompute directory root.
4763 @param[in] case_cfg Parsed case.yml.
4764 @param[in] case_path Path to case.yml for relative grid/source resolution.
4765 @param[in] profile_grid_dims Optional pre-resolved block node dimensions.
4766 @return List of generated profile summaries.
4767 """
4768 prepared_blocks = validate_and_prepare_boundary_conditions(case_cfg)
4769 if not any(
4770 bc.get("handler") == "prescribed_flow"
4771 and ((bc.get("params") or {}).get("source") or {}).get("type") in {"generated", "field_slice"}
4772 for block in prepared_blocks for bc in block
4773 ):
4774 return []
4775 if profile_grid_dims is None:
4776 profile_grid_dims = resolve_grid_block_dimensions_for_profiles(case_cfg, case_path, run_dir)
4777
4778 config_dir = os.path.join(run_dir, "config")
4779 target_grid = None
4780 generated_target_grid = None
4781 summaries = []
4782 for block_idx, block in enumerate(prepared_blocks):
4783 for bc in block:
4784 if bc.get("handler") != "prescribed_flow":
4785 continue
4786 source = (bc.get("params") or {}).get("source", {})
4787 if source.get("type") not in {"generated", "field_slice"}:
4788 continue
4789 face = bc["face"]
4790 dims = _bc_profile_expected_dims(face, profile_grid_dims[block_idx])
4791 face_token = _face_artifact_token(face)
4792 suffix = "generated" if source.get("type") == "generated" else "sliced"
4793 default_output = os.path.join(
4794 "config", f"inlet_profile_block{block_idx}_{face_token}.{suffix}.picslice"
4795 )
4796 output_path = _resolve_run_artifact_path(
4797 run_dir,
4798 source.get("output_file"),
4799 default_output,
4800 default_to_config_dir=True,
4801 )
4802 if source.get("type") == "generated" and source["generator"] == "square_duct_poiseuille":
4803 if generated_target_grid is None:
4804 generated_target_grid = resolve_target_grid_for_generated_profile(case_cfg, case_path, run_dir)
4805 summary = generate_square_duct_poiseuille_picslice(
4806 output_path,
4807 dims,
4808 source["params"],
4809 target_grid=generated_target_grid,
4810 target_block=block_idx,
4811 target_face=face,
4812 script=source.get("script"),
4813 case_path=case_path,
4814 )
4815 elif source.get("type") == "generated":
4816 raise ValueError(f"Unsupported generated profile generator '{source['generator']}'.")
4817 else:
4818 if target_grid is None:
4819 target_grid = resolve_target_grid_for_field_slice(case_cfg, case_path, run_dir)
4820 summary = generate_field_slice_picslice(
4821 output_path,
4822 dims,
4823 source,
4824 target_grid,
4825 face,
4826 block_idx,
4827 case_path,
4828 )
4829 summary.update({"block": block_idx, "face": face})
4830 summaries.append(summary)
4831 print(
4832 f"[SUCCESS] Materialized prescribed_flow profile for block {block_idx}, face {face}: "
4833 f"{os.path.relpath(output_path)} dims={summary['dims']}"
4834 )
4835
4836 if summaries:
4837 info_path = write_profile_info(config_dir, summaries)
4838 print(f"[SUCCESS] Wrote generated profile summary: {os.path.relpath(info_path)}")
4839 return summaries
4840
4841def _to_float(value, field_name: str) -> float:
4842 """!
4843 @brief Convert a YAML scalar to float with a clear error message.
4844 @param[in] value Argument passed to `_to_float()`.
4845 @param[in] field_name Argument passed to `_to_float()`.
4846 @return Value returned by `_to_float()`.
4847 """
4848 try:
4849 return float(value)
4850 except (TypeError, ValueError):
4851 raise ValueError(f"'{field_name}' must be numeric (got {value!r}).")
4852
4853
4854def _to_finite_float(value, field_name: str) -> float:
4855 """!
4856 @brief Convert a non-boolean YAML scalar to a finite float.
4857 @param[in] value Raw YAML scalar.
4858 @param[in] field_name User-facing configuration path.
4859 @return Finite floating-point value.
4860 """
4861 if isinstance(value, bool):
4862 raise ValueError(f"'{field_name}' must be numeric, not boolean.")
4863 parsed = _to_float(value, field_name)
4864 if not math.isfinite(parsed):
4865 raise ValueError(f"'{field_name}' must be finite (got {value!r}).")
4866 return parsed
4867
4868def _to_bool(value, field_name: str) -> bool:
4869 """!
4870 @brief Convert a YAML scalar/string to bool with a clear error message.
4871 @param[in] value Argument passed to `_to_bool()`.
4872 @param[in] field_name Argument passed to `_to_bool()`.
4873 @return Value returned by `_to_bool()`.
4874 """
4875 if isinstance(value, bool):
4876 return value
4877 if isinstance(value, str):
4878 raw = value.strip().lower()
4879 if raw in {"true", "1", "yes"}:
4880 return True
4881 if raw in {"false", "0", "no"}:
4882 return False
4883 raise ValueError(f"'{field_name}' must be boolean (got {value!r}).")
4884
4885def normalize_boundary_conditions_layout(all_blocks_bcs, num_blocks: int):
4886 """!
4887 @brief Normalize boundary_conditions to list-of-lists form and validate block count.
4888 @param[in] all_blocks_bcs Argument passed to `normalize_boundary_conditions_layout()`.
4889 @param[in] num_blocks Argument passed to `normalize_boundary_conditions_layout()`.
4890 @return Value returned by `normalize_boundary_conditions_layout()`.
4891 """
4892 if not all_blocks_bcs:
4893 raise ValueError("The 'boundary_conditions' section in case.yml is empty.")
4894
4895 is_simple_list = isinstance(all_blocks_bcs[0], dict)
4896 if num_blocks == 1 and is_simple_list:
4897 all_blocks_bcs = [all_blocks_bcs]
4898 elif is_simple_list and num_blocks > 1:
4899 raise ValueError(
4900 f"case.yml declares {num_blocks} blocks but boundary_conditions is a single face-list. "
4901 "Use a list-of-lists, one inner list per block."
4902 )
4903
4904 if len(all_blocks_bcs) != num_blocks:
4905 raise ValueError(
4906 f"Mismatch: case.yml declares {num_blocks} block(s) but found {len(all_blocks_bcs)} BC definitions."
4907 )
4908 return all_blocks_bcs
4909
4910def validate_and_prepare_boundary_conditions(case_cfg: dict):
4911 """!
4912 @brief Validate BC entries against currently supported C-side handlers/types and
4913 @details return normalized entries ready for bcs.run generation.
4914 @param[in] case_cfg Argument passed to `validate_and_prepare_boundary_conditions()`.
4915 @return Value returned by `validate_and_prepare_boundary_conditions()`.
4916 """
4917 num_blocks = int(case_cfg.get('models', {}).get('domain', {}).get('blocks', 1))
4918 scales = case_cfg.get('properties', {}).get('scaling', {})
4919 L_ref = _to_float(scales.get('length_ref'), "properties.scaling.length_ref")
4920 U_ref = _to_float(scales.get('velocity_ref'), "properties.scaling.velocity_ref")
4921 if U_ref == 0.0:
4922 raise ValueError("properties.scaling.velocity_ref must be non-zero for non-dimensionalization.")
4923 if L_ref == 0.0:
4924 raise ValueError("properties.scaling.length_ref must be non-zero for non-dimensionalization.")
4925
4926 all_blocks_bcs = normalize_boundary_conditions_layout(case_cfg.get('boundary_conditions', []), num_blocks)
4927 prepared_blocks = []
4928
4929 expected_faces = {"-Xi", "+Xi", "-Eta", "+Eta", "-Zeta", "+Zeta"}
4930 axis_pairs = [("-Xi", "+Xi"), ("-Eta", "+Eta"), ("-Zeta", "+Zeta")]
4931
4932 for bi, block_bcs in enumerate(all_blocks_bcs):
4933 if not isinstance(block_bcs, list):
4934 raise ValueError(f"boundary_conditions[{bi}] must be a list of face configs.")
4935
4936 prepared_block = []
4937 seen_faces = {}
4938
4939 for idx, bc in enumerate(block_bcs):
4940 if not isinstance(bc, dict):
4941 raise ValueError(f"boundary_conditions[{bi}][{idx}] must be a mapping.")
4942
4943 for req in ("face", "type", "handler"):
4944 if req not in bc:
4945 raise ValueError(f"boundary_conditions[{bi}][{idx}] missing required key '{req}'.")
4946
4947 face_raw = str(bc["face"]).strip()
4948 face_key = face_raw.lower()
4949 face = BC_FACE_MAP.get(face_key)
4950 if face is None:
4951 raise ValueError(
4952 f"Unsupported BC face '{face_raw}' at boundary_conditions[{bi}][{idx}]. "
4953 f"Supported: {sorted(expected_faces)}."
4954 )
4955 if face in seen_faces:
4956 raise ValueError(f"Duplicate face '{face}' in boundary_conditions[{bi}] (entries {seen_faces[face]} and {idx}).")
4957 seen_faces[face] = idx
4958
4959 bc_type_raw = str(bc["type"]).strip()
4960 bc_type = BC_TYPE_MAP.get(bc_type_raw.lower())
4961 if bc_type is None:
4962 raise ValueError(
4963 f"Unsupported BC type '{bc_type_raw}' for face {face} in block {bi}. "
4964 f"Supported: {sorted(set(BC_TYPE_MAP.values()))}."
4965 )
4966
4967 handler = str(bc["handler"]).strip().lower()
4968 handler_spec = BC_HANDLER_SPECS.get(handler)
4969 if handler_spec is None:
4970 raise ValueError(
4971 f"Unsupported BC handler '{bc['handler']}' for face {face} in block {bi}. "
4972 f"Supported now: {sorted(BC_HANDLER_SPECS.keys())}."
4973 )
4974 if bc_type not in handler_spec["types"]:
4975 raise ValueError(
4976 f"Invalid BC combination on block {bi}, face {face}: type '{bc_type}' cannot use handler '{handler}'."
4977 )
4978
4979 params = bc.get("params", {})
4980 if params is None:
4981 params = {}
4982 if not isinstance(params, dict):
4983 raise ValueError(f"'params' for block {bi}, face {face} must be a mapping.")
4984
4985 # Reject unsupported older structured keys explicitly.
4986 if "vector" in params or "velocity" in params:
4987 raise ValueError(
4988 f"Unsupported older params key ('vector'/'velocity') found on block {bi}, face {face}. "
4989 "Use scalar keys 'vx', 'vy', 'vz'."
4990 )
4991
4992 required = handler_spec["required_params"]
4993 optional = handler_spec["optional_params"]
4994 allowed = required | optional
4995
4996 missing = sorted(required - set(params.keys()))
4997 if missing:
4998 raise ValueError(
4999 f"Missing required params for handler '{handler}' on block {bi}, face {face}: {missing}."
5000 )
5001 unknown = sorted(set(params.keys()) - allowed)
5002 if unknown:
5003 raise ValueError(
5004 f"Unknown params for handler '{handler}' on block {bi}, face {face}: {unknown}. "
5005 f"Allowed: {sorted(allowed)}."
5006 )
5007
5008 converted_params = {}
5009 for key, value in params.items():
5010 if key in _NUMERIC_BC_PARAMS:
5011 numeric = _to_float(value, f"boundary_conditions[{bi}][{idx}].params.{key}")
5012 if key in {"vx", "vy", "vz", "v_max"}:
5013 converted_params[key] = numeric / U_ref
5014 elif key == "target_flux":
5015 converted_params[key] = numeric / (U_ref * (L_ref ** 2))
5016 elif key in _BOOL_BC_PARAMS:
5017 converted_params[key] = _to_bool(value, f"boundary_conditions[{bi}][{idx}].params.{key}")
5018 elif handler == "prescribed_flow" and key == "source":
5019 converted_params[key] = _normalize_prescribed_flow_source(
5020 value, f"boundary_conditions[{bi}][{idx}].params.source"
5021 )
5022 else:
5023 # Defensive fallback; should not happen due unknown-key gate above.
5024 converted_params[key] = value
5025
5026 prepared_block.append({
5027 "face": face,
5028 "type": bc_type,
5029 "handler": handler,
5030 "params": converted_params,
5031 })
5032
5033 missing_faces = sorted(expected_faces - set(seen_faces.keys()))
5034 if missing_faces:
5035 raise ValueError(
5036 f"boundary_conditions[{bi}] is incomplete. Missing faces: {missing_faces}. "
5037 "Provide all six faces explicitly."
5038 )
5039
5040 # Pairwise periodic consistency checks.
5041 face_map = {entry["face"]: entry for entry in prepared_block}
5042 for neg_face, pos_face in axis_pairs:
5043 neg = face_map[neg_face]
5044 pos = face_map[pos_face]
5045 neg_periodic = (neg["type"] == "PERIODIC")
5046 pos_periodic = (pos["type"] == "PERIODIC")
5047 if neg_periodic != pos_periodic:
5048 raise ValueError(
5049 f"Inconsistent periodicity in block {bi}: {neg_face} and {pos_face} must both be PERIODIC or neither."
5050 )
5051
5052 driven_handlers = {"constant_flux"}
5053 if (neg["handler"] in driven_handlers) or (pos["handler"] in driven_handlers):
5054 if neg["handler"] != pos["handler"]:
5055 raise ValueError(
5056 f"In block {bi}, driven periodic handlers on {neg_face}/{pos_face} must match exactly."
5057 )
5058 if not (neg_periodic and pos_periodic):
5059 raise ValueError(
5060 f"In block {bi}, driven periodic handler '{neg['handler']}' requires PERIODIC type on both faces."
5061 )
5062
5063 prepared_blocks.append(prepared_block)
5064
5065 return prepared_blocks
5066
5067
5068def _schema_path_text(path: tuple) -> str:
5069 """!
5070 @brief Render an internal schema path tuple as a user-facing YAML path.
5071 @param[in] path Internal path tuple.
5072 @return Dotted YAML path.
5073 """
5074 return ".".join(part for part in path if part != "[]") or "<root>"
5075
5076
5077def _lookup_allowed_schema_keys(schema: dict, path: tuple):
5078 """!
5079 @brief Return allowed keys for a path, honoring '*' dynamic mapping entries.
5080 @param[in] schema Role schema mapping.
5081 @param[in] path Internal path tuple.
5082 @return Allowed key set, None for free-form mappings, or False when path is not schema-checked.
5083 """
5084 if path in schema:
5085 return schema[path]
5086 for idx, part in enumerate(path):
5087 if part == "[]":
5088 continue
5089 candidate = path[:idx] + ("*",) + path[idx + 1:]
5090 if candidate in schema:
5091 return schema[candidate]
5092 return False
5093
5094
5095def _schema_key_hint(schema: dict, path: tuple, key: str, allowed: set) -> str:
5096 """!
5097 @brief Build a concise typo or hierarchy hint for an unsupported YAML key.
5098 @param[in] schema Role schema mapping.
5099 @param[in] path Current internal YAML path tuple.
5100 @param[in] key Unsupported YAML key.
5101 @param[in] allowed Allowed keys at the current path.
5102 @return Optional hint string.
5103 """
5104 hints = []
5105 allowed_strings = sorted(str(item) for item in allowed)
5106 lower_matches = [item for item in allowed_strings if item.lower() == key.lower()]
5107 close_matches = lower_matches or difflib.get_close_matches(key, allowed_strings, n=1, cutoff=0.80)
5108 if close_matches:
5109 hints.append(f"Did you mean '{close_matches[0]}'?")
5110
5111 valid_paths = []
5112 for schema_path, schema_allowed in schema.items():
5113 if schema_path == path or not schema_allowed:
5114 continue
5115 if key in schema_allowed:
5116 valid_paths.append(_schema_path_text(schema_path))
5117 if valid_paths:
5118 hints.append(f"This key is valid at: {', '.join(sorted(valid_paths))}.")
5119
5120 return " ".join(hints)
5121
5122
5123def _validate_yaml_schema_keys(cfg, schema: dict, file_path: str, errors: list, path: tuple = ()) -> None:
5124 """!
5125 @brief Reject unsupported YAML keys before they can be silently ignored by staging.
5126 @param[in] cfg Parsed YAML node.
5127 @param[in] schema Role schema mapping.
5128 @param[in] file_path Source file path for diagnostics.
5129 @param[in,out] errors Validation error accumulator.
5130 @param[in] path Current internal YAML path tuple.
5131 """
5132 if isinstance(cfg, dict):
5133 allowed = _lookup_allowed_schema_keys(schema, path)
5134 if allowed is not False and allowed is not None:
5135 unknown = sorted(str(key) for key in cfg.keys() if key not in allowed)
5136 for key in unknown:
5137 hint = _schema_key_hint(schema, path, key, allowed)
5138 hint_text = f" {hint}" if hint else ""
5139 errors.append(
5140 f" {file_path}: unsupported key at {_schema_path_text(path)}: '{key}'. "
5141 f"Allowed keys: {sorted(allowed)}.{hint_text}"
5142 )
5143 if allowed is None:
5144 return
5145 for key, value in cfg.items():
5146 _validate_yaml_schema_keys(value, schema, file_path, errors, path + (key,))
5147 elif isinstance(cfg, list):
5148 for item in cfg:
5149 _validate_yaml_schema_keys(item, schema, file_path, errors, path + ("[]",))
