6990def render_slurm_script(
6991 script_path: str,
6992 job_name: str,
6993 cluster_cfg: dict,
6994 command: list,
6995 workdir: str,
6996 stdout_path: str,
6997 stderr_path: str = None,
6998 env_vars: dict = None,
6999 shell_env_vars: dict = None,
7000 array_spec: str = None,
7001 follow_commands: list = None
7002):
7003 """!
7004 @brief Render a Slurm batch script for a single command.
7005 @param[in] script_path Argument passed to `render_slurm_script()`.
7006 @param[in] job_name Argument passed to `render_slurm_script()`.
7007 @param[in] cluster_cfg Argument passed to `render_slurm_script()`.
7008 @param[in] command Argument passed to `render_slurm_script()`.
7009 @param[in] workdir Argument passed to `render_slurm_script()`.
7010 @param[in] stdout_path Argument passed to `render_slurm_script()`.
7011 @param[in] stderr_path Argument passed to `render_slurm_script()`.
7012 @param[in] env_vars Argument passed to `render_slurm_script()`.
7013 @param[in] shell_env_vars Argument passed to `render_slurm_script()`.
7014 @param[in] array_spec Argument passed to `render_slurm_script()`.
7015 @param[in] follow_commands Commands to run after the launched one, each an argv
7016 list. They run in the batch shell rather than under the
7017 MPI launcher, so a serial step does not become one copy
7018 per task. Supplying any of them drops the `exec`.
7019 """
7020 resources = cluster_cfg.get("resources", {})
7021 notifications = cluster_cfg.get("notifications", {}) or {}
7022 execution = cluster_cfg.get("execution", {}) or {}
7023 extra_sbatch = execution.get("extra_sbatch")
7024 module_setup = execution.get("module_setup", []) or []
7025
7026 if stderr_path is None:
7027 stderr_path = stdout_path.replace(".out", ".err")
7028
7029 lines = [
7030 "#!/bin/bash",
7031 f"#SBATCH --job-name={job_name}",
7032 f"#SBATCH --nodes={resources['nodes']}",
7033 f"#SBATCH --ntasks-per-node={resources['ntasks_per_node']}",
7034 f"#SBATCH --mem={resources['mem']}",
7035 f"#SBATCH --time={resources['time']}",
7036 f"#SBATCH --output={stdout_path}",
7037 f"#SBATCH --error={stderr_path}",
7038 f"#SBATCH --account={resources['account']}",
7039 ]
7040 partition = resources.get("partition")
7041 if partition:
7042 lines.append(f"#SBATCH --partition={partition}")
7043 if array_spec:
7044 lines.append(f"#SBATCH --array={array_spec}")
7045 mail_user = notifications.get("mail_user")
7046 mail_type = notifications.get("mail_type")
7047 if mail_user:
7048 lines.append(f"#SBATCH --mail-user={mail_user}")
7049 if mail_type:
7050 lines.append(f"#SBATCH --mail-type={mail_type}")
7051
7052 if isinstance(extra_sbatch, dict):
7053 for key, value in extra_sbatch.items():
7054 flag = str(key)
7055 if not flag.startswith("--"):
7056 flag = f"--{flag}"
7057 if isinstance(value, bool):
7058 if value:
7059 lines.append(f"#SBATCH {flag}")
7060 elif value is not None:
7061 lines.append(f"#SBATCH {flag}={value}")
7062 elif isinstance(extra_sbatch, list):
7063 for token in extra_sbatch:
7064 lines.append(f"#SBATCH {token}")
7065
7066 lines.extend(
7067 [
7068 "",
7069 "set -euo pipefail",
7070 "",
7071 f"cd {shlex.quote(workdir)}",
7072 'echo "[$(date)] Starting job ${SLURM_JOB_NAME} (${SLURM_JOB_ID})"',
7073 'echo "[$(date)] Working directory: $PWD"',
7074 ]
7075 )
7076
7077 if shell_env_vars:
7078 for key, value in shell_env_vars.items():
7079 lines.append(f"export {key}={value}")
7080
7081 for setup_line in module_setup:
7082 lines.append(str(setup_line))
7083
7084 if env_vars:
7085 for key, value in env_vars.items():
7086 lines.append(f"export {key}={shlex.quote(str(value))}")
7087
7088 cmd = " ".join(shlex.quote(str(tok)) for tok in command)
7089 if follow_commands:
7090 # `exec` would replace the shell and the trailing commands would never run.
7091 # `set -e` is already in effect, so a failure in the launched command aborts
7092 # the job before anything downstream of it executes.
7093 lines.append(cmd)
7094 for follow in follow_commands:
7095 lines.append(" ".join(shlex.quote(str(tok)) for tok in follow))
7096 else:
7097 lines.append(f"exec {cmd}")
7098
7099 os.makedirs(os.path.dirname(script_path), exist_ok=True)
7100 with open(script_path, "w") as f:
7101 f.write("\n".join(lines) + "\n")
7102 os.chmod(script_path, 0o755)
7103
7104def split_launcher_tokens(
7105 launcher: "str | None",
7106 launcher_args: "list | None" = None,
7107 label: str = "launcher",
7108) -> "tuple[str | None, list[str]]":
7109 """!
7110 @brief Canonicalize launcher config into executable token plus argv-style flags.
7111 @param[in] launcher Argument passed to `split_launcher_tokens()`.
7112 @param[in] launcher_args Argument passed to `split_launcher_tokens()`.
7113 @param[in] label Argument passed to `split_launcher_tokens()`.
7114 @return Value returned by `split_launcher_tokens()`.
7115 """
7116 normalized_args = [str(x) for x in (launcher_args or [])]
7117
7118 if launcher is None:
7119 return None, normalized_args
7120
7121 try:
7122 launcher_tokens = shlex.split(str(launcher))
7123 except ValueError as exc:
7124 raise ValueError(f"{label} is not shell-parseable: {exc}") from exc
7125
7126 if not launcher_tokens:
7127 return None, normalized_args
7128
7129 return launcher_tokens[0], launcher_tokens[1:] + normalized_args
7130
7131
7132def normalize_cluster_launcher(execution: dict) -> "tuple[str | None, list[str]]":
7133 """!
7134 @brief Canonicalize cluster launcher config into executable token plus argv-style flags.
7135 @param[in] execution Argument passed to `normalize_cluster_launcher()`.
7136 @return Value returned by `normalize_cluster_launcher()`.
7137 """
7138 return split_launcher_tokens(
7139 execution.get("launcher"),
7140 execution.get("launcher_args") or [],
7141 label="execution.launcher",
7142 )
7143
7144
7145def strip_launcher_size_flags(launcher_name: str, launcher_args: "list[str]") -> "list[str]":
7146 """!
7147 @brief Remove explicit MPI task-count flags from known launchers.
7148 @param[in] launcher_name Basename-normalized launcher executable.
7149 @param[in] launcher_args Launcher argument list.
7150 @return Filtered launcher arguments with explicit size flags removed.
7151 """
7152 filtered = []
7153 idx = 0
7154 while idx < len(launcher_args):
7155 token = str(launcher_args[idx])
7156
7157 if launcher_name == "srun":
7158 if token in {"-n", "--ntasks"}:
7159 idx += 2
7160 continue
7161 if token.startswith("--ntasks="):
7162 idx += 1
7163 continue
7164 elif launcher_name in {"mpiexec", "mpirun"}:
7165 if token in {"-n", "-np"}:
7166 idx += 2
7167 continue
7168 if token.startswith("-n=") or token.startswith("-np="):
7169 idx += 1
7170 continue
7171
7172 filtered.append(token)
7173 idx += 1
7174
7175 return filtered
7176
7177
7178def build_local_launch_command(
7179 executable: str,
7180 executable_args: list,
7181 num_procs: int,
7182 config_search_anchor: str = None,
7183 allow_single_rank_launcher_override: bool = False,
7184 force_num_procs: "int | None" = None,
7185) -> list:
7186 """!
7187 @brief Build local launcher command, allowing env or shared config overrides for login-node MPI quirks.
7188 @param[in] executable Argument passed to `build_local_launch_command()`.
7189 @param[in] executable_args Argument passed to `build_local_launch_command()`.
7190 @param[in] num_procs Argument passed to `build_local_launch_command()`.
7191 @param[in] config_search_anchor Argument passed to `build_local_launch_command()`.
7192 @param[in] allow_single_rank_launcher_override When true, explicit launcher overrides also apply to 1-rank commands.
7193 @param[in] force_num_procs Optional explicit MPI rank count override applied after stripping conflicting launcher size flags.
7194 @return Value returned by `build_local_launch_command()`.
7195 """
7196 target_num_procs = force_num_procs if force_num_procs is not None else num_procs
7197 command = [executable] + executable_args
7198 if target_num_procs <= 1 and not allow_single_rank_launcher_override:
7199 return command
7200
7201 launcher_override = os.environ.get("PICURV_MPI_LAUNCHER")
7202 if launcher_override is None:
7203 launcher_override = os.environ.get("MPI_LAUNCHER")
7204
7205 try:
7206 if launcher_override is not None:
7207 explicit_launcher_config = True
7208 launcher, launcher_args = split_launcher_tokens(
7209 launcher_override,
7210 label="local MPI launcher override",
7211 )
7212 else:
7213 _, runtime_execution_cfg = load_runtime_execution_config(config_search_anchor)
7214 local_execution = resolve_runtime_execution_context(runtime_execution_cfg, "local")
7215 configured_launcher = local_execution.get("launcher")
7216 configured_args = local_execution.get("launcher_args") or []
7217 explicit_launcher_config = configured_launcher is not None or bool(configured_args)
7218 if target_num_procs <= 1 and not explicit_launcher_config:
7219 return command
7220 launcher, launcher_args = split_launcher_tokens(
7221 configured_launcher if configured_launcher is not None else "mpiexec",
7222 configured_args,
7223 label="local_execution.launcher",
7224 )
7225 except ValueError as exc:
7226 print(f"[FATAL] {exc}", file=sys.stderr)
7227 sys.exit(1)
7228
7229 if not launcher:
7230 return command
7231
7232 launcher_name = os.path.basename(launcher).lower()
7233 if force_num_procs is not None:
7234 launcher_args = strip_launcher_size_flags(launcher_name, launcher_args)
7235 prefix = [launcher] + launcher_args
7236
7237 if launcher_name == "srun":
7238 has_n = any(token in {"-n", "--ntasks"} for token in launcher_args)
7239 if not has_n:
7240 prefix += ["-n", str(target_num_procs)]
7241 elif launcher_name in {"mpiexec", "mpirun"}:
7242 has_n = any(token in {"-n", "-np"} for token in launcher_args)
7243 if not has_n:
7244 prefix += ["-n", str(target_num_procs)]
7245
7246 return prefix + command
7247
7248def resolve_cluster_execution(cluster_cfg: dict, config_search_anchor: str = None, extra_search_anchors=None) -> dict:
7249 """!
7250 @brief Resolve cluster execution launcher settings from shared runtime config plus cluster.yml overrides.
7251 @param[in] cluster_cfg Argument passed to `resolve_cluster_execution()`.
7252 @param[in] config_search_anchor Argument passed to `resolve_cluster_execution()`.
7253 @param[in] extra_search_anchors Argument passed to `resolve_cluster_execution()`.
7254 @return Value returned by `resolve_cluster_execution()`.
7255 """
7256 _, runtime_execution_cfg = load_runtime_execution_config(config_search_anchor, extra_search_anchors=extra_search_anchors)
7257 shared_cluster_execution = resolve_runtime_execution_context(runtime_execution_cfg, "cluster")
7258 execution = cluster_cfg.get("execution", {}) or {}
7259 cluster_override = {
7260 "launcher": execution.get("launcher") if "launcher" in execution else None,
7261 "launcher_args": execution.get("launcher_args") if "launcher_args" in execution else None,
7262 }
7263 return merge_execution_overrides(shared_cluster_execution, cluster_override)
7264
7265
7266def build_cluster_launch_command(
7267 cluster_cfg: dict,
7268 executable: str,
7269 executable_args: list,
7270 config_search_anchor: str = None,
7271 extra_search_anchors=None,
7272 force_num_procs: "int | None" = None,
7273) -> list:
7274 """!
7275 @brief Build scheduler launcher command from cluster config plus optional shared execution defaults.
7276 @param[in] cluster_cfg Argument passed to `build_cluster_launch_command()`.
7277 @param[in] executable Argument passed to `build_cluster_launch_command()`.
7278 @param[in] executable_args Argument passed to `build_cluster_launch_command()`.
7279 @param[in] config_search_anchor Argument passed to `build_cluster_launch_command()`.
7280 @param[in] extra_search_anchors Argument passed to `build_cluster_launch_command()`.
7281 @param[in] force_num_procs Optional explicit MPI rank count override applied after stripping conflicting launcher size flags.
7282 @return Value returned by `build_cluster_launch_command()`.
7283 """
7284 try:
7285 execution = resolve_cluster_execution(
7286 cluster_cfg,
7287 config_search_anchor=config_search_anchor,
7288 extra_search_anchors=extra_search_anchors,
7289 )
7290 launcher, launcher_args = split_launcher_tokens(
7291 execution.get("launcher") if execution.get("launcher") is not None else "srun",
7292 execution.get("launcher_args") or [],
7293 label="cluster execution launcher",
7294 )
7295 except ValueError as exc:
7296 print(f"[FATAL] {exc}", file=sys.stderr)
7297 sys.exit(1)
7298
7299 ntasks = int(force_num_procs) if force_num_procs is not None else get_cluster_total_tasks(cluster_cfg)
7300 launcher_name = launcher.lower() if launcher else ""
7301 if force_num_procs is not None:
7302 launcher_args = strip_launcher_size_flags(launcher_name, launcher_args)
7303
7304 if launcher and launcher_name == "srun":
7305 has_n = any(token in {"-n", "--ntasks"} for token in launcher_args)
7306 cmd = ["srun"] + launcher_args
7307 if not has_n:
7308 cmd += ["-n", str(ntasks)]
7309 return cmd + [executable] + executable_args
7310
7311 if launcher and launcher_name == "mpirun":
7312 has_np = any(token in {"-np", "-n"} for token in launcher_args)
7313 cmd = ["mpirun"] + launcher_args
7314 if not has_np:
7315 cmd += ["-np", str(ntasks)]
7316 return cmd + [executable] + executable_args
7317
7318 if launcher and launcher_name == "mpiexec":
7319 has_np = any(token in {"-np", "-n"} for token in launcher_args)
7320 cmd = ["mpiexec"] + launcher_args
7321 if not has_np:
7322 cmd += ["-np", str(ntasks)]
7323 return cmd + [executable] + executable_args
7324
7325 # Custom launcher or no launcher.
7326 cmd = []
7327 if launcher:
7328 cmd.append(str(launcher))
7329 cmd += launcher_args
7330 cmd += [executable] + executable_args
7331 return cmd
7332
7333def parse_slurm_job_id(sbatch_output: str) -> str:
7334 """!
7335 @brief Extract numeric job id from standard sbatch output.
7336 @param[in] sbatch_output Argument passed to `parse_slurm_job_id()`.
7337 @return Value returned by `parse_slurm_job_id()`.
7338 """
7339 match = re.search(r"Submitted batch job\s+(\d+)", sbatch_output or "")
7340 return match.group(1) if match else None
7341
7342def submit_sbatch(script_path: str, dependency: str = None, dependency_type: str = "afterok") -> dict:
7343 """!
7344 @brief Submit sbatch script and return submission metadata.
7345 @param[in] script_path Argument passed to `submit_sbatch()`.
7346 @param[in] dependency Argument passed to `submit_sbatch()`.
7347 @param[in] dependency_type Slurm dependency type (default: afterok). Common values: afterok, afterany.
7348 @return Value returned by `submit_sbatch()`.
7349 """
7350 cmd = ["sbatch"]
7351 if dependency:
7352 cmd.append(f"--dependency={dependency_type}:{dependency}")
7353 cmd.append(script_path)
7354 result = subprocess.run(cmd, text=True, capture_output=True, check=False)
7355 metadata = {
7356 "command": cmd,
7357 "returncode": result.returncode,
7358 "stdout": (result.stdout or "").strip(),
7359 "stderr": (result.stderr or "").strip(),
7360 "script": script_path,
7361 }
7362 if result.returncode != 0:
7363 print(f"[FATAL] sbatch submission failed for {script_path}\n{metadata['stderr']}", file=sys.stderr)
7364 sys.exit(result.returncode)
7365 metadata["job_id"] = parse_slurm_job_id(metadata["stdout"])
7366 if not metadata["job_id"]:
7367 print(
7368 f"[FATAL] Could not parse Slurm job id from sbatch output: {metadata['stdout']}",
7369 file=sys.stderr
7370 )
7371 sys.exit(1)
7372 return metadata
7373
7374
7375def _print_validation_errors(errors: list):
7376 """!
7377 @brief Prints validation errors and exits.
7378 @param[in] errors List of error message strings.
7379 """
7380 print(f"\n[FATAL] Configuration validation failed with {len(errors)} issue(s):", file=sys.stderr)
7381 for raw_error in errors:
7382 file_path, message = _split_error_file_and_message(raw_error)
7383 key_path = _extract_key_path(message)
7384 code = _classify_error_code(message)
7385 emit_structured_error(code, key=key_path, file_path=file_path, message=message)
7386 print(
7387 "\nHint: See examples/master_template/ for valid config structure and "
7388 "docs/pages/14_Config_Contract.md for key-level contract details.",
7389 file=sys.stderr,
7390 )
7391 sys.exit(1)

7394def generate_header(run_id: str, source_files: dict) -> str:
7395 """!
7396 @brief Creates a standard header block for all generated files.
7397 @param[in] run_id The unique identifier for the current simulation run.
7398 @param[in] source_files A dictionary of source profile files used.
7399 @return A formatted string containing the header.
7400 """
7401 header_parts = [
7402 "# ==============================================================================",
7403 "# AUTO-GENERATED CONFIGURATION FILE",
7404 "# ------------------------------------------------------------------------------",
7405 f"# Run ID: {run_id}",
7406 f"# Timestamp: {datetime.now().strftime('%Y-%m-%d %H:%M:%S')}",
7407 "#",
7408 "# Source Configuration:"
7409 ]
7410 for name, path in source_files.items():
7411 header_parts.append(f"# - {name:<12}: {os.path.basename(path)}")
7412 header_parts.extend([
7413 "#",
7414 "# DO NOT EDIT THIS FILE MANUALLY. IT IS A MACHINE-READABLE ARTIFACT.",
7415 "# ==============================================================================\n"
7416 ])
7417 return "\n".join(header_parts)
7418
7419def generate_simple_list_file(run_dir: str, run_id: str, cfg: dict, section: str, key: str, filename: str, header_sources: dict) -> str:
7420 """!
7421 @brief Generic function to create a file containing a simple list of strings.
7422 @param[in] run_dir The path to the main run directory.
7423 @param[in] run_id The unique identifier for the run.
7424 @param[in] cfg The dictionary containing the configuration data.
7425 @param[in] section The top-level key in the cfg dictionary.
7426 @param[in] key The second-level key whose value is the list of strings.
7427 @param[in] filename The name of the file to generate (e.g., 'whitelist.run').
7428 @param[in] header_sources A dictionary of source files for the header.
7429 @return The absolute path to the generated file.
7430 """
7431 print(f"[INFO] Generating {filename}...")
7432 config_dir = os.path.join(run_dir, "config")
7433 file_path = os.path.join(config_dir, filename)
7434
7435 lines = [generate_header(run_id, header_sources)]
7436 items = cfg.get(section, {}).get(key, [])
7437 lines.extend(items)
7438
7439 with open(file_path, "w") as f: f.write("\n".join(lines))
7440 print(f"[SUCCESS] Generated {filename}: {os.path.relpath(file_path)}")
7441 return os.path.abspath(file_path)
7442

7454def resolve_profiling_config(monitor_cfg: dict) -> dict:
7455 """!
7456 @brief Resolve profiling reporting config from monitor.yml.
7457 @param[in] monitor_cfg Argument passed to `resolve_profiling_config()`.
7458 @return Value returned by `resolve_profiling_config()`.
7459 """
7460 profiling_cfg = monitor_cfg.get("profiling", {}) or {}
7461 timestep_cfg = profiling_cfg.get("timestep_output")
7462 final_cfg = profiling_cfg.get("final_summary")
7463
7464 if timestep_cfg is None:
7465 mode = "off"
7466 functions = []
7467 timestep_file = "Profiling_Timestep_Summary.csv"
7468 else:
7469 if not isinstance(timestep_cfg, dict):
7470 raise ValueError("monitor.profiling.timestep_output must be a mapping when provided.")
7471 mode = str(timestep_cfg.get("mode", "off")).lower()
7472 functions = timestep_cfg.get("functions", [])
7473 timestep_file = str(timestep_cfg.get("file", "Profiling_Timestep_Summary.csv"))
7474
7475 if mode not in {"off", "selected", "all"}:
7476 raise ValueError("monitor.profiling.timestep_output.mode must be one of ['off', 'selected', 'all'].")
7477 if functions is None:
7478 functions = []
7479 if not isinstance(functions, list):
7480 raise ValueError("monitor.profiling.timestep_output.functions must be a list of function names.")
7481 if not all(isinstance(item, str) and item.strip() for item in functions):
7482 raise ValueError("monitor.profiling.timestep_output.functions entries must be non-empty strings.")
7483 if mode == "selected" and not functions:
7484 raise ValueError("monitor.profiling.timestep_output.functions must be non-empty when mode is 'selected'.")
7485 if mode != "selected" and functions:
7486 raise ValueError("monitor.profiling.timestep_output.functions is only valid when mode is 'selected'.")
7487 if not timestep_file:
7488 raise ValueError("monitor.profiling.timestep_output.file must be a non-empty string.")
7489
7490 if final_cfg is None:
7491 final_enabled = True
7492 elif isinstance(final_cfg, dict):
7493 final_enabled = bool(final_cfg.get("enabled", True))
7494 else:
7495 raise ValueError("monitor.profiling.final_summary must be a mapping when provided.")
7496
7497 return {
7498 "mode": mode,
7499 "functions": functions,
7500 "timestep_file": timestep_file,
7501 "final_summary_enabled": final_enabled,
7502 }
7503
7504
7505DIAGNOSTICS_PETSC_KEYS = {
7506 "malloc_debug",
7507 "malloc_test",
7508 "malloc_dump",
7509 "malloc_view",
7510 "malloc_view_threshold",
7511 "memory_view",
7512 "log_view",
7513 "log_view_memory",
7514 "log_all",
7515 "log_trace",
7516 "objects_dump",
7517 "options_left",
7518}
7519
7520
7521def _diagnostic_bool_or_path(value, key: str):
7522 """!
7523 @brief Validate a diagnostics value that can be false, true, or a path/viewer string.
7524 @param[in] value Candidate value.
7525 @param[in] key Diagnostics key used in error messages.
7526 @return Normalized value.
7527 """
7528 if isinstance(value, bool) or value is None:
7529 return value
7530 if isinstance(value, str) and value.strip():
7531 return value.strip()
7532 raise ValueError(f"monitor.diagnostics.petsc.{key} must be boolean, null, or a non-empty string.")
7533
7534
7535def _diagnostic_bool(value, key: str) -> bool:
7536 """!
7537 @brief Validate a diagnostics boolean value.
7538 @param[in] value Candidate value.
7539 @param[in] key Diagnostics key used in error messages.
7540 @return Boolean value.
7541 """
7542 if isinstance(value, bool):
7543 return value
7544 raise ValueError(f"monitor.diagnostics.petsc.{key} must be boolean.")
7545
7546
7547def _diagnostic_bool_or_all(value, key: str):
7548 """!
7549 @brief Validate a diagnostics value that can be false, true, or "all".
7550 @param[in] value Candidate value.
7551 @param[in] key Diagnostics key used in error messages.
7552 @return Normalized value.
7553 """
7554 if isinstance(value, bool) or value is None:
7555 return value
7556 if isinstance(value, str) and value.strip().lower() == "all":
7557 return "all"
7558 raise ValueError(f"monitor.diagnostics.petsc.{key} must be boolean, null, or 'all'.")
7559
7560
7561def _diagnostic_default_file(run_dir: str, filename: str) -> str:
7562 """!
7563 @brief Return an absolute run-local diagnostics file path.
7564 @param[in] run_dir Run directory.
7565 @param[in] filename Diagnostics filename.
7566 @return Absolute diagnostics path under the run logs directory.
7567 """
7568 return os.path.abspath(os.path.join(run_dir, "logs", filename))
7569
7570
7571def _diagnostic_resolve_path_or_default(value, run_dir: str, default_filename: str):
7572 """!
7573 @brief Resolve true/string diagnostics values to a concrete file path.
7574 @param[in] value Boolean/string diagnostics value.
7575 @param[in] run_dir Run directory.
7576 @param[in] default_filename Default file name when value is true.
7577 @return False, or an absolute/explicit path string.
7578 """
7579 if value is True:
7580 return _diagnostic_default_file(run_dir, default_filename)
7581 if isinstance(value, str):
7582 if os.path.isabs(value) or value.startswith(":"):
7583 return value
7584 return os.path.abspath(os.path.join(run_dir, "logs", value))
7585 return False
7586
7587
7588def resolve_diagnostics_config(monitor_cfg: dict, run_dir: "str | None" = None, stage_label: str = "Solver") -> dict:
7589 """!
7590 @brief Resolve monitor diagnostics config and default run-local log paths.
7591 @param[in] monitor_cfg Parsed monitor.yml mapping.
7592 @param[in] run_dir Optional run directory for default artifact paths.
7593 @param[in] stage_label Solver/PostProcessor suffix used for PETSc output defaults.
7594 @return Normalized diagnostics config.
7595 """
7596 diagnostics_cfg = (monitor_cfg.get("diagnostics", {}) or {}) if isinstance(monitor_cfg, dict) else {}
7597 if not isinstance(diagnostics_cfg, dict):
7598 raise ValueError("monitor.diagnostics must be a mapping when provided.")
7599
7600 petsc_raw = diagnostics_cfg.get("petsc", {}) or {}
7601 if not isinstance(petsc_raw, dict):
7602 raise ValueError("monitor.diagnostics.petsc must be a mapping when provided.")
7603 unknown = sorted(set(petsc_raw.keys()) - DIAGNOSTICS_PETSC_KEYS)
7604 if unknown:
7605 raise ValueError(f"monitor.diagnostics.petsc has unsupported key(s): {unknown}.")
7606
7607 petsc = {
7608 "malloc_debug": _diagnostic_bool(petsc_raw.get("malloc_debug", False), "malloc_debug"),
7609 "malloc_test": _diagnostic_bool(petsc_raw.get("malloc_test", False), "malloc_test"),
7610 "malloc_dump": _diagnostic_bool(petsc_raw.get("malloc_dump", False), "malloc_dump"),
7611 "malloc_view": _diagnostic_bool_or_path(petsc_raw.get("malloc_view", False), "malloc_view"),
7612 "malloc_view_threshold": petsc_raw.get("malloc_view_threshold"),
7613 "memory_view": _diagnostic_bool(petsc_raw.get("memory_view", False), "memory_view"),
7614 "log_view": _diagnostic_bool_or_path(petsc_raw.get("log_view", False), "log_view"),
7615 "log_view_memory": _diagnostic_bool(petsc_raw.get("log_view_memory", False), "log_view_memory"),
7616 "log_all": _diagnostic_bool(petsc_raw.get("log_all", False), "log_all"),
7617 "log_trace": _diagnostic_bool_or_path(petsc_raw.get("log_trace", False), "log_trace"),
7618 "objects_dump": _diagnostic_bool_or_all(petsc_raw.get("objects_dump", False), "objects_dump"),
7619 "options_left": petsc_raw.get("options_left"),
7620 }
7621 if petsc["malloc_view_threshold"] is not None and not isinstance(petsc["malloc_view_threshold"], (int, float)):
7622 raise ValueError("monitor.diagnostics.petsc.malloc_view_threshold must be numeric or null.")
7623 if petsc["options_left"] is not None and not isinstance(petsc["options_left"], bool):
7624 raise ValueError("monitor.diagnostics.petsc.options_left must be boolean or null.")
7625
7626 memory_raw = diagnostics_cfg.get("runtime_memory_log", {}) or {}
7627 if not isinstance(memory_raw, dict):
7628 raise ValueError("monitor.diagnostics.runtime_memory_log must be a mapping when provided.")
7629 memory_unknown = sorted(set(memory_raw.keys()) - {"enabled", "file"})
7630 if memory_unknown:
7631 raise ValueError(f"monitor.diagnostics.runtime_memory_log has unsupported key(s): {memory_unknown}.")
7632 memory_enabled = memory_raw.get("enabled", True)
7633 if not isinstance(memory_enabled, bool):
7634 raise ValueError("monitor.diagnostics.runtime_memory_log.enabled must be boolean.")
7635 memory_file = str(memory_raw.get("file", "Runtime_Memory.log")).strip()
7636 if not memory_file:
7637 raise ValueError("monitor.diagnostics.runtime_memory_log.file must be a non-empty string.")
7638
7639 resolved_petsc = dict(petsc)
7640 artifacts = []
7641 if run_dir:
7642 suffix = "PostProcessor" if stage_label == "PostProcessor" else "Solver"
7643 defaults = {
7644 "malloc_view": f"PETSc_MallocView_{suffix}.log",
7645 "log_view": f"PETSc_LogView_{suffix}.log",
7646 "log_trace": f"PETSc_LogTrace_{suffix}.log",
7647 }
7648 for key, default_name in defaults.items():
7649 resolved_value = _diagnostic_resolve_path_or_default(petsc[key], run_dir, default_name)
7650 if key == "log_view" and resolved_value and isinstance(resolved_value, str) and not resolved_value.startswith(":"):
7651 resolved_value = f":{resolved_value}"
7652 resolved_petsc[key] = resolved_value
7653 if resolved_value and isinstance(resolved_value, str) and not resolved_value.startswith(":"):
7654 artifacts.append(resolved_value)
7655 elif resolved_value and isinstance(resolved_value, str) and resolved_value.startswith(":"):
7656 artifacts.append(resolved_value[1:])
7657 if memory_enabled:
7658 artifacts.append(os.path.abspath(os.path.join(run_dir, "logs", memory_file)))
7659
7660 return {
7661 "petsc": resolved_petsc,
7662 "runtime_memory_log": {"enabled": memory_enabled, "file": memory_file},
7663 "artifacts": artifacts,
7664 }
7665
7666
7667def build_petsc_diagnostics_args(monitor_cfg: dict, run_dir: str, stage_label: str) -> list:
7668 """!
7669 @brief Build PETSc diagnostics command-line arguments for a run stage.
7670 @param[in] monitor_cfg Parsed monitor.yml mapping.
7671 @param[in] run_dir Run directory used to resolve default diagnostics files.
7672 @param[in] stage_label Stage label for default output names.
7673 @return List of executable arguments.
7674 """
7675 diagnostics = resolve_diagnostics_config(monitor_cfg, run_dir, stage_label)
7676 petsc = diagnostics["petsc"]
7677 args = []
7678 if petsc["malloc_debug"]:
7679 args.append("-malloc_debug")
7680 if petsc["malloc_test"]:
7681 args.append("-malloc_test")
7682 for key, flag in (
7683 ("malloc_dump", "-malloc_dump"),
7684 ("malloc_view", "-malloc_view"),
7685 ("memory_view", "-memory_view"),
7686 ("log_view", "-log_view"),
7687 ("log_trace", "-log_trace"),
7688 ("objects_dump", "-objects_dump"),
7689 ):
7690 value = petsc.get(key)
7691 if value is True:
7692 args.append(flag)
7693 elif value:
7694 args.extend([flag, str(value)])
7695 if petsc["malloc_view_threshold"] is not None:
7696 args.extend(["-malloc_view_threshold", str(petsc["malloc_view_threshold"])])
7697 if petsc["log_view_memory"]:
7698 args.append("-log_view_memory")
7699 if petsc["log_all"]:
7700 args.append("-log_all")
7701 if petsc["options_left"] is not None:
7702 args.extend(["-options_left", "true" if petsc["options_left"] else "false"])
7703 return args
7704
7705
7706def _statistics_subsystem_available(case_cfg: dict, requirement) -> bool:
7707 """!
7708 @brief Report whether the subsystem a statistics field depends on is active.
7709 @param[in] case_cfg Parsed case configuration.
7710 @param[in] requirement Subsystem key from `STATISTICS_ELIGIBLE_FIELDS`, or None.
7711 @return Value returned by `_statistics_subsystem_available()`.
7712 """
7713 if requirement is None:
7714 return True
7715 physics = ((case_cfg or {}).get("models", {}) or {}).get("physics", {}) or {}
7716 if requirement == "particles":
7717 particles = physics.get("particles", {}) or {}
7718 try:
7719 return int(particles.get("count", 0) or 0) > 0
7720 except (TypeError, ValueError):
7721 return False
7722 turbulence = physics.get("turbulence", {}) or {}
7723 les_on = bool((turbulence.get("les", {}) or {}).get("enabled", False))
7724 rans_on = bool((turbulence.get("rans", {}) or {}).get("enabled", False))
7725 if requirement == "les":
7726 return les_on
7727 if requirement == "turbulence":
7728 return les_on or rans_on
7729 return False
7730
7731
7732def normalize_field_statistics_config(monitor_cfg: dict, case_cfg: dict = None) -> dict:
7733 """!
7734 @brief Validate and canonicalize the field-statistics block of monitor.yml.
7735
7736 @details Rejects every condition the field-statistics contract forbids, naming the
7737 offending window so a message points at one entry rather than the block.
7738 Returns a canonical form the flag resolver serializes without further
7739 interpretation, so validation and emission cannot disagree.
7740
7741 @param[in] monitor_cfg Parsed monitor configuration.
7742 @param[in] case_cfg Parsed case configuration, used to check that each field's
7743 subsystem is active. Subsystem checks are skipped when None.
7744 @return Value returned by `normalize_field_statistics_config()`.
7745 """
7746 raw = (monitor_cfg or {}).get("field_statistics")
7747 if raw is None:
7748 return {"enabled": False, "windows": []}
7749 if not isinstance(raw, dict):
7750 raise ValueError("'field_statistics' must be a mapping.")
7751
7752 enabled = raw.get("enabled", False)
7753 if not isinstance(enabled, bool):
7754 raise ValueError("'field_statistics.enabled' must be true or false.")
7755 windows_raw = raw.get("windows", []) or []
7756 if not isinstance(windows_raw, list):
7757 raise ValueError("'field_statistics.windows' must be a list.")
7758 if enabled and not windows_raw:
7759 raise ValueError("'field_statistics.enabled' is true but no window is defined.")
7760
7761 windows = []
7762 seen_names = set()
7763 for index, window in enumerate(windows_raw):
7764 if not isinstance(window, dict):
7765 raise ValueError(f"'field_statistics.windows[{index}]' must be a mapping.")
7766 name = window.get("name")
7767 if not isinstance(name, str) or not name.strip():
7768 raise ValueError(f"'field_statistics.windows[{index}]' needs a non-empty 'name'.")
7769 name = name.strip()
7770 # Window names identify saved state across a restart, so a duplicate would
7771 # make two windows indistinguishable in the checkpoint.
7772 if name in seen_names:
7773 raise ValueError(f"field statistics window '{name}' is defined more than once.")
7774 seen_names.add(name)
7775
7776 start_time = window.get("start_time")
7777 if not isinstance(start_time, (int, float)) or isinstance(start_time, bool):
7778 raise ValueError(f"field statistics window '{name}': 'start_time' must be a number.")
7779 end_time = window.get("end_time")
7780 if end_time is not None:
7781 if not isinstance(end_time, (int, float)) or isinstance(end_time, bool):
7782 raise ValueError(f"field statistics window '{name}': 'end_time' must be a number.")
7783 if float(end_time) <= float(start_time):
7784 raise ValueError(
7785 f"field statistics window '{name}': 'end_time' ({end_time}) must be greater "
7786 f"than 'start_time' ({start_time})."
7787 )
7788
7789 weighting = window.get("weighting")
7790 if weighting not in STATISTICS_WEIGHTING_MODES:
7791 raise ValueError(
7792 f"field statistics window '{name}': 'weighting' must be one of "
7793 f"{list(STATISTICS_WEIGHTING_MODES)} (got {weighting!r})."
7794 )
7795
7796 has_step = "step_cadence" in window and window["step_cadence"] is not None
7797 has_time = "time_cadence" in window and window["time_cadence"] is not None
7798 if has_step == has_time:
7799 raise ValueError(
7800 f"field statistics window '{name}': set exactly one of 'step_cadence' and "
7801 "'time_cadence'."
7802 )
7803 step_cadence = None
7804 time_cadence = None
7805 if has_step:
7806 step_cadence = window["step_cadence"]
7807 if not isinstance(step_cadence, int) or isinstance(step_cadence, bool) or step_cadence <= 0:
7808 raise ValueError(
7809 f"field statistics window '{name}': 'step_cadence' must be a positive integer "
7810 f"(got {step_cadence!r})."
7811 )
7812 else:
7813 time_cadence = window["time_cadence"]
7814 if (not isinstance(time_cadence, (int, float)) or isinstance(time_cadence, bool)
7815 or float(time_cadence) <= 0.0):
7816 raise ValueError(
7817 f"field statistics window '{name}': 'time_cadence' must be a positive number "
7818 f"(got {time_cadence!r})."
7819 )
7820
7821 fields_raw = window.get("fields")
7822 if not isinstance(fields_raw, list) or not fields_raw:
7823 raise ValueError(f"field statistics window '{name}': 'fields' must be a non-empty list.")
7824 fields = []
7825 for field_entry in fields_raw:
7826 if not isinstance(field_entry, dict):
7827 raise ValueError(f"field statistics window '{name}': each 'fields' entry must be a mapping.")
7828 field_name = field_entry.get("field")
7829 if field_name not in STATISTICS_ELIGIBLE_FIELDS:
7830 raise ValueError(
7831 f"field statistics window '{name}': field {field_name!r} cannot be accumulated. "
7832 f"Available fields: {sorted(STATISTICS_ELIGIBLE_FIELDS)}."
7833 )
7834 requirement = STATISTICS_ELIGIBLE_FIELDS[field_name]["requires"]
7835 if case_cfg is not None and not _statistics_subsystem_available(case_cfg, requirement):
7836 raise ValueError(
7837 f"field statistics window '{name}': field '{field_name}' requires the "
7838 f"'{requirement}' subsystem, which is not enabled for this case."
7839 )
7840 if any(existing["field"] == field_name for existing in fields):
7841 raise ValueError(
7842 f"field statistics window '{name}': field '{field_name}' is listed more than once."
7843 )
7844 moments = field_entry.get("moments")
7845 if not isinstance(moments, list) or not moments:
7846 raise ValueError(
7847 f"field statistics window '{name}': field '{field_name}' needs a non-empty "
7848 "'moments' list."
7849 )
7850 unknown = [m for m in moments if m not in STATISTICS_MOMENT_NAMES]
7851 if unknown:
7852 raise ValueError(
7853 f"field statistics window '{name}': field '{field_name}' requests unknown "
7854 f"moments {unknown}. Available moments: {list(STATISTICS_MOMENT_NAMES)}."
7855 )
7856 # The first moment is always kept, because every centered product is
7857 # measured against it.
7858 fields.append({"field": field_name, "moments": ["first"] + (["second"] if "second" in moments else [])})
7859
7860 covariances_raw = window.get("covariances", []) or []
7861 if not isinstance(covariances_raw, list):
7862 raise ValueError(f"field statistics window '{name}': 'covariances' must be a list.")
7863 requested = {entry["field"] for entry in fields}
7864 covariances = []
7865 for pair in covariances_raw:
7866 if not isinstance(pair, list) or len(pair) != 2:
7867 raise ValueError(
7868 f"field statistics window '{name}': each covariance must be a pair of field names."
7869 )
7870 first, second = pair
7871 for member in (first, second):
7872 if member not in STATISTICS_ELIGIBLE_FIELDS:
7873 raise ValueError(
7874 f"field statistics window '{name}': covariance member {member!r} cannot be "
7875 f"accumulated. Available fields: {sorted(STATISTICS_ELIGIBLE_FIELDS)}."
7876 )
7877 if first == second:
7878 raise ValueError(
7879 f"field statistics window '{name}': covariance ['{first}', '{second}'] pairs a "
7880 "field with itself; request that through moments: [second] instead."
7881 )
7882 missing = sorted({first, second} - requested)
7883 if missing:
7884 raise ValueError(
7885 f"field statistics window '{name}': covariance ['{first}', '{second}'] needs "
7886 f"{missing} in 'fields' as well, because a co-moment is centered against their means."
7887 )
7888 # Two three-component fields would need a full nine-component tensor,
7889 # which nothing allocates.
7890 if (STATISTICS_ELIGIBLE_FIELDS[first]["components"] == 3
7891 and STATISTICS_ELIGIBLE_FIELDS[second]["components"] == 3):
7892 raise ValueError(
7893 f"field statistics window '{name}': covariance ['{first}', '{second}'] pairs two "
7894 "vector fields, which is not supported."
7895 )
7896 if sorted((first, second)) in [sorted(existing) for existing in covariances]:
7897 raise ValueError(
7898 f"field statistics window '{name}': covariance ['{first}', '{second}'] is "
7899 "requested more than once."
7900 )
7901 covariances.append([first, second])
7902
7903 windows.append({
7904 "name": name,
7905 "start_time": float(start_time),
7906 "end_time": None if end_time is None else float(end_time),
7907 "weighting": weighting,
7908 "step_cadence": step_cadence,
7909 "time_cadence": None if time_cadence is None else float(time_cadence),
7910 "fields": fields,
7911 "covariances": covariances,
7912 })
7913
7914 return {"enabled": bool(enabled), "windows": windows}
7915
7916
7917def resolve_field_statistics_flags(monitor_cfg: dict, case_cfg: dict = None) -> list:
7918 """!
7919 @brief Serialize field-statistics configuration into control-file option lines.
7920 @details A window list is variable arity, so its option names are constructed from
7921 the index. Each name belongs to a family declared in the ingress audit
7922 manifest.
7923 @param[in] monitor_cfg Parsed monitor configuration.
7924 @param[in] case_cfg Parsed case configuration, for subsystem availability checks.
7925 @return Value returned by `resolve_field_statistics_flags()`.
7926 """
7927 config = normalize_field_statistics_config(monitor_cfg, case_cfg)
7928 if not config["enabled"]:
7929 return []
7930
7931 lines = ["-field_statistics_enabled true",
7932 f"-field_statistics_window_count {len(config['windows'])}"]
7933 for index, window in enumerate(config["windows"]):
7934 prefix = f"-field_statistics_window_{index}"
7935 lines.append(f"{prefix}_name {window['name']}")
7936 lines.append(f"{prefix}_start_time {window['start_time']!r}")
7937 # An absent end time is what makes a window open ended, so the option is
7938 # omitted rather than given a sentinel value.
7939 if window["end_time"] is not None:
7940 lines.append(f"{prefix}_end_time {window['end_time']!r}")
7941 lines.append(f"{prefix}_weighting {window['weighting']}")
7942 if window["step_cadence"] is not None:
7943 lines.append(f"{prefix}_step_cadence {window['step_cadence']}")
7944 else:
7945 lines.append(f"{prefix}_time_cadence {window['time_cadence']!r}")
7946 lines.append(f"{prefix}_field_count {len(window['fields'])}")
7947 for field_index, field_entry in enumerate(window["fields"]):
7948 lines.append(f"{prefix}_field_{field_index}_name {field_entry['field']}")
7949 lines.append(f"{prefix}_field_{field_index}_moments {','.join(field_entry['moments'])}")
7950 lines.append(f"{prefix}_covariance_count {len(window['covariances'])}")
7951 for pair_index, pair in enumerate(window["covariances"]):
7952 lines.append(f"{prefix}_covariance_{pair_index} {pair[0]},{pair[1]}")
7953 return lines
7954
7955
7956def resolve_statistics_console_output_frequency(io_cfg: dict) -> "int | None":
7957 """!
7958 @brief Resolve the statistics console cadence, mirroring the particle one.
7959 @param[in] io_cfg Parsed monitor `io` block.
7960 @return Value returned by `resolve_statistics_console_output_frequency()`.
7961 """
7962 if 'statistics_console_output_frequency' in io_cfg:
7963 return io_cfg['statistics_console_output_frequency']
7964 return io_cfg.get('data_output_frequency')
7965
7966
7967def normalize_solution_monitoring_config(monitor_cfg: dict) -> dict:
7968 """!
7969 @brief Validate and canonicalize physical-solution convergence monitoring.
7970 @param[in] monitor_cfg Parsed monitor.yml mapping.
7971 @return Canonical solution-monitoring configuration.
7972 @throws ValueError when convergence settings are invalid.
7973 """
7974 if not isinstance(monitor_cfg, dict):
7975 raise ValueError("monitor.yml must be a mapping before solution monitoring can be normalized.")
7976 monitoring = monitor_cfg.get("solution_monitoring", {}) or {}
7977 if not isinstance(monitoring, dict):
7978 raise ValueError("solution_monitoring must be a mapping when provided.")
7979 convergence = monitoring.get("convergence", {}) or {}
7980 if not isinstance(convergence, dict):
7981 raise ValueError("solution_monitoring.convergence must be a mapping when provided.")
7982 enabled = convergence.get("enabled", True)
7983 if not isinstance(enabled, bool):
7984 raise ValueError("solution_monitoring.convergence.enabled must be boolean.")
7985 mode = normalize_solution_convergence_mode(convergence.get("mode", "steady_deterministic"))
7986 normalized = {"enabled": enabled, "mode": mode.lower()}
7987 periodic_cfg = convergence.get("periodic_deterministic")
7988 statistical_cfg = convergence.get("statistical_steady")
7989 if mode == "PERIODIC_DETERMINISTIC":
7990 if not isinstance(periodic_cfg, dict):
7991 raise ValueError(
7992 "solution_monitoring.convergence.periodic_deterministic is required for periodic_deterministic mode."
7993 )
7994 period_steps = periodic_cfg.get("period_steps")
7995 if isinstance(period_steps, bool) or not isinstance(period_steps, int) or period_steps <= 0:
7996 raise ValueError(
7997 "solution_monitoring.convergence.periodic_deterministic.period_steps must be a positive integer."
7998 )
7999 normalized["periodic_deterministic"] = {"period_steps": period_steps}
8000 elif periodic_cfg is not None:
8001 raise ValueError(
8002 "solution_monitoring.convergence.periodic_deterministic is only valid for periodic_deterministic mode."
8003 )
8004 if mode == "STATISTICAL_STEADY":
8005 if not isinstance(statistical_cfg, dict):
8006 raise ValueError(
8007 "solution_monitoring.convergence.statistical_steady is required for statistical_steady mode."
8008 )
8009 window_steps = statistical_cfg.get("window_steps")
8010 if isinstance(window_steps, bool) or not isinstance(window_steps, int) or window_steps <= 0:
8011 raise ValueError(
8012 "solution_monitoring.convergence.statistical_steady.window_steps must be a positive integer."
8013 )
8014 normalized["statistical_steady"] = {"window_steps": window_steps}
8015 elif statistical_cfg is not None:
8016 raise ValueError(
8017 "solution_monitoring.convergence.statistical_steady is only valid for statistical_steady mode."
8018 )
8019 return {"convergence": normalized}
8020

8022def resolve_solution_monitoring_flags(monitor_cfg: dict) -> dict:
8023 """!
8024 @brief Translate solution-monitoring YAML into the existing C convergence flags.
8025 @param[in] monitor_cfg Parsed monitor.yml mapping.
8026 @return Mapping of convergence options to explicit runtime values.
8027 """
8028 convergence = normalize_solution_monitoring_config(monitor_cfg)["convergence"]
8029 flags = {
8030 "-solution_convergence_enabled": "true" if convergence["enabled"] else "false",
8031 "-solution_convergence_mode": f'"{normalize_solution_convergence_mode(convergence["mode"])}"',
8032 }
8033 if "periodic_deterministic" in convergence:
8034 flags["-solution_convergence_period_steps"] = convergence["periodic_deterministic"]["period_steps"]
8035 if "statistical_steady" in convergence:
8036 flags["-solution_convergence_window_steps"] = convergence["statistical_steady"]["window_steps"]
8037 return flags

8081def generate_multi_block_bcs(run_dir: str, run_id: str, case_cfg: dict, source_files: dict) -> list:
8082 """!
8083 @brief Parses multi-block BCs from YAML, generates a .run file for each block,
8084 and returns a list of their absolute paths.
8085 @details Handles both simple list format (for single-block cases) and a
8086 list-of-lists (for multi-block cases) for boundary conditions.
8087 @param[in] run_dir The path to the main run directory.
8088 @param[in] run_id The unique identifier for the run.
8089 @param[in] case_cfg The parsed case.yml configuration dictionary.
8090 @param[in] source_files A dictionary of source files for the header.
8091 @return A list of absolute paths to the generated BC files.
8092 @throws ValueError if the number of BC definitions does not match the number of blocks.
8093 """
8094 print("[INFO] Generating boundary condition files...")
8095 config_dir = os.path.join(run_dir, "config")
8096 num_blocks = int(case_cfg.get('models', {}).get('domain', {}).get('blocks', 1))
8097 prepared_blocks = validate_and_prepare_boundary_conditions(case_cfg)
8098 case_path = source_files.get("Case") if source_files else None
8099 profile_grid_dims = None
8100 scales = case_cfg.get('properties', {}).get('scaling', {})
8101 U_ref = _to_float(scales.get('velocity_ref'), "properties.scaling.velocity_ref")
8102 if U_ref == 0.0:
8103 raise ValueError("properties.scaling.velocity_ref must be non-zero for prescribed_flow profile staging.")
8104
8105 if any(bc.get("handler") == "prescribed_flow" for block in prepared_blocks for bc in block):
8106 profile_grid_dims = resolve_grid_block_dimensions_for_profiles(case_cfg, case_path, run_dir)
8107
8108 generated_files = []
8109 generated_profile_summaries = []
8110 generated_target_grid = None
8111 field_slice_target_grid = None
8112 for i, block_bcs_list in enumerate(prepared_blocks):
8113 file_name = "bcs.run" if num_blocks == 1 else f"bcs_block{i}.run"
8114 bcs_file_path = os.path.join(config_dir, file_name)
8115 bcs_lines = [generate_header(run_id, source_files)]
8116
8117 for bc in block_bcs_list:
8118 face, bc_type, handler = bc['face'], bc['type'], bc['handler']
8119 params = dict(bc.get('params') or {})
8120 if handler == "prescribed_flow":
8121 source = params.pop("source")
8122 expected_dims = _bc_profile_expected_dims(face, profile_grid_dims[i])
8123 staged_name = f"inlet_profile_block{i}_{face.replace('+', 'pos').replace('-', 'neg')}.picslice"
8124 staged_path = os.path.join(config_dir, staged_name)
8125 if source["type"] == "file":
8126 source_path = source["path"]
8127 if case_path and not os.path.isabs(source_path):
8128 source_path = os.path.abspath(os.path.join(os.path.dirname(case_path), source_path))
8129 elif source["type"] == "generated":
8130 default_output = os.path.join(
8131 "config",
8132 f"inlet_profile_block{i}_{_face_artifact_token(face)}.generated.picslice",
8133 )
8134 source_path = _resolve_run_artifact_path(
8135 run_dir,
8136 source.get("output_file"),
8137 default_output,
8138 default_to_config_dir=True,
8139 )
8140 if os.path.abspath(source_path) == os.path.abspath(staged_path):
8141 raise ValueError(
8142 f"Generated profile output_file for block {i}, face {face} must differ from staged solver profile."
8143 )
8144 if source["generator"] == "square_duct_poiseuille":
8145 if generated_target_grid is None:
8146 generated_target_grid = resolve_target_grid_for_generated_profile(case_cfg, case_path, run_dir)
8147 summary = generate_square_duct_poiseuille_picslice(
8148 source_path,
8149 expected_dims,
8150 source["params"],
8151 target_grid=generated_target_grid,
8152 target_block=i,
8153 target_face=face,
8154 script=source.get("script"),
8155 case_path=case_path,
8156 )
8157 else:
8158 raise ValueError(f"Unsupported generated profile generator '{source['generator']}'.")
8159 summary.update({"block": i, "face": face})
8160 generated_profile_summaries.append(summary)
8161 elif source["type"] == "field_slice":
8162 default_output = os.path.join(
8163 "config",
8164 f"inlet_profile_block{i}_{_face_artifact_token(face)}.sliced.picslice",
8165 )
8166 source_path = _resolve_run_artifact_path(
8167 run_dir,
8168 source.get("output_file"),
8169 default_output,
8170 default_to_config_dir=True,
8171 )
8172 if os.path.abspath(source_path) == os.path.abspath(staged_path):
8173 raise ValueError(
8174 f"field_slice output_file for block {i}, face {face} must differ from staged solver profile."
8175 )
8176 if field_slice_target_grid is None:
8177 field_slice_target_grid = resolve_target_grid_for_field_slice(case_cfg, case_path, run_dir)
8178 summary = generate_field_slice_picslice(
8179 source_path,
8180 expected_dims,
8181 source,
8182 field_slice_target_grid,
8183 face,
8184 i,
8185 case_path,
8186 )
8187 summary.update({"block": i, "face": face})
8188 generated_profile_summaries.append(summary)
8189 else:
8190 raise ValueError(f"Unsupported prescribed_flow source type '{source.get('type')}'.")
8191 summary = validate_and_nondimensionalize_picslice(source_path, staged_path, U_ref, expected_dims)
8192 print(
8193 f"[SUCCESS] Staged prescribed_flow profile for block {i}, face {face}: "
8194 f"{os.path.relpath(staged_path)} dims={summary['dims']}"
8195 )
8196 params["source_file"] = os.path.abspath(staged_path)
8197 params_str = ""
8198 if params:
8199 parts = []
8200 for k, v in params.items():
8201 if isinstance(v, bool):
8202 value_str = "true" if v else "false"
8203 else:
8204 value_str = str(v)
8205 parts.append(f"{k}={value_str}")
8206 params_str = " ".join(parts)
8207 bcs_lines.append(f"{face:<20s} {bc_type:<12s} {handler:<20s} {params_str}")
8208
8209 with open(bcs_file_path, "w") as f: f.write("\n".join(bcs_lines))
8210
8211 print(f"[SUCCESS] Generated BCs for Block {i}: {os.path.relpath(bcs_file_path)}")
8212 generated_files.append(os.path.abspath(bcs_file_path))
8213
8214 if generated_profile_summaries:
8215 info_path = write_profile_info(config_dir, generated_profile_summaries)
8216 print(f"[SUCCESS] Wrote generated profile summary: {os.path.relpath(info_path)}")
8217
8218 return generated_files
8219
8220def format_flag_value(value):
8221 """!
8222 @brief Converts Python types to C-style command-line flag values.
8223 @param[in] value The Python object to convert (bool, list, or other).
8224 @return A string representation suitable for a C command-line parser.
8225 """
8226 if isinstance(value, bool):
8227 return "1" if value else "0"
8228 if isinstance(value, list):
8229 return ",".join(map(str, value))
8230 return str(value)

8232def translate_programmatic_grid_settings(grid_settings: dict) -> dict:
8233 """!
8234 @brief Return programmatic-grid settings translated to the C node-count contract.
8235 @param[in] grid_settings Argument passed to `translate_programmatic_grid_settings()`.
8236 @return Value returned by `translate_programmatic_grid_settings()`.
8237 """
8238 translated = dict(grid_settings)
8239 for dim_key in ("im", "jm", "km"):
8240 if dim_key in translated:
8241 raw_val = translated[dim_key]
8242 if not isinstance(raw_val, int) or raw_val <= 0:
8243 raise ValueError(
8244 f"grid.programmatic_settings.{dim_key} must be a positive integer cell count "
8245 f"(got {raw_val!r})."
8246 )
8247 translated[dim_key] = raw_val + 1
8248 return translated
8249
