11568def generate_study_plots(study_cfg: dict, metrics_csv: str, plots_dir: str):
11569 """!
11570 @brief Generate metric-vs-parameter plots for completed studies.
11571 @param[in] study_cfg Argument passed to `generate_study_plots()`.
11572 @param[in] metrics_csv Argument passed to `generate_study_plots()`.
11573 @param[in] plots_dir Argument passed to `generate_study_plots()`.
11574 @return Value returned by `generate_study_plots()`.
11575 """
11576 plotting_cfg = study_cfg.get("plotting", {}) or {}
11577 if plotting_cfg.get("enabled", True) is False:
11578 print("[INFO] Plotting disabled by study.yml.")
11579 return []
11580 plt = optional_matplotlib_pyplot()
11581 if plt is None:
11582 print("[WARNING] matplotlib not available; skipping plot generation.")
11583 return []
11584 if not metrics_csv or not os.path.isfile(metrics_csv):
11585 return []
11586
11587 with open(metrics_csv, "r", newline="") as f:
11588 reader = csv.DictReader(f)
11589 rows = list(reader)
11590 if not rows:
11591 return []
11592
11593 axis = _infer_study_plot_axis(study_cfg, rows)
11594 if axis is None:
11595 print("[WARNING] Could not infer numeric x-axis for plots; skipping.")
11596 return []
11597
11598 configured_metrics = study_cfg.get("metrics", []) or ["msd_final"]
11599 metric_keys = [
11600 normalize_metric_spec(metric).get("name", "metric") for metric in configured_metrics
11601 if normalize_metric_spec(metric).get("name", "metric") in rows[0]
11602 ]
11603
11604 out_format = plotting_cfg.get("output_format", "png")
11605 os.makedirs(plots_dir, exist_ok=True)
11606 generated = []
11607 for metric in metric_keys:
11608 groups = _study_plot_groups(study_cfg, rows, axis, metric)
11609 if not groups:
11610 continue
11611 all_x = [point[0] for group in groups for point in group["points"]]
11612 all_y = [point[1] for group in groups for point in group["points"]]
11613 metric_label = _study_metric_label(study_cfg, metric)
11614 metric_hint = metric.lower()
11615 y_log = _study_use_log_scale(
11616 all_y,
11617 any(token in metric_hint for token in ("error", "residual", "drift", "msd")),
11618 )
11619 x_log = _study_use_log_scale(all_x)
11620 grid_cross_product = (
11621 study_cfg.get("study_type") == "grid_independence"
11622 and bool(study_cfg.get("parameters")) and len(axis["contributors"]) == 3
11623 and sum(
11624 len(set(float(row[key]) for row in rows)) > 1
11625 for key in axis["contributors"]
11626 ) > 1
11627 )
11628
11629 plt.figure(figsize=(9.2, 5.5), facecolor="white")
11630 for index, group in enumerate(groups):
11631 x_values = [point[0] for point in group["points"]]
11632 y_values = [point[1] for point in group["points"]]
11633 repeated_x = len(set(x_values)) != len(x_values)
11634 plt.plot(
11635 x_values, y_values,
11636 color=_STUDY_REPORT_COLORS[index % len(_STUDY_REPORT_COLORS)],
11637 marker="o", markersize=5.2, markeredgewidth=0.7,
11638 linewidth=0.0 if repeated_x or grid_cross_product else 1.8,
11639 linestyle="none" if repeated_x or grid_cross_product else "-",
11640 label=group["label"],
11641 )
11642 plt.xlabel(axis["label"], fontsize=11)
11643 plt.ylabel(metric_label, fontsize=11)
11644 study_label = {
11645 "grid_independence": "Grid-independence study",
11646 "timestep_independence": "Timestep-independence study",
11647 "sensitivity": "Sensitivity study",
11648 }.get(study_cfg.get("study_type"), "Parameter study")
11649 plt.title(f"{metric_label} vs. {axis['label']}\n{study_label}", fontsize=13, loc="left", pad=12)
11650 if x_log and hasattr(plt, "xscale"):
11651 plt.xscale("log")
11652 if y_log:
11653 plt.yscale("log")
11654 elif hasattr(plt, "ylim"):
11655 limits = _study_linear_y_limits(all_y)
11656 if limits:
11657 plt.ylim(*limits)
11658 if hasattr(plt, "tick_params"):
11659 plt.tick_params(axis="both", which="major", labelsize=9.5)
11660 plt.grid(True, alpha=0.24, which="major", linewidth=0.7)
11661 if x_log or y_log:
11662 plt.grid(True, alpha=0.08, which="minor", linewidth=0.5)
11663 if len(groups) > 1:
11664 plt.legend(
11665 loc="upper left", bbox_to_anchor=(1.01, 1.0), borderaxespad=0.0,
11666 frameon=False, title="Fixed parameters", fontsize=9, title_fontsize=9.5,
11667 )
11668 plt.tight_layout(rect=(0.0, 0.0, 0.76, 1.0))
11669 else:
11670 plt.tight_layout()
11671 safe_metric = re.sub(r"[^A-Za-z0-9_.-]+", "_", metric)
11672 out_path = os.path.join(plots_dir, f"{safe_metric}_vs_{axis['slug']}.{out_format}")
11673 plt.savefig(out_path, dpi=240, bbox_inches="tight", facecolor="white")
11674 plt.close()
11675 generated.append(out_path)
11676 if generated:
11677 print(f"[SUCCESS] Generated {len(generated)} plot(s) in {os.path.relpath(plots_dir)}")
11678 return generated
11679

11681def _command_to_string(command_tokens: list) -> str:
11682 """!
11683 @brief Render a command list as a shell-safe display string.
11684 @param[in] command_tokens Argument passed to `_command_to_string()`.
11685 @return Value returned by `_command_to_string()`.
11686 """
11687 return " ".join(shlex.quote(str(tok)) for tok in command_tokens)

11690def _resolve_post_source_directory_preview(run_dir: str, monitor_cfg: dict, post_cfg: dict) -> str:
11691 """!
11692 @brief Resolve post source directory without side effects or stdout/stderr output.
11693 @param[in] run_dir Argument passed to `_resolve_post_source_directory_preview()`.

11706def build_run_dry_plan(args) -> dict:
11707 """!
11708 @brief Build a no-write execution plan for `run --dry-run`.
11709 @param[in] args Command-line style argument list supplied to the function.
11710 @return Value returned by `build_run_dry_plan()`.
11711 """
11712 plan = {
11713 "mode": "dry-run",
11714 "created_at": datetime.now().isoformat(),
11715 "warnings": [],
11716 "inputs": {},
11717 "stages": {},
11718 "artifacts": [],
11719 }
11720
11721 if args.dry_run and args.no_submit:
11722 plan["warnings"].append("--dry-run takes precedence over --no-submit; no files will be written.")
11723
11724 cluster_mode = bool(getattr(args, "cluster", None))
11725 cluster_cfg = None
11726 cluster_path = None
11727 solver_num_procs_effective = args.num_procs
11728 post_num_procs_effective = args.num_procs
11729 run_id = None
11730 run_dir = None
11731 solver_control_path = None
11732 loaded_case_cfg = None
11733 loaded_monitor_cfg = None
11734 resolved_restart_source_dir = None
11735
11736 if cluster_mode:
11737 cluster_path = os.path.abspath(args.cluster)
11738 cluster_cfg = read_yaml_file(cluster_path)
11739 validate_cluster_config(cluster_cfg, cluster_path)
11740 scheduler_type = str(cluster_cfg.get("scheduler", {}).get("type", "slurm")).lower()
11741 if args.scheduler and args.scheduler.lower() != scheduler_type:
11742 emit_structured_error(
11743 ERROR_CODE_CFG_INCONSISTENT_COMBO,
11744 key="scheduler.type",
11745 file_path=cluster_path,
11746 message=f"--scheduler={args.scheduler} does not match cluster.yml scheduler.type={scheduler_type}.",
11747 )
11748 sys.exit(1)
11749 if scheduler_type != "slurm":
11750 emit_structured_error(
11751 ERROR_CODE_CFG_INVALID_VALUE,
11752 key="scheduler.type",
11753 file_path=cluster_path,
11754 message=f"Unsupported scheduler '{scheduler_type}'. Only Slurm is supported in v1.",
11755 )
11756 sys.exit(1)
11757 cluster_tasks = get_cluster_total_tasks(cluster_cfg)
11758 if (args.solve or args.post_process) and args.num_procs not in (1, cluster_tasks):
11759 emit_structured_error(
11760 ERROR_CODE_CFG_INCONSISTENT_COMBO,
11761 key="resources.ntasks_per_node",
11762 file_path=cluster_path,
11763 message=(
11764 "--num-procs must be 1 (auto) or "
11765 f"exactly nodes*ntasks_per_node ({cluster_tasks}) in cluster mode."
11766 ),
11767 )
11768 sys.exit(1)
11769 if args.solve:
11770 solver_num_procs_effective = cluster_tasks
11771 if args.post_process:
11772 post_num_procs_effective = cluster_tasks
11773 plan["launch_mode"] = "slurm"
11774 plan["inputs"]["cluster"] = cluster_path
11775 else:
11776 if getattr(args, "scheduler", None):
11777 fail_cli_usage("--scheduler requires --cluster in this version.")
11778 plan["launch_mode"] = "local"
11779
11780 # --- Guard: restart flags without --solve ---
11781 if not args.solve:
11782 if getattr(args, 'restart_from', None):
11783 print("[WARNING] --restart-from has no effect without --solve and will be ignored.", file=sys.stderr)
11784 if getattr(args, 'continue_run', False) and not args.post_process:
11785 print("[WARNING] --continue has no effect without --solve or --post-process and will be ignored.", file=sys.stderr)
11786
11787 if args.solve:
11788 case_path = os.path.abspath(args.case)
11789 solver_path = os.path.abspath(args.solver)
11790 monitor_path = os.path.abspath(args.monitor)
11791 loaded_case_cfg = read_yaml_file(case_path)
11792 solver_cfg = read_yaml_file(solver_path)
11793 loaded_monitor_cfg = read_yaml_file(monitor_path)
11794 validate_simulation_configs(loaded_case_cfg, solver_cfg, loaded_monitor_cfg, case_path, solver_path, monitor_path)
11795
11796 continue_mode = getattr(args, 'continue_run', False)
11797
11798 if continue_mode:
11799 # --continue reuses existing run directory
11800 if not args.run_dir:
11801 fail_cli_usage(RESTART_RUN_DIR_REQUIRED_MESSAGE)
11802 run_dir = os.path.abspath(args.run_dir)
11803 if not os.path.isdir(run_dir):
11804 emit_structured_error(
11805 ERROR_CODE_CFG_FILE_NOT_FOUND,
11806 key="run-dir",
11807 file_path=run_dir,
11808 message="Specified run directory not found.",
11809 )
11810 sys.exit(1)
11811 run_id = os.path.basename(run_dir)
11812 else:
11813 case_name = os.path.splitext(os.path.basename(case_path))[0]
11814 timestamp = datetime.now().strftime("%Y%m%d-%H%M%S")
11815 run_id = f"{case_name}_{timestamp}"
11816 run_dir = os.path.abspath(os.path.join("runs", run_id))
11817
11818 try:
11819 resolved_restart_source_dir, is_continue = resolve_restart_source(
11820 args, loaded_case_cfg, solver_cfg, loaded_monitor_cfg, run_dir
11821 )
11822 except ValueError as e:
11823 emit_structured_error(
11824 ERROR_CODE_CFG_INCONSISTENT_COMBO,
11825 key="restart",
11826 file_path=case_path,
11827 message=str(e),
11828 )
11829 sys.exit(1)
11830
11831 config_dir = os.path.join(run_dir, "config")
11832 scheduler_dir = os.path.join(run_dir, "scheduler")
11833 logs_dir = os.path.join(run_dir, "logs")
11834 solver_control_path = os.path.join(config_dir, f"{run_id}.control")
11835 profile_path = os.path.join(config_dir, "profile.run")
11836 profiling_preview = resolve_profiling_config(loaded_monitor_cfg)
11837
11838 plan["run_id_preview"] = run_id
11839 plan["run_dir_preview"] = run_dir
11840 plan["inputs"].update({"case": case_path, "solver": solver_path, "monitor": monitor_path})
11841 plan["artifacts"].extend(
11842 [
11843 run_dir,
11844 config_dir,
11845 logs_dir,
11846 os.path.join(run_dir, "output"),
11847 scheduler_dir,
11848 os.path.join(config_dir, "case.yml"),
11849 os.path.join(config_dir, "solver.yml"),
11850 os.path.join(config_dir, "monitor.yml"),
11851 solver_control_path,
11852 os.path.join(run_dir, "manifest.json"),
11853 ]
11854 )
11855 add_planned_grid_artifacts(plan, loaded_case_cfg, run_dir)
11856 add_planned_profile_artifacts(plan, loaded_case_cfg, run_dir)
11857 add_planned_initial_condition_artifacts(plan, loaded_case_cfg, solver_cfg, run_dir)
11858 if has_explicit_monitor_whitelist(loaded_monitor_cfg):
11859 plan["artifacts"].append(os.path.join(config_dir, "whitelist.run"))
11860 if profiling_preview["mode"] == "selected":
11861 plan["artifacts"].append(profile_path)
11862 solve_diagnostics = resolve_diagnostics_config(loaded_monitor_cfg, run_dir, "Solver")
11863 plan["artifacts"].extend(solve_diagnostics["artifacts"])
11864 if cluster_mode:
11865 plan["artifacts"].append(os.path.join(config_dir, "cluster.yml"))
11866 plan["artifacts"].append(os.path.join(scheduler_dir, "submission.json"))
11867
11868 solver_exe = resolve_runtime_executable("simulator")
11869 solver_args = build_petsc_diagnostics_args(loaded_monitor_cfg, run_dir, "Solver") + ["-control_file", solver_control_path]
11870 if cluster_mode:
11871 solver_script = os.path.join(scheduler_dir, "solver.sbatch")
11872 solver_cmd = build_cluster_launch_command(
11873 cluster_cfg,
11874 solver_exe,
11875 solver_args,
11876 config_search_anchor=case_path,
11877 extra_search_anchors=[cluster_path],
11878 )
11879 plan["artifacts"].append(solver_script)
11880 plan["stages"]["solve"] = {
11881 "mode": "slurm",
11882 "script": solver_script,
11883 "num_procs_effective": solver_num_procs_effective,
11884 "launch_command": solver_cmd,
11885 "launch_command_string": _command_to_string(solver_cmd),
11886 }
11887 else:
11888 solver_cmd = build_local_launch_command(
11889 solver_exe,
11890 solver_args,
11891 solver_num_procs_effective,
11892 config_search_anchor=case_path,
11893 )
11894 solver_stream_log = os.path.join(scheduler_dir, f"{run_id}_solver.log")
11895 plan["artifacts"].append(solver_stream_log)
11896 plan["stages"]["solve"] = {
11897 "mode": "local",
11898 "num_procs_effective": solver_num_procs_effective,
11899 "stream_log": solver_stream_log,
11900 "launch_command": solver_cmd,
11901 "launch_command_string": _command_to_string(solver_cmd),
11902 }
11903 if resolved_restart_source_dir:
11904 plan["stages"]["solve"]["restart_source_directory"] = resolved_restart_source_dir
11905 if is_continue:
11906 plan["stages"]["solve"]["continue_mode"] = True
11907
11908 if args.post_process:
11909 post_path = os.path.abspath(args.post)
11910 plan["inputs"]["post"] = post_path
11911 post_cfg = read_yaml_file(post_path)
11912 validate_post_config(post_cfg, post_path, loaded_monitor_cfg, loaded_case_cfg)
11913
11914 if args.run_dir:
11915 run_dir = os.path.abspath(args.run_dir)
11916 if not os.path.isdir(run_dir):
11917 emit_structured_error(
11918 ERROR_CODE_CFG_FILE_NOT_FOUND,
11919 key="run-dir",
11920 file_path=run_dir,
11921 message="Specified run directory not found.",
11922 )
11923 sys.exit(1)
11924 run_id = os.path.basename(run_dir)
11925 elif not args.solve:
11926 fail_cli_usage("--post-process requires --run-dir when not used with --solve.")
11927
11928 if args.run_dir:

11930 case_path, monitor_path, solver_control_path = auto_identify_run_inputs(config_dir)
11931 if not all([case_path, monitor_path, solver_control_path]):
11932 emit_structured_error(
11933 ERROR_CODE_CFG_MISSING_KEY,
11934 key="run_dir.config",
11935 file_path=config_dir,
11936 message=(
11937 "Could not auto-identify required run inputs "

11939 ),
11940 )
11941 sys.exit(1)
11942 loaded_case_cfg = read_yaml_file(case_path)
11943 loaded_monitor_cfg = read_yaml_file(monitor_path)
11944 else:
11945 config_dir = os.path.join(run_dir, "config")
11946 case_path = os.path.join(config_dir, "case.yml")
11947 monitor_path = os.path.join(config_dir, "monitor.yml")
11948 if solver_control_path is None:
11949 solver_control_path = os.path.join(config_dir, f"{run_id}.control")
11950
11951 allow_source_frontier_scan = not args.solve
11952 post_plan = build_post_execution_plan(
11953 run_dir,
11954 run_id,
11955 loaded_case_cfg,
11956 loaded_monitor_cfg,

11962 post_recipe_path = os.path.join(config_dir, "post.run")

11973 output_dir_abs = os.path.abspath(os.path.join(run_dir, output_dir_rel))
11974 statistics_output_paths = get_post_statistics_output_artifacts(post_cfg, run_dir, loaded_monitor_cfg)
11975 post_exe = resolve_runtime_executable("postprocessor")
11976 post_diagnostics = resolve_diagnostics_config(loaded_monitor_cfg, run_dir, "PostProcessor")
11977 plan["artifacts"].extend(post_diagnostics["artifacts"])
11978 post_args = build_petsc_diagnostics_args(loaded_monitor_cfg, run_dir, "PostProcessor") + [
11979 "-control_file",
11980 solver_control_path,
11981 "-postprocessing_config_file",
11982 post_recipe_path,
11983 ]
11984 plan["artifacts"].extend([
11985 post_recipe_path,
11986 output_dir_abs,
11987 post_plan["resume_state_path"],
11988 post_plan["lock_paths"]["wrapper_path"],
11989 post_plan["lock_paths"]["lock_file"],
11990 post_plan["lock_paths"]["metadata_file"],
11991 ])
11992 plan["artifacts"].extend(statistics_output_paths)
11993
11994 stage_meta = {
11995 "source_data_directory": post_plan["source_data_directory"],
11996 "requested_start_step": post_plan["requested_start_step"],
11997 "requested_end_step": post_plan["requested_end_step"],
11998 "step_interval": post_plan["step_interval"],
11999 "resume_applied": bool(post_plan["continue_requested"] and post_plan["resume_recipe_match"]),
12000 "resume_recipe_match": post_plan["resume_recipe_match"],
12001 "resume_bootstrapped": post_plan["resume_bootstrapped"],
12002 "resume_match_source": post_plan["resume_match_source"],
12003 "completed_frontier_step": post_plan["completed_frontier_step"],
12004 "source_frontier_step": post_plan["source_frontier_step"],
12005 "source_frontier_diagnostic": post_plan["source_frontier_diagnostic"],
12006 "source_frontier_deferred": post_plan["source_frontier_deferred"],
12007 "effective_start_step": post_plan["effective_start_step"],
12008 "effective_end_step": post_plan["effective_end_step"],
12009 "skip_reason": post_plan["skip_reason"],
12010 "post_skipped_as_complete": post_plan["skip_reason"] == "already-complete-window",
12011 "recipe_fingerprint": post_plan["recipe_fingerprint"],
12012 "num_procs_effective": post_num_procs_effective,
12013 }
12014
12015 if post_plan["skip_reason"] is None:
12016 if cluster_mode:
12017 scheduler_dir = os.path.join(run_dir, "scheduler")
12018 post_script = os.path.join(scheduler_dir, "post.sbatch")
12019 post_cluster_cfg = cluster_cfg
12020 raw_post_cmd = build_cluster_launch_command(
12021 post_cluster_cfg,
12022 post_exe,
12023 post_args,
12024 config_search_anchor=case_path,
12025 extra_search_anchors=[cluster_path],
12026 force_num_procs=post_num_procs_effective,
12027 )
12028 post_cmd, _ = build_post_locked_command(
12029 run_dir,
12030 post_plan["recipe_fingerprint"],
12031 raw_post_cmd,
12032 create_wrapper=False,
12033 )
12034 plan["artifacts"].append(post_script)
12035 stage_meta.update({
12036 "mode": "slurm",
12037 "script": post_script,
12038 "launch_command": post_cmd,
12039 "launch_command_string": _command_to_string(post_cmd),
12040 })
12041 else:
12042 raw_post_cmd = build_local_launch_command(
12043 post_exe,
12044 post_args,
12045 post_num_procs_effective,
12046 config_search_anchor=case_path,
12047 allow_single_rank_launcher_override=True,
12048 force_num_procs=post_num_procs_effective,
12049 )
12050 post_cmd, _ = build_post_locked_command(
12051 run_dir,
12052 post_plan["recipe_fingerprint"],
12053 raw_post_cmd,
12054 create_wrapper=False,
12055 )
12056 post_stream_log = os.path.join(run_dir, "scheduler", f"{run_id}_{output_prefix}.log")
12057 plan["artifacts"].append(post_stream_log)
12058 stage_meta.update({
12059 "mode": "local",
12060 "stream_log": post_stream_log,
12061 "launch_command": post_cmd,
12062 "launch_command_string": _command_to_string(post_cmd),
12063 })
12064 else:
12065 stage_meta.update({
12066 "mode": "slurm" if cluster_mode else "local",
12067 "launch_command": [],
12068 "launch_command_string": "",
12069 })
12070
12071 plan["stages"]["post-process"] = stage_meta
12072
12073 # Preserve insertion order while removing duplicates.
12074 deduped = []
12075 seen = set()
12076 for item in plan["artifacts"]:
12077 if item not in seen:
12078 seen.add(item)
12079 deduped.append(item)
12080 plan["artifacts"] = deduped
12081 if run_id and "run_id_preview" not in plan:
12082 plan["run_id_preview"] = run_id
12083 if run_dir and "run_dir_preview" not in plan:
12084 plan["run_dir_preview"] = run_dir
12085 plan["solver_num_procs_effective"] = solver_num_procs_effective
12086 plan["post_num_procs_effective"] = post_num_procs_effective
12087 plan["num_procs_effective"] = solver_num_procs_effective
12088 return plan

12091def add_planned_grid_artifacts(plan: dict, case_cfg: dict, run_dir: str) -> None:
12092 """!
12093 @brief Add grid-mode-specific staged artifacts to a dry-run plan.
12094 @param[in,out] plan Dry-run plan to update.
12095 @param[in] case_cfg Parsed case configuration.
12096 @param[in] run_dir Preview run directory for relative artifact resolution.
12097 """
12098 grid_cfg = case_cfg.get("grid", {})
12099 if not isinstance(grid_cfg, dict):
12100 return
12101
12102 mode = grid_cfg.get("mode")
12103 config_dir = os.path.join(run_dir, "config")
12104
12105 if mode == "file":
12106 plan["artifacts"].append(os.path.join(config_dir, "grid.run"))
12107 legacy_cfg = grid_cfg.get("legacy_conversion")
12108 if isinstance(legacy_cfg, dict) and legacy_cfg.get("enabled", True):
12109 output_file = legacy_cfg.get("output_file", os.path.join("config", "grid.converted.picgrid"))
12110 if isinstance(output_file, str) and output_file.strip():
12111 if not os.path.isabs(output_file):
12112 output_file = os.path.abspath(os.path.join(run_dir, output_file))
12113 plan["artifacts"].append(output_file)
12114 elif mode == "grid_gen":
12115 generator = grid_cfg.get("generator", {})
12116 if not isinstance(generator, dict):
12117 return
12118 plan["artifacts"].append(os.path.join(config_dir, "grid.run"))
12119 for key, default in (
12120 ("output_file", os.path.join("config", "grid.generated.picgrid")),
12121 ("stats_file", None),
12122 ("vts_file", None),
12123 ):
12124 artifact_path = generator.get(key, default)
12125 if isinstance(artifact_path, str) and artifact_path.strip():
12126 if not os.path.isabs(artifact_path):
12127 artifact_path = os.path.abspath(os.path.join(run_dir, artifact_path))
12128 plan["artifacts"].append(artifact_path)
12129
12130def add_planned_profile_artifacts(plan: dict, case_cfg: dict, run_dir: str) -> None:
12131 """!
12132 @brief Add generated prescribed-flow profile artifacts to a dry-run plan.
12133 @param[in,out] plan Dry-run plan to update.
12134 @param[in] case_cfg Parsed case configuration.
12135 @param[in] run_dir Preview run directory.
12136 """
12137 try:
12138 prepared_blocks = validate_and_prepare_boundary_conditions(case_cfg)
12139 except ValueError:
12140 return
12141 config_dir = os.path.join(run_dir, "config")
12142 has_generated = False
12143 for block_idx, block in enumerate(prepared_blocks):
12144 for bc in block:
12145 if bc.get("handler") != "prescribed_flow":
12146 continue
12147 source = (bc.get("params") or {}).get("source", {})
12148 if source.get("type") not in {"generated", "field_slice"}:
12149 continue
12150 has_generated = True
12151 face_token = _face_artifact_token(bc["face"])
12152 suffix = "generated" if source.get("type") == "generated" else "sliced"
12153 default_output = os.path.join(
12154 "config", f"inlet_profile_block{block_idx}_{face_token}.{suffix}.picslice"
12155 )
12156 generated_path = _resolve_run_artifact_path(
12157 run_dir,
12158 source.get("output_file"),
12159 default_output,
12160 default_to_config_dir=True,
12161 )
12162 staged_path = os.path.join(config_dir, f"inlet_profile_block{block_idx}_{face_token}.picslice")
12163 plan["artifacts"].append(generated_path)
12164 plan["artifacts"].append(staged_path)
12165 if has_generated:
12166 plan["artifacts"].append(os.path.join(config_dir, "profile.info"))
12167
12168def add_planned_initial_condition_artifacts(plan: dict, case_cfg: dict, solver_cfg: dict, run_dir: str) -> None:
12169 """!
12170 @brief Add authoritative file-backed initial-condition artifacts to a dry-run plan.
12171 @param[in,out] plan Dry-run plan receiving artifact paths.
12172 @param[in] case_cfg Parsed case configuration.
12173 @param[in] solver_cfg Parsed solver configuration.
12174 @param[in] run_dir Planned run directory.
12175 """
12176 source = normalize_eulerian_field_source(
12177 (solver_cfg.get("operation_mode", {}) or {}).get("eulerian_field_source", "solve")
12178 )
12179 start_step = int((case_cfg.get("run_control", {}) or {}).get("start_step", 0) or 0)
12180 if source != "solve" or start_step != 0:
12181 return
12182 try:
12183 fluid_scaling = resolve_fluid_scaling(case_cfg)
12184 resolved = resolve_initial_condition_config(
12185 (case_cfg.get("properties", {}) or {}).get("initial_conditions", {}),
12186 validate_and_prepare_boundary_conditions(case_cfg),
12187 U_ref=fluid_scaling["velocity_ref"],
12188 provider_context={"kinematic_viscosity": fluid_scaling["nondimensional_kinematic_viscosity"]},
12189 )
12190 except (KeyError, ValueError):
12191 return
12192 if resolved["kind"] != "file" and not is_generated_ic_provider(resolved):
12193 return
12194 config_dir = os.path.join(run_dir, "config")
12195 plan["artifacts"].append(
12196 os.path.join(config_dir, "initial_condition", f"{resolved['field_name']}00000_0.dat")
12197 )
12198 if is_generated_ic_provider(resolved):
12199 if (case_cfg.get("grid", {}) or {}).get("mode") == "programmatic_c":
12200 plan["artifacts"].append(os.path.join(config_dir, "grid.run"))
12201 plan["artifacts"].append(_resolve_run_artifact_path(
12202 run_dir, resolved.get("output_file"), os.path.join("config", "initial_condition.generated.dat"),
12203 default_to_config_dir=True,
12204 ))
12205 plan["artifacts"].extend(
12206 _resolve_run_artifact_path(run_dir, resolved.get(key), default)
12207 for key, default in GENERATED_IC_PROVIDERS[resolved["kind"]].get("diagnostic_artifacts", ())
12208 )
12209

12211def render_run_dry_plan(plan: dict, output_format: str = "text"):
12212 """!
12213 @brief Render dry-run plan in human or JSON format.
12214 @param[in] plan Argument passed to `render_run_dry_plan()`.
12215 @param[in] output_format Argument passed to `render_run_dry_plan()`.
12216 """
12217 if output_format == "json":
12218 print(json.dumps(plan, indent=2, sort_keys=True))
12219 return
12220
12221 print("\n" + "=" * 60)
12222 print(" DRY-RUN PLAN")
12223 print("=" * 60)
12224 print(f" Launch mode : {plan.get('launch_mode')}")
12225 print(f" Created at : {plan.get('created_at')}")
12226 if plan.get("run_id_preview"):
12227 print(f" Run ID preview : {plan.get('run_id_preview')}")
12228 if plan.get("run_dir_preview"):
12229 print(f" Run dir preview: {plan.get('run_dir_preview')}")
12230 print(f" Solver MPI procs: {plan.get('solver_num_procs_effective')}")
12231 print(f" Post MPI procs : {plan.get('post_num_procs_effective')}")
12232 if plan.get("warnings"):
12233 print(" Warnings :")
12234 for warning in plan["warnings"]:
12235 print(f" - {warning}")
12236
12237 if plan.get("inputs"):
12238 print("\n Inputs:")
12239 for key, value in plan["inputs"].items():
12240 print(f" - {key}: {value}")
12241
12242 if plan.get("stages"):
12243 print("\n Planned stage commands:")
12244 for stage, details in plan["stages"].items():
12245 print(f" - {stage} ({details.get('mode')}):")
12246 if details.get('skip_reason'):
12247 print(f" skipped: {details.get('skip_reason')}")
12248 else:
12249 print(f" {details.get('launch_command_string')}")
12250
12251 diagnostics_artifacts = [item for item in plan.get("artifacts", []) if "PETSc_" in os.path.basename(str(item)) or os.path.basename(str(item)) == "Runtime_Memory.log"]
12252 if diagnostics_artifacts:
12253 print("\n Diagnostics artifacts:")
12254 for artifact in diagnostics_artifacts:
12255 print(f" - {artifact}")
12256
12257 print("\n Planned artifacts (no files created in dry-run):")
12258 for artifact in plan.get("artifacts", []):
12259 print(f" - {artifact}")
12260 print("=" * 60)
12261

12263def validate_workflow(args):
12264 """!
12265 @brief Implements `picurv validate` without launching solver/post workflows.
12266 @param[in] args Command-line style argument list supplied to the function.
12267 """
12268 checked = []
12269 solver_group_selected = any([args.case, args.solver, args.monitor])
12270 any_group_selected = solver_group_selected or any([args.post, args.cluster, args.study])
12271 case_path = None
12272 cluster_path = None
12273
12274 if not any_group_selected:
12275 fail_cli_usage(
12276 "validate requires at least one config group. Provide solver trio and/or --post/--cluster/--study.",
12277 hint="Example: picurv validate --case case.yml --solver solver.yml --monitor monitor.yml --post post.yml",
12278 )
12279
12280 if solver_group_selected and not all([args.case, args.solver, args.monitor]):
12281 fail_cli_usage("When solver validation is requested, --case, --solver, and --monitor are all required.")
12282
12283 # --- Guard: restart flags without solver group ---
12284 restart_from = getattr(args, 'restart_from', None)
12285 continue_run = getattr(args, 'continue_run', False)
12286 run_dir_val = getattr(args, 'run_dir', None)
12287 if not solver_group_selected:
12288 if restart_from:
12289 print("[WARNING] --restart-from has no effect without --case/--solver/--monitor and will be ignored.", file=sys.stderr)
12290 if continue_run and not args.post:
12291 print("[WARNING] --continue has no effect without solver configs or --post and will be ignored.", file=sys.stderr)
12292 if continue_run and not run_dir_val:
12293 fail_cli_usage(RESTART_RUN_DIR_REQUIRED_MESSAGE)
12294
12295 monitor_cfg = None
12296 case_cfg = None
12297 if solver_group_selected:
12298 case_path = os.path.abspath(args.case)
12299 solver_path = os.path.abspath(args.solver)
12300 monitor_path = os.path.abspath(args.monitor)
12301 case_cfg = read_yaml_file(case_path)
12302 solver_cfg = read_yaml_file(solver_path)
12303 monitor_cfg = read_yaml_file(monitor_path)
12304 validate_simulation_configs(case_cfg, solver_cfg, monitor_cfg, case_path, solver_path, monitor_path)
12305 checked.extend([case_path, solver_path, monitor_path])
12306
12307 # Validate restart flags if provided
12308 if restart_from or continue_run:
12309 target_run_dir = os.path.abspath(run_dir_val) if run_dir_val else os.path.abspath("runs/_validate_dummy")
12310 try:
12311 resolve_restart_source(args, case_cfg, solver_cfg, monitor_cfg, target_run_dir)
12312 print("[SUCCESS] Restart source validation passed.")
12313 except ValueError as e:
12314 print(f"[ERROR] Restart validation failed: {e}", file=sys.stderr)
12315 sys.exit(1)
12316
12317 post_cfg = None
12318 if args.post:
12319 post_path = os.path.abspath(args.post)
12320 post_cfg = read_yaml_file(post_path)
12321 validate_post_config(post_cfg, post_path, monitor_cfg, case_cfg)
12322 checked.append(post_path)
12323
12324 cluster_cfg = None
12325 if args.cluster:
12326 cluster_path = os.path.abspath(args.cluster)
12327 cluster_cfg = read_yaml_file(cluster_path)
12328 validate_cluster_config(cluster_cfg, cluster_path)
12329 checked.append(cluster_path)
12330
12331 try:
12332 runtime_execution_path, _ = load_runtime_execution_config(
12333 case_path,
12334 extra_search_anchors=[cluster_path] if cluster_path else None,
12335 )
12336 except ValueError as exc:
12337 emit_structured_error(
12338 ERROR_CODE_CFG_INVALID_VALUE,
12339 key="runtime_execution",
12340 file_path=case_path or cluster_path or os.getcwd(),
12341 message=str(exc),
12342 )
12343 sys.exit(1)
12344 if runtime_execution_path:
12345 checked.append(runtime_execution_path)
12346
12347 study_cfg = None
12348 if args.study:
12349 study_path = os.path.abspath(args.study)
12350 study_cfg = read_yaml_file(study_path)
12351 validate_study_config(study_cfg, study_path)
12352 checked.append(study_path)
12353
12354 if post_cfg is not None and run_dir_val:
12355 post_path = os.path.abspath(args.post)
12356 validate_run_dir = os.path.abspath(run_dir_val)
12357 if os.path.isdir(validate_run_dir):
12358 monitor_for_post = monitor_cfg if solver_group_selected else None
12359 if monitor_for_post is None:
12360 config_dir_candidate = os.path.join(validate_run_dir, "config")
12361 monitor_candidate = os.path.join(config_dir_candidate, "monitor.yml")
12362 if os.path.isfile(monitor_candidate):
12363 monitor_for_post = read_yaml_file(monitor_candidate)
12364 if monitor_for_post is not None:
12365 resolved_source = _resolve_post_source_directory_preview(validate_run_dir, monitor_for_post, post_cfg)
12366 if os.path.isdir(resolved_source) and os.listdir(resolved_source):
12367 print(f"[SUCCESS] Post-processor source data directory exists: {resolved_source}")
12368 else:
12369 print(f"[WARNING] Post-processor source data directory is missing or empty: {resolved_source}", file=sys.stderr)
12370
12371 if args.strict and post_cfg is not None:
12372 post_path = os.path.abspath(args.post)
12373 source_dir = post_cfg.get("source_data", {}).get("directory")
12374 if source_dir and source_dir != "<solver_output_dir>":
12375 resolved = resolve_path(post_path, source_dir)
12376 if not os.path.isdir(resolved):
12377 emit_structured_error(
12378 ERROR_CODE_CFG_FILE_NOT_FOUND,
12379 key="source_data.directory",
12380 file_path=post_path,
12381 message=f"strict mode: source_data.directory resolves to missing directory '{resolved}'.",
12382 )
12383 sys.exit(1)
12384
12385 if args.strict and study_cfg is not None:
12386 study_path = os.path.abspath(args.study)
12387 base_cfgs = study_cfg.get("base_configs", {})
12388 if isinstance(base_cfgs, dict):
12389 base_case_path = resolve_path(study_path, base_cfgs.get("case"))
12390 base_solver_path = resolve_path(study_path, base_cfgs.get("solver"))
12391 base_monitor_path = resolve_path(study_path, base_cfgs.get("monitor"))
12392 base_post_path = resolve_path(study_path, base_cfgs.get("post"))
12393 if all([base_case_path, base_solver_path, base_monitor_path]):
12394 validate_simulation_configs(
12395 read_yaml_file(base_case_path),
12396 read_yaml_file(base_solver_path),
12397 read_yaml_file(base_monitor_path),
12398 base_case_path,
12399 base_solver_path,
12400 base_monitor_path,
12401 )
12402 if base_post_path:
12403 validate_post_config(read_yaml_file(base_post_path), base_post_path,
12404 read_yaml_file(base_monitor_path) if base_monitor_path else None,
12405 read_yaml_file(base_case_path) if base_case_path else None)
12406
12407 print(f"[SUCCESS] Validation completed for {len(checked)} file(s).")
12408 for path in checked:
12409 print(f" - {path}")

12411def precompute_workflow(args):
12412 """!
12413 @brief Generate deterministic case artifacts without launching solver/post stages.
12414 @param[in] args Parsed precompute command arguments.
12415 """
12416 case_path = os.path.abspath(args.case)
12417 case_cfg = read_yaml_file(case_path)
12418 case_name = os.path.splitext(os.path.basename(case_path))[0]
12419 output_dir = args.output_dir or os.path.join("precomputed", case_name)
12420 output_dir = os.path.abspath(output_dir)
12421 config_dir = os.path.join(output_dir, "config")
12422 os.makedirs(config_dir, exist_ok=True)
12423
12424 print(f"[INFO] Precomputing deterministic artifacts for case: {case_path}")
12425 print(f"[INFO] Output directory: {output_dir}")
12426 validate_and_prepare_boundary_conditions(case_cfg)
12427
12428 artifacts = []
12429 grid_cfg = case_cfg.get("grid", {}) or {}
12430 grid_mode = grid_cfg.get("mode")
12431 scaling = (case_cfg.get("properties", {}) or {}).get("scaling", {}) or {}
12432 length_ref = float(scaling.get("length_ref", 1.0))
12433 expected_nblk = int((case_cfg.get("models", {}) or {}).get("domain", {}).get("blocks", 1))
12434 staged_grid = os.path.join(config_dir, "grid.run")
12435 if grid_mode == "grid_gen":
12436 print("[INFO] Precomputing grid via grid.gen...")
12437 generated_grid = run_grid_generator(case_path, output_dir, grid_cfg)
12438 artifacts.append(os.path.abspath(generated_grid))
12439 validate_and_nondimensionalize_picgrid(generated_grid, staged_grid, length_ref, expected_nblk=expected_nblk)
12440 artifacts.append(os.path.abspath(staged_grid))
12441 elif grid_mode == "file":
12442 source_grid = _resolve_case_relative_path(grid_cfg.get("source_file"), os.path.dirname(case_path))
12443 if isinstance(grid_cfg.get("legacy_conversion"), dict):
12444 source_grid = convert_legacy_grid_with_gridgen(case_path, output_dir, grid_cfg, source_grid)
12445 validate_and_nondimensionalize_picgrid(source_grid, staged_grid, length_ref, expected_nblk=expected_nblk)
12446 artifacts.append(os.path.abspath(staged_grid))
12447 print(f"[INFO] Precomputed validated file grid: {staged_grid}")
12448 elif grid_mode == "programmatic_c":
12449 print(f"[INFO] Grid mode '{grid_mode}' does not require precomputed grid generation.")
12450 else:
12451 raise ValueError(f"Unsupported grid.mode '{grid_mode}' for precompute.")
12452
12453 profile_summaries = materialize_generated_prescribed_flow_profiles(output_dir, case_cfg, case_path)
12454 artifacts.extend(summary["path"] for summary in profile_summaries)
12455 if profile_summaries:
12456 artifacts.append(os.path.join(config_dir, "profile.info"))
12457
12458 initial_condition = None
12459 fluid_scaling = resolve_fluid_scaling(case_cfg)
12460 resolved_ic = resolve_initial_condition_config(
12461 (case_cfg.get("properties", {}) or {}).get("initial_conditions", {}),
12462 validate_and_prepare_boundary_conditions(case_cfg),
12463 U_ref=fluid_scaling["velocity_ref"],
12464 provider_context={"kinematic_viscosity": fluid_scaling["nondimensional_kinematic_viscosity"]},
12465 )
12466 if is_generated_ic_provider(resolved_ic):
12467 if grid_mode == "programmatic_c":
12468 try:
12469 summary = generate_picgrid_from_programmatic_settings(
12470 grid_cfg.get('programmatic_settings', {}), staged_grid, length_ref
12471 )
12472 artifacts.append(os.path.abspath(staged_grid))
12473 print(
12474 f"[INFO] Materialized programmatic grid.run for generated IC: {staged_grid} "
12475 f"(nblk={summary['nblk']}, total_nodes={summary['total_nodes']})"
12476 )
12477 except Exception as e:
12478 raise RuntimeError(f"Failed to generate grid.run for generated IC: {e}") from e
12479 initial_condition = stage_initial_condition_file(output_dir, case_path, resolved_ic)
12480 artifacts.extend([initial_condition["source"], initial_condition["staged"]])
12481 artifacts.extend(initial_condition.get("diagnostics", []))
12482 elif resolved_ic["kind"] == "file":
12483 print("[INFO] File initial condition does not require generated precompute output.")
12484 else:
12485 print(f"[INFO] Built-in initial-condition generator '{resolved_ic['label']}' runs in the C solver.")
12486
12487 manifest = {
12488 "case": case_path,
12489 "output_dir": output_dir,
12490 "grid_mode": grid_mode,
12491 "artifacts": artifacts,
12492 "profiles": profile_summaries,
12493 "initial_condition": initial_condition,
12494 }
12495 manifest_path = os.path.join(config_dir, "precompute.manifest.json")
12496 write_json_file(manifest_path, manifest)
12497 print(f"[SUCCESS] Wrote precompute manifest: {os.path.relpath(manifest_path)}")
12498 print(f"[SUCCESS] Precompute completed with {len(artifacts)} artifact(s).")
12499
12500def run_workflow(args):
12501 """!
12502 @brief Main orchestrator for the 'run' command (local and Slurm modes).
12503 @param[in] args Command-line style argument list supplied to the function.
12504 """
12505 if getattr(args, "dry_run", False):
12506 plan = build_run_dry_plan(args)
12507 render_run_dry_plan(plan, output_format=getattr(args, "output_format", "text"))
12508 return
12509
12510 run_dir = None
12511 run_id = None
12512 output_dir_abs = None
12513 statistics_output_paths = []
12514 workflow_start = time.time()
12515 stages_completed = []
12516 configs = None
12517 submission_meta = {"launch_mode": "local", "no_submit": bool(args.no_submit), "stages": {}}
12518
12519 cluster_mode = bool(getattr(args, "cluster", None))
12520 cluster_cfg = None
12521 cluster_path = None
12522 solver_num_procs_effective = args.num_procs
12523 post_num_procs_effective = args.num_procs
12524
12525 if cluster_mode:
12526 cluster_path = os.path.abspath(args.cluster)
12527 cluster_cfg = read_yaml_file(cluster_path)
12528 validate_cluster_config(cluster_cfg, cluster_path)
12529 scheduler_type = str(cluster_cfg.get("scheduler", {}).get("type", "slurm")).lower()
12530 if args.scheduler and args.scheduler.lower() != scheduler_type:
12531 print(
12532 f"[FATAL] --scheduler={args.scheduler} does not match cluster.yml scheduler.type={scheduler_type}.",
12533 file=sys.stderr
12534 )
12535 sys.exit(1)
12536 if scheduler_type != "slurm":
12537 print(f"[FATAL] Unsupported scheduler '{scheduler_type}'. Only Slurm is supported in v1.", file=sys.stderr)
12538 sys.exit(1)
12539 cluster_tasks = get_cluster_total_tasks(cluster_cfg)
12540 if (args.solve or args.post_process) and args.num_procs not in (1, cluster_tasks):
12541 print(
12542 "[FATAL] In cluster mode, --num-procs must be "
12543 f"1 (auto) or exactly nodes*ntasks_per_node ({cluster_tasks}).",
12544 file=sys.stderr
12545 )
12546 sys.exit(1)
12547 if args.solve:
12548 solver_num_procs_effective = cluster_tasks
12549 if args.post_process:
12550 post_num_procs_effective = cluster_tasks
12551 submission_meta["launch_mode"] = "slurm"
12552 submission_meta["cluster_config"] = cluster_path
12553 submission_meta["no_submit"] = bool(args.no_submit)
12554 if args.solve and args.post_process:
12555 print(
12556 f"[INFO] Cluster mode enabled (Slurm). Solver and post stages use "
12557 f"{solver_num_procs_effective} MPI tasks from cluster.yml."
12558 )
12559 elif args.solve:
12560 print(f"[INFO] Cluster mode enabled (Slurm). Solver uses {solver_num_procs_effective} MPI tasks from cluster.yml.")
12561 else:
12562 print(f"[INFO] Cluster mode enabled (Slurm). Post stage uses {post_num_procs_effective} MPI tasks from cluster.yml.")
12563 elif getattr(args, "scheduler", None):
12564 print("[FATAL] --scheduler requires --cluster in this version.", file=sys.stderr)
12565 sys.exit(1)
12566
12567 # --- Guard: restart flags without --solve ---
12568 if not args.solve:
12569 if getattr(args, 'restart_from', None):
12570 print("[WARNING] --restart-from has no effect without --solve and will be ignored.", file=sys.stderr)
12571 if getattr(args, 'continue_run', False) and not args.post_process:
12572 print("[WARNING] --continue has no effect without --solve or --post-process and will be ignored.", file=sys.stderr)
12573
12574 # --- Stage 1: Solver (if requested) ---
12575 if args.solve:
12576 walltime_guard_policy = resolve_walltime_guard_policy(cluster_cfg) if cluster_mode else None
12577 configs = {
12578 'case': read_yaml_file(args.case), 'case_path': os.path.abspath(args.case),
12579 'solver': read_yaml_file(args.solver), 'solver_path': os.path.abspath(args.solver),
12580 'monitor': read_yaml_file(args.monitor), 'monitor_path': os.path.abspath(args.monitor),
12581 'walltime_guard_policy': walltime_guard_policy,
12582 }
12583
12584 print("\n[INFO] Validating configuration files...")
12585 validate_simulation_configs(
12586 configs['case'], configs['solver'], configs['monitor'],
12587 args.case, args.solver, args.monitor
12588 )
12589 print("[SUCCESS] All configuration files passed validation.\n")
12590
12591 continue_mode = getattr(args, 'continue_run', False)
12592
12593 if continue_mode:
12594 if not args.run_dir:
12595 fail_cli_usage(RESTART_RUN_DIR_REQUIRED_MESSAGE)
12596 run_dir = os.path.abspath(args.run_dir)
12597 if not os.path.isdir(run_dir):
12598 emit_structured_error(
12599 ERROR_CODE_CFG_FILE_NOT_FOUND,
12600 key="run-dir",
12601 file_path=run_dir,
12602 message="Specified run directory not found.",
12603 )
12604 sys.exit(1)
12605 run_id = os.path.basename(run_dir)
12606 else:
12607 case_name = os.path.splitext(os.path.basename(args.case))[0]
12608 timestamp = datetime.now().strftime("%Y%m%d-%H%M%S")
12609 run_id = f"{case_name}_{timestamp}"
12610 run_dir = os.path.abspath(os.path.join("runs", run_id))
12611
12612 try:
12613 resolved_restart_source_dir, is_continue = resolve_restart_source(
12614 args, configs["case"], configs["solver"], configs["monitor"], run_dir
12615 )
12616 except ValueError as e:
12617 emit_structured_error(
12618 ERROR_CODE_CFG_INCONSISTENT_COMBO,
12619 key="restart",
12620 file_path=args.case,
12621 message=str(e),
12622 )
12623 sys.exit(1)
12624
12625 config_dir = os.path.join(run_dir, "config")
12626 if not continue_mode:
12627 for d in [config_dir, os.path.join(run_dir, "scheduler")]:
12628 os.makedirs(d, exist_ok=True)
12629 else:
12630 os.makedirs(config_dir, exist_ok=True)
12631 if continue_mode:
12632 print(f"[INFO] Continuing in existing run directory: {os.path.relpath(run_dir)}")
12633 else:
12634 print(f"[INFO] Created new self-contained run directory: {os.path.relpath(run_dir)}")
12635
12636 shutil.copy(args.case, os.path.join(config_dir, "case.yml"))
12637 shutil.copy(args.solver, os.path.join(config_dir, "solver.yml"))
12638 shutil.copy(args.monitor, os.path.join(config_dir, "monitor.yml"))
12639 if cluster_mode:
12640 shutil.copy(cluster_path, os.path.join(config_dir, "cluster.yml"))
12641
12642 print("\n" + "="*25 + " SOLVER STAGE " + "="*25)
12643 source_files = {'Case': args.case, 'Solver': args.solver, 'Monitor': args.monitor}
12644 monitor_files = prepare_monitor_files(run_dir, run_id, configs['monitor'], source_files)
12645 if resolved_restart_source_dir:
12646 print(f"[INFO] Restart source: {resolved_restart_source_dir}")
12647 if is_continue:
12648 print("[INFO] Continue mode: logs will be appended, not overwritten.")
12649 control_file = generate_solver_control_file(
12650 run_dir,
12651 run_id,
12652 configs,
12653 solver_num_procs_effective,
12654 monitor_files,
12655 restart_source_dir=resolved_restart_source_dir,
12656 continue_mode=is_continue,
12657 )
12658
12659 solver_exe = resolve_runtime_executable("simulator")
12660 solver_args = build_petsc_diagnostics_args(configs["monitor"], run_dir, "Solver") + ["-control_file", control_file]
12661 if cluster_mode:
12662 scheduler_dir = os.path.join(run_dir, "scheduler")
12663 solver_script = os.path.join(scheduler_dir, "solver.sbatch")
12664 solver_log = os.path.join(scheduler_dir, "solver_%j.out")
12665 solver_err = os.path.join(scheduler_dir, "solver_%j.err")
12666 solver_cmd = build_cluster_launch_command(
12667 cluster_cfg,
12668 solver_exe,
12669 solver_args,
12670 config_search_anchor=args.case,
12671 extra_search_anchors=[cluster_path],
12672 )
12673 render_slurm_script(
12674 solver_script,
12675 f"{run_id}_solve",
12676 cluster_cfg,
12677 solver_cmd,
12678 run_dir,
12679 solver_log,
12680 solver_err,
12681 env_vars={"LOG_LEVEL": configs['monitor'].get('logging', {}).get('verbosity', 'INFO').upper()},
12682 shell_env_vars=build_walltime_guard_exports(cluster_cfg),
12683 )
12684 submission_meta["stages"]["solve"] = {
12685 "script": solver_script,
12686 "submitted": False,

13072def parse_case_index_tsv(tsv_path: str) -> list:
13073 """!
13074 @brief Parse a case_index.tsv file back into a list of case entry dicts.
13075 @param[in] tsv_path Path to the case_index.tsv file.
13076 @return List of dicts with keys: index, case_id, run_dir, control_file,
13077 post_recipe_file, log_level, post_prefix.
13078 """
13079 entries = []
13080 with open(tsv_path) as f:
13081 for line in f:
13082 line = line.strip()
13083 if not line:
13084 continue
13085 parts = line.split("\t")
13086 entries.append({
13087 "index": int(parts[0]),
13088 "case_id": parts[1],
13089 "run_dir": parts[2],
13090 "control_file": parts[3],
13091 "post_recipe_file": parts[4],
13092 "log_level": parts[5],
13093 "post_prefix": parts[6],
13094 })
13095 return entries
13096

13098def sweep_workflow(args):
13099 """!
13100 @brief Study/sweep orchestration using Slurm job arrays.
13101 @param[in] args Command-line style argument list supplied to the function.
13102 """
13103 study_path = os.path.abspath(args.study)
13104 cluster_path = os.path.abspath(args.cluster)
13105
13106 study_cfg = read_yaml_file(study_path)
13107 cluster_cfg = read_yaml_file(cluster_path)
13108 validate_study_config(study_cfg, study_path)
13109 validate_cluster_config(cluster_cfg, cluster_path)
13110
13111 study_name = os.path.splitext(os.path.basename(study_path))[0]
13112 timestamp = datetime.now().strftime("%Y%m%d-%H%M%S")
13113 study_id = f"{study_name}_{timestamp}"
13114 study_dir = os.path.abspath(os.path.join("studies", study_id))
13115 cases_dir = os.path.join(study_dir, "cases")
13116 scheduler_dir = os.path.join(study_dir, "scheduler")
13117 results_dir = os.path.join(study_dir, "results")
13118 for path in [cases_dir, scheduler_dir, results_dir]:
13119 os.makedirs(path, exist_ok=True)
13120
13121 print(f"[INFO] Creating study directory: {os.path.relpath(study_dir)}")
13122 shutil.copy(study_path, os.path.join(study_dir, "study.yml"))
13123 shutil.copy(cluster_path, os.path.join(study_dir, "cluster.yml"))
13124
13125 base_cfgs = study_cfg["base_configs"]
13126 base_paths = {k: resolve_path(study_path, v) for k, v in base_cfgs.items()}
13127 base_case = read_yaml_file(base_paths["case"])
13128 base_solver = read_yaml_file(base_paths["solver"])
13129 base_monitor = read_yaml_file(base_paths["monitor"])
13130 base_post = read_yaml_file(base_paths["post"])
13131 validate_simulation_configs(base_case, base_solver, base_monitor, base_paths["case"], base_paths["solver"], base_paths["monitor"])
13132 validate_post_config(base_post, base_paths["post"], base_monitor, base_case)
13133
13134 combinations = expand_study_parameter_combinations(study_cfg)
13135 if not combinations:
13136 print("[FATAL] Study parameter matrix expanded to zero cases.", file=sys.stderr)
13137 sys.exit(1)
13138 print(f"[INFO] Expanded sweep matrix to {len(combinations)} case(s).")
13139
13140 cluster_tasks = get_cluster_total_tasks(cluster_cfg)
13141 case_entries = []
13142 case_index_file = os.path.join(scheduler_dir, "case_index.tsv")
13143
13144 for idx, combo in enumerate(combinations):
13145 case_id = f"case_{idx:04d}"
13146 run_dir = os.path.join(cases_dir, case_id)
13147 config_dir = os.path.join(run_dir, "config")
13148 os.makedirs(config_dir, exist_ok=True)
13149 os.makedirs(os.path.join(run_dir, "logs"), exist_ok=True)
13150 os.makedirs(os.path.join(run_dir, "output"), exist_ok=True)
13151
13152 case_cfg = copy.deepcopy(base_case)
13153 solver_cfg = copy.deepcopy(base_solver)
13154 monitor_cfg = copy.deepcopy(base_monitor)
13155 post_cfg = copy.deepcopy(base_post)
13156 target_map = {"case": case_cfg, "solver": solver_cfg, "monitor": monitor_cfg, "post": post_cfg}
13157 for full_key, value in combo.items():
13158 root, nested = full_key.split(".", 1)
13159 _deep_set(target_map[root], nested, value)
13160
13161 # Preserve file-based/grid-gen workflows when study cases are materialized
13162 # into new directories by rewriting external paths as absolute.
13163 absolutize_case_external_paths(case_cfg, base_paths["case"])
13164
13165 case_path = os.path.join(config_dir, "case.yml")
13166 solver_path = os.path.join(config_dir, "solver.yml")

13205 })

13210 "\t".join(
13211 [

13217 entry["log_level"],
13218 entry["post_prefix"],
13219 entry["solve_diagnostic_args"],
13220 entry["post_diagnostic_args"],
13221 ]
13222 ) + "\n"
13223 )

13233 post_exe = resolve_runtime_executable("postprocessor")

13235 post_array_script = os.path.join(scheduler_dir, "post_array.sbatch")

13336def sweep_continue_workflow(args):
13337 """!
13338 @brief Continue a partially-completed Slurm parameter sweep study.
13339 @details Detects incomplete cases, prepares them for continuation (updating
13340 start_step, populating restart directories, regenerating control files),
13341 and submits new solver/post/metrics Slurm jobs. If all cases are already
13342 complete, performs metrics aggregation automatically.
13343 @param[in] args Parsed CLI arguments with study_dir and optional cluster override.
13344 """
13345 study_dir = os.path.abspath(args.study_dir)
13346 manifest_path = os.path.join(study_dir, "study_manifest.json")
13347 if not os.path.isfile(manifest_path):
13348 print(f"[FATAL] Study manifest not found: {manifest_path}", file=sys.stderr)
13349 sys.exit(1)
13350 manifest = _read_json_if_exists(manifest_path)
13351 study_id = manifest["study_id"]
13352
13353 study_path = os.path.join(study_dir, "study.yml")
13354 cluster_path = os.path.abspath(args.cluster) if args.cluster else os.path.join(study_dir, "cluster.yml")
13355 study_cfg = read_yaml_file(study_path)
13356 cluster_cfg = read_yaml_file(cluster_path)
13357 validate_study_config(study_cfg, study_path, skip_base_file_check=True)
13358 validate_cluster_config(cluster_cfg, cluster_path)
13359
13360 if args.cluster:
13361 shutil.copy(os.path.abspath(args.cluster), os.path.join(study_dir, "cluster.yml"))
13362 print(f"[INFO] Updated study cluster config from: {os.path.relpath(args.cluster)}")
13363
13364 scheduler_dir = os.path.join(study_dir, "scheduler")
13365 cases_dir = os.path.join(study_dir, "cases")
13366 results_dir = os.path.join(study_dir, "results")
13367 case_index_file = os.path.join(scheduler_dir, "case_index.tsv")
13368 if not os.path.isfile(case_index_file):
13369 print(f"[FATAL] Case index not found: {case_index_file}", file=sys.stderr)
13370 sys.exit(1)
13371
13372 parsed_entries = parse_case_index_tsv(case_index_file)
13373
13374 base_cfgs = study_cfg["base_configs"]
13375 base_paths = {k: resolve_path(study_path, v) for k, v in base_cfgs.items()}
13376 base_case = read_yaml_file(base_paths["case"])
13377
13378 combinations = expand_study_parameter_combinations(study_cfg)
13379 if len(combinations) != len(parsed_entries):
13380 print(
13381 f"[FATAL] Parameter matrix ({len(combinations)} cases) does not match "
13382 f"case_index.tsv ({len(parsed_entries)} entries).",
13383 file=sys.stderr,
13384 )
13385 sys.exit(1)
13386
13387 print(f"\n[INFO] Study: {study_id}")
13388 print(f"[INFO] Scanning {len(combinations)} case(s) for completion status...")
13389
13390 incomplete_indices = []
13391 all_case_entries = []
13392 for idx, combo in enumerate(combinations):
13393 case_id = f"case_{idx:04d}"
13394 entry = parsed_entries[idx]
13395 entry["parameters"] = combo
13396 run_dir = entry["run_dir"]
13397
13398 effective_case = copy.deepcopy(base_case)
13399 for full_key, value in combo.items():
13400 root, nested = full_key.split(".", 1)
13401 if root == "case":
13402 _deep_set(effective_case, nested, value)
13403 try:
13404 eff_start = int(effective_case.get("run_control", {}).get("start_step", 0) or 0)
13405 except (TypeError, ValueError):
13406 eff_start = 0
13407 eff_total = int(effective_case["run_control"]["total_steps"])
13408 target = eff_start + eff_total
13409
13410 monitor_cfg = read_yaml_file(os.path.join(run_dir, "config", "monitor.yml"))
13411 status = detect_case_completion_status(run_dir, monitor_cfg, target)
13412 entry["_status"] = status
13413
13414 if status["status"] == "complete":
13415 print(f" {case_id}: complete (step {status['last_step']}/{target})")
13416 elif status["status"] == "partial":
13417 print(f" {case_id}: incomplete (step {status['last_step']}/{target}) — will continue")
13418 incomplete_indices.append(idx)
13419 else:
13420 print(f" {case_id}: no checkpoint — will re-run from scratch")
13421 incomplete_indices.append(idx)
13422
13423 all_case_entries.append(entry)
13424
13425 if not incomplete_indices:
13426 print("\n[INFO] All cases are complete. Running metrics aggregation...")
13427 metrics_csv = aggregate_study_metrics(study_cfg, all_case_entries, results_dir)
13428 plots = generate_study_plots(study_cfg, metrics_csv, os.path.join(results_dir, "plots"))
13429 print("\n" + "=" * 60)
13430 print(" STUDY CONTINUATION SUMMARY")
13431 print("=" * 60)
13432 print(f" Study ID : {study_id}")
13433 print(f" Status : ALL COMPLETE")
13434 if metrics_csv:
13435 print(f" Metrics table : {os.path.relpath(metrics_csv)}")
13436 if plots:
13437 print(f" Plots : {os.path.relpath(os.path.join(results_dir, 'plots'))}")
13438 print("=" * 60)
13439 return
13440
13441 print(f"\n[INFO] {len(incomplete_indices)} incomplete case(s) to continue/re-run.")
13442
13443 skipped = []
13444 for idx in incomplete_indices:
13445 entry = all_case_entries[idx]
13446 status = entry["_status"]
13447 if status["status"] == "partial":
13448 prepare_case_for_continuation(
13449 entry["run_dir"], entry["case_id"],
13450 status["last_step"], status["target_step"],
13451 cluster_cfg,
13452 )
13453 elif status["status"] == "empty":
13454 print(f"[INFO] {entry['case_id']}: re-running from scratch (no control file changes)")
13455
13456 solver_array_spec = ",".join(str(i) for i in incomplete_indices)
13457 max_conc = study_cfg.get("execution", {}).get("max_concurrent_array_tasks")
13458 if max_conc:
13459 solver_array_spec = f"{solver_array_spec}%{max_conc}"
13460
13461 max_idx = len(combinations) - 1
13462 post_array_spec = f"0-{max_idx}"
13463 if max_conc:
13464 post_array_spec = f"{post_array_spec}%{max_conc}"
13465
13466 solver_exe = resolve_runtime_executable("simulator")
13467 post_exe = resolve_runtime_executable("postprocessor")
13468
13469 solver_continue_script = os.path.join(scheduler_dir, "solver_continue_array.sbatch")
13470 post_continue_script = os.path.join(scheduler_dir, "post_continue_array.sbatch")
13471 render_slurm_array_stage_script(
13472 solver_continue_script,
13473 f"{study_id}_solve_cont",
13474 cluster_cfg,
13475 solver_array_spec,
13476 case_index_file,
13477 "solve",
13478 solver_exe, post_exe,
13479 os.path.join(scheduler_dir, "solver_cont_%A_%a.out"),
13480 os.path.join(scheduler_dir, "solver_cont_%A_%a.err"),
13481 )
13482 render_slurm_array_stage_script(
13483 post_continue_script,
13484 f"{study_id}_post_cont",
13485 cluster_cfg,
13486 post_array_spec,
13487 case_index_file,
13488 "post",
13489 solver_exe, post_exe,
13490 os.path.join(scheduler_dir, "post_cont_%A_%a.out"),
13491 os.path.join(scheduler_dir, "post_cont_%A_%a.err"),
13492 )
13493
13494 picurv_path = os.path.abspath(os.path.join(INVOKED_SCRIPT_DIR, "picurv"))
13495 metrics_aggregate_script = os.path.join(scheduler_dir, "metrics_continue_aggregate.sbatch")
13496 render_metrics_aggregate_script(
13497 metrics_aggregate_script,
13498 f"{study_id}_metrics_cont",
13499 cluster_cfg,
13500 study_dir,
13501 picurv_path,
13502 )
13503 print(f"[SUCCESS] Generated continuation scripts in {os.path.relpath(scheduler_dir)}")
13504
13505 submission = {
13506 "launch_mode": "slurm",
13507 "study_id": study_id,
13508 "continuation": True,
13509 "incomplete_cases": [all_case_entries[i]["case_id"] for i in incomplete_indices],
13510 "solver_continue_array": {"script": solver_continue_script, "submitted": False},
13511 "post_continue_array": {"script": post_continue_script, "submitted": False},
13512 "metrics_aggregate": {"script": metrics_aggregate_script, "submitted": False},
13513 "no_submit": bool(args.no_submit),
13514 }
13515 if not args.no_submit:
13516 solver_submit = submit_sbatch(solver_continue_script)
13517 submission["solver_continue_array"].update(solver_submit)
13518 submission["solver_continue_array"]["submitted"] = True
13519 post_submit = submit_sbatch(post_continue_script, dependency=solver_submit["job_id"])
13520 submission["post_continue_array"].update(post_submit)
13521 submission["post_continue_array"]["submitted"] = True
13522 submission["post_continue_array"]["dependency"] = f"afterok:{solver_submit['job_id']}"
13523 metrics_submit = submit_sbatch(metrics_aggregate_script, dependency=post_submit["job_id"], dependency_type="afterany")
13524 submission["metrics_aggregate"].update(metrics_submit)
13525 submission["metrics_aggregate"]["submitted"] = True
13526 submission["metrics_aggregate"]["dependency"] = f"afterany:{post_submit['job_id']}"
13527 print(f"[SUCCESS] Submitted continuation solver array: {solver_submit['job_id']}")
13528 print(f"[SUCCESS] Submitted continuation post array: {post_submit['job_id']}")
13529 print(f"[SUCCESS] Submitted metrics aggregation job: {metrics_submit['job_id']}")
13530
13531 write_json_file(os.path.join(scheduler_dir, "submission_continue.json"), submission)
13532
13533 manifest["continuation"] = {
13534 "continued_at": datetime.now().isoformat(),
13535 "incomplete_cases": [all_case_entries[i]["case_id"] for i in incomplete_indices],
13536 "submission": submission,
13537 }
13538 write_json_file(manifest_path, manifest)
13539
13540 print("\n" + "=" * 60)
13541 print(" STUDY CONTINUATION SUMMARY")
13542 print("=" * 60)
13543 print(f" Study ID : {study_id}")
13544 print(f" Incomplete cases : {len(incomplete_indices)}/{len(combinations)}")
13545 print(f" Solver array spec : {solver_array_spec}")
13546 print(f" Post array spec : {post_array_spec}")
13547 print(f" Solver script : {os.path.relpath(solver_continue_script)}")
13548 print(f" Post script : {os.path.relpath(post_continue_script)}")
13549 print(f" Metrics script : {os.path.relpath(metrics_aggregate_script)}")
13550 if not args.no_submit:
13551 print(f" [Metrics aggregation will run automatically after post-processing]")
13552 else:
13553 print(f" [--no-submit] Scripts generated but not submitted.")
13554 print(f" After manual submission and completion, run:")
13555 print(f" picurv sweep --reaggregate --study-dir {os.path.relpath(study_dir)}")
13556 print("=" * 60)

13559def sweep_reaggregate_workflow(args):
13560 """!
13561 @brief Re-run metrics aggregation and plot generation for an existing study.
13562 @param[in] args Parsed CLI arguments with study_dir.

13607_SUMMARY_NUMERIC_RE = re.compile(r"[-+]?\d*\.?\d+(?:[eE][-+]?\d+)?")
13608
13609
13610def _read_yaml_if_exists(filepath: str):
13611 """!
13612 @brief Read YAML when present, otherwise return None.
13613 @param[in] filepath Argument passed to `_read_yaml_if_exists()`.
13614 @return Value returned by `_read_yaml_if_exists()`.
13615 """
13616 if not filepath or not os.path.isfile(filepath):
13617 return None
13618 try:
13619 with open(filepath, "r", encoding="utf-8") as f:
13620 return yaml.safe_load(f)
13621 except yaml.YAMLError:
13622 return None
13623
13624
13625def _read_json_if_exists(filepath: str):
13626 """!
13627 @brief Read JSON when present, otherwise return None.
13628 @param[in] filepath Argument passed to `_read_json_if_exists()`.
13629 @return Value returned by `_read_json_if_exists()`.
13630 """
13631 if not filepath or not os.path.isfile(filepath):
13632 return None
13633 with open(filepath, "r", encoding="utf-8") as f:
13634 return json.load(f)
13635
13636
13637def _parse_int_loose(value):
13638 """!
13639 @brief Best-effort integer parsing for summary extraction.
13640 @param[in] value Argument passed to `_parse_int_loose()`.
13641 @return Value returned by `_parse_int_loose()`.
13642 """
13643 if value is None:
13644 return None
13645 text = str(value).strip()
13646 if not text:
13647 return None
13648 try:
13649 return int(text)
13650 except ValueError:
13651 try:
13652 return int(float(text))
13653 except ValueError:
13654 return None
13655
13656
13657def _parse_float_loose(value):
13658 """!
13659 @brief Best-effort float parsing for summary extraction.
13660 @param[in] value Argument passed to `_parse_float_loose()`.
13661 @return Value returned by `_parse_float_loose()`.
13662 """
13663 if value is None:
13664 return None
13665 text = str(value).strip()
13666 if not text:
13667 return None
13668 try:
13669 return float(text)
13670 except ValueError:
13671 return None
13672
13673
13674def _extract_numeric_tuple(text: str):
13675 """!
13676 @brief Extract a numeric tuple from a string like '(1, 2, 3)'.
13677 @param[in] text Argument passed to `_extract_numeric_tuple()`.
13678 @return Value returned by `_extract_numeric_tuple()`.
13679 """
13680 if not text:
13681 return []
13682 return [float(token) for token in _SUMMARY_NUMERIC_RE.findall(text)]
13683
13684
13685def _build_summary_context(run_dir: str) -> dict:
13686 """!
13687 @brief Resolve run-local config and artifact paths for summarize.
13688 @param[in] run_dir Argument passed to `_build_summary_context()`.
13689 @return Value returned by `_build_summary_context()`.
13690 """
13691 run_dir = os.path.abspath(run_dir)
13692 if not os.path.isdir(run_dir):
13693 emit_structured_error(
13694 ERROR_CODE_CFG_FILE_NOT_FOUND,
13695 key="run_dir",
13696 file_path=run_dir,
13697 message="Run directory not found.",
13698 )
13699 sys.exit(1)
13700
13701 config_dir = os.path.join(run_dir, "config")
13702 config_paths = {
13703 "case": os.path.join(config_dir, "case.yml"),
13704 "solver": os.path.join(config_dir, "solver.yml"),
13705 "monitor": os.path.join(config_dir, "monitor.yml"),
13706 }
13707 monitor_cfg = _read_yaml_if_exists(config_paths["monitor"]) or {}
13708 case_cfg = _read_yaml_if_exists(config_paths["case"]) or {}
13709 solver_cfg = _read_yaml_if_exists(config_paths["solver"]) or {}
13710 manifest = _read_json_if_exists(os.path.join(run_dir, "manifest.json")) or {}
13711
13712 io_cfg = monitor_cfg.get("io", {}) if isinstance(monitor_cfg, dict) else {}
13713 io_dirs = io_cfg.get("directories", {}) if isinstance(io_cfg, dict) else {}
13714 log_dir_name = io_dirs.get("log", "logs")
13715 scheduler_dir = os.path.join(run_dir, "scheduler")
13716
13717 profiling_cfg = {"mode": "off", "functions": [], "timestep_file": "Profiling_Timestep_Summary.csv", "final_summary_enabled": True}
13718 if monitor_cfg:
13719 profiling_cfg = resolve_profiling_config(monitor_cfg)
13720
13721 particle_console_output_freq = None
13722 particle_log_interval = None
13723 if monitor_cfg:
13724 particle_console_output_freq = resolve_particle_console_output_frequency(io_cfg)
13725 particle_log_interval = io_cfg.get("particle_log_interval")
13726
13727 particle_count_cfg = None
13728 if case_cfg:
13729 particle_count_cfg = (
13730 case_cfg.get("models", {})
13731 .get("physics", {})
13732 .get("particles", {})
13733 .get("count")
13734 )
13735
13736 return {
13737 "run_dir": run_dir,
13738 "config_dir": config_dir,
13739 "log_dir": os.path.join(run_dir, log_dir_name),
13740 "scheduler_dir": scheduler_dir,
13741 "monitor_cfg": monitor_cfg,
13742 "case_cfg": case_cfg,
13743 "solver_cfg": solver_cfg,
13744 "config_paths": config_paths,
13745 "manifest": manifest,
13746 "profiling_cfg": profiling_cfg,
13747 "particle_console_output_freq": particle_console_output_freq,
13748 "particle_log_interval": particle_log_interval,
13749 "particle_count_cfg": particle_count_cfg,
13750 }
13751

13753def _require_summary_config(context: dict, name: str) -> dict:
13754 """!
13755 @brief Return one explicitly requested copied config or fail with a structured error.
13756 @param[in] context Summary context returned by `_build_summary_context()`.
13757 @param[in] name Config selector name.
13758 @return Parsed config mapping.
13759 """
13760 path = context["config_paths"][name]
13761 cfg = context.get(f"{name}_cfg")
13762 if not os.path.isfile(path):
13763 emit_structured_error(
13764 ERROR_CODE_CFG_FILE_NOT_FOUND,
13765 key=name,
13766 file_path=path,
13767 message=f"Copied run config '{name}.yml' was not found.",
13768 hint="Use a staged run directory containing the requested copied config.",
13769 )
13770 sys.exit(1)
13771 if not isinstance(cfg, dict) or not cfg:
13772 emit_structured_error(
13773 ERROR_CODE_CFG_INVALID_VALUE,
13774 key=name,
13775 file_path=path,
13776 message=f"Copied run config '{name}.yml' is empty or is not a YAML mapping.",
13777 )
13778 sys.exit(1)
13779 return cfg

13802def _summarize_turbulence(turbulence_cfg: dict) -> dict:
13803 """!
13804 @brief Build compact turbulence and wall-model selections.
13805 @param[in] turbulence_cfg Case turbulence configuration mapping.
13806 @return Curated turbulence and wall-model mapping.
13807 """
13808 result = {}
13809 for key in ("les", "rans", "wall_function"):
13810 value = turbulence_cfg.get(key)
13811 if isinstance(value, dict):
13812 result[key] = {
13813 "enabled": value.get("enabled", True),
13814 "model": value.get("model"),
13815 **{k: v for k, v in value.items() if k not in {"enabled", "model"}},
13816 }
13817 elif value is not None:
13818 result[key] = value
13819 return result

13822def _build_case_overview(context: dict) -> dict:
13823 """!
13824 @brief Build a curated case.yml summary with useful derived quantities.
13825 @param[in] context Summary context returned by `_build_summary_context()`.
13826 @return Curated case configuration mapping.
13827 """
13828 cfg = _require_summary_config(context, "case")
13829 props = cfg.get("properties", {})
13830 scaling = props.get("scaling", {})
13831 fluid = props.get("fluid", {})
13832 run = cfg.get("run_control", {})
13833 grid = cfg.get("grid", {})
13834 models = cfg.get("models", {})
13835 domain = models.get("domain", {})
13836 physics = models.get("physics", {})
13837 particles = physics.get("particles", {})
13838 start = int(run.get("start_step", 0))
13839 total = int(run.get("total_steps", 0))
13840 dt = float(run.get("dt_physical", 0.0))
13841 length_ref = float(scaling.get("length_ref"))
13842 velocity_ref = float(scaling.get("velocity_ref"))
13843 density = float(fluid.get("density"))
13844 viscosity = float(fluid.get("viscosity"))
13845 prepared_bcs = validate_and_prepare_boundary_conditions(cfg)
13846 first_block_faces = {row["face"]: row for row in prepared_bcs[0]}
13847 periodic_axes = {
13848 "i": first_block_faces["-Xi"]["type"] == "PERIODIC",
13849 "j": first_block_faces["-Eta"]["type"] == "PERIODIC",
13850 "k": first_block_faces["-Zeta"]["type"] == "PERIODIC",
13851 }
13852 bc_blocks = []
13853 for block_idx, block in enumerate(prepared_bcs):
13854 bc_blocks.append(
13855 {
13856 "block": block_idx,
13857 "faces": [
13858 {"face": row["face"], "type": row["type"], "handler": row["handler"]}
13859 for row in block
13860 ],
13861 }
13862 )
13863 return {
13864 "run_control": {
13865 "start_step": start,
13866 "total_steps": total,
13867 "end_step": start + total,
13868 "dt_physical": dt,
13869 "duration_physical": total * dt,
13870 "dt_nondimensional": dt * velocity_ref / length_ref,
13871 },
13872 "properties": {
13873 "length_ref": length_ref,
13874 "velocity_ref": velocity_ref,
13875 "density": density,
13876 "viscosity": viscosity,
13877 "reynolds_number": density * velocity_ref * length_ref / viscosity if viscosity else None,
13878 "initial_conditions": props.get("initial_conditions", {}),
13879 },
13880 "grid": {
13881 "mode": grid.get("mode"),
13882 "processor_layout": resolve_grid_da_processor_layout(grid),
13883 "programmatic_settings": grid.get("programmatic_settings") if grid.get("mode") == "programmatic_c" else None,
13884 "source_file": grid.get("source_file"),
13885 },
13886 "domain": {
13887 "blocks": domain.get("blocks", 1),
13888 "dimensionality": physics.get("dimensionality", "3D"),
13889 "periodic": periodic_axes,
13890 },
13891 "physics": {
13892 "fsi": physics.get("fsi", {}),
13893 "particles": particles,
13894 "turbulence": _summarize_turbulence(physics.get("turbulence", {}) or {}),
13895 },
13896 "boundary_conditions": bc_blocks,
13897 }

13900def _build_solver_overview(context: dict) -> dict:
13901 """!
13902 @brief Build a curated solver.yml summary with normalized selections.
13903 @param[in] context Summary context returned by `_build_summary_context()`.
13904 @return Curated solver configuration mapping.

13906 cfg = _require_summary_config(context, "solver")

13909 momentum_cfg = cfg.get("momentum_solver", {}) or {}
13910 dualtime = momentum_cfg.get("dual_time_picard_jameson_rk", momentum_cfg.get("dual_time_picard_rk4", {})) or {}
13911 newton_krylov = momentum_cfg.get("newton_krylov", {}) or {}
13912 poisson = cfg.get("poisson_solver", cfg.get("pressure_solver", {})) or {}
13913 operation_mode = cfg.get("operation_mode", {}) or {}
13914 operation_mode = {
13915 **operation_mode,
13916 "eulerian_field_source": normalize_eulerian_field_source(operation_mode.get("eulerian_field_source", "solve")),
13917 }
13918 if operation_mode.get("analytical_type") is not None:
13919 operation_mode["analytical_type"] = normalize_analytical_type(operation_mode["analytical_type"])
13920 passthrough = cfg.get("petsc_passthrough_options", {}) or {}
13921 return {
13922 "operation_mode": operation_mode,
13923 "momentum": {
13924 "type": selected,
13925 "central_diff": bool(strategy.get("central_diff", False)),
13926 "tolerances": cfg.get("tolerances", {}),
13927 "controls": newton_krylov if selected == "newton_krylov" else dualtime,
13928 },
13929 "poisson": poisson,
13930 "interpolation": cfg.get("interpolation", {"method": "Trilinear"}),
13931 "scalar_transport": cfg.get("scalar_transport", {}),
13932 "verification": cfg.get("verification", {}),
13933 "petsc_passthrough": {"count": len(passthrough), "options": sorted(passthrough.keys())},
13934 }
