13975def _parse_continuity_metrics_log(filepath: str) -> "tuple[dict, list[int]]":
13976 """!
13977 @brief Parse Continuity_Metrics.log into latest rows by step plus observed order.
13978 @param[in] filepath Argument passed to `_parse_continuity_metrics_log()`.
13979 @return Value returned by `_parse_continuity_metrics_log()`.
13980 """
13981 rows_by_step = {}
13982 step_order = []
13983 active_step = None
13984 if not os.path.isfile(filepath):
13985 return rows_by_step, step_order
13986
13987 with open(filepath, "r", encoding="utf-8", errors="replace") as f:
13988 for raw_line in f:
13989 line = raw_line.strip()
13990 if not line or line.startswith("-") or line.startswith("Timestep"):
13991 continue
13992 parts = [part.strip() for part in raw_line.split("|")]
13993 if len(parts) < 8:
13994 continue
13995 step = _parse_int_loose(parts[0])
13996 block = _parse_int_loose(parts[1])
13997 max_div = _parse_float_loose(parts[2])
13998 rhs_sum = _parse_float_loose(parts[4])
13999 flux_in = _parse_float_loose(parts[5])
14000 flux_out = _parse_float_loose(parts[6])
14001 net_flux = _parse_float_loose(parts[7])
14002 if step is None or block is None:
14003 continue
14004 if step != active_step:
14005 active_step = step
14006 step_order.append(step)
14007 rows_by_step[step] = {}
14008 rows_by_step.setdefault(step, {})[block] = {
14009 "block": block,
14010 "max_divergence": max_div,
14011 "max_divergence_location": parts[3],
14012 "rhs_sum": rhs_sum,
14013 "flux_in": flux_in,
14014 "flux_out": flux_out,
14015 "net_flux": net_flux,
14016 }
14017 return {step: list(block_rows.values()) for step, block_rows in rows_by_step.items()}, step_order
14018
14019
14020def _parse_particle_metrics_log(filepath: str) -> "tuple[dict, list[int]]":
14021 """!
14022 @brief Parse Particle_Metrics.log into latest rows by step plus observed order.
14023 @param[in] filepath Argument passed to `_parse_particle_metrics_log()`.
14024 @return Value returned by `_parse_particle_metrics_log()`.
14025 """
14026 rows_by_step = {}
14027 step_order = []
14028 if not os.path.isfile(filepath):
14029 return rows_by_step, step_order
14030
14031 with open(filepath, "r", encoding="utf-8", errors="replace") as f:
14032 for raw_line in f:
14033 line = raw_line.strip()
14034 if not line or line.startswith("-") or line.startswith("Stage"):
14035 continue
14036 parts = [part.strip() for part in raw_line.split("|")]
14037 if len(parts) < 8:
14038 continue
14039 step = _parse_int_loose(parts[1])
14040 if step is None:
14041 continue
14042 row = {
14043 "stage": parts[0],
14044 "total_particles": _parse_int_loose(parts[2]),
14045 "lost_particles": _parse_int_loose(parts[3]),
14046 "lost_particles_cumulative": None,
14047 "migrated_particles": None,
14048 "occupied_cells": None,
14049 "load_imbalance": None,
14050 "migration_passes": None,
14051 }
14052 if len(parts) >= 9:
14053 row.update(
14054 {
14055 "lost_particles_cumulative": _parse_int_loose(parts[4]),
14056 "migrated_particles": _parse_int_loose(parts[5]),
14057 "occupied_cells": _parse_int_loose(parts[6]),
14058 "load_imbalance": _parse_float_loose(parts[7]),
14059 "migration_passes": _parse_int_loose(parts[8]),
14060 }
14061 )
14062 else:
14063 row.update(
14064 {
14065 "migrated_particles": _parse_int_loose(parts[4]),
14066 "occupied_cells": _parse_int_loose(parts[5]),
14067 "load_imbalance": _parse_float_loose(parts[6]),
14068 "migration_passes": _parse_int_loose(parts[7]),
14069 }
14070 )
14071 rows_by_step[step] = row
14072 step_order.append(step)
14073 return rows_by_step, step_order
14074
14075
14076def _parse_momentum_convergence_logs(log_dir: str) -> "tuple[dict, dict, list[int]]":
14077 """!
14078 @brief Parse per-block momentum convergence logs.
14079 @param[in] log_dir Argument passed to `_parse_momentum_convergence_logs()`.
14080 @return Value returned by `_parse_momentum_convergence_logs()`.
14081 """
14082 rows_by_step = {}
14083 sources = {}
14084 step_order = []
14085 patterns = [
14086 os.path.join(log_dir, "Momentum_Solver_DualTime_Picard_Jameson_RK_History_Block_*.log"),
14087 os.path.join(log_dir, "Momentum_Solver_Convergence_History_Block_*.log"),
14088 ]
14089 # Log format (Phase 3+): dtau [physical time] and cfl_eff [dimensionless Courant number].
14090 # cfl_eff = dtau * lambda_max; this is the value controlled by pseudo_cfl.* YAML keys.
14091 regex = re.compile(
14092 r"Step:\s*(?P<step>\d+)\s*\|\s*PseudoIter\‍(k\‍):\s*(?P<pseudo_iter>\d+)\s*\|"
14093 r"\s*dtau:\s*(?P<dtau>[-+0-9.eE]+)\s*\|\s*cfl_eff:\s*(?P<cfl_eff>[-+0-9.eE]+)\s*\|"
14094 r"\s*\|dUk\|:\s*(?P<delta>[-+0-9.eE]+)\s*\|"
14095 r"\s*\|dUk\|/\|dU0\|:\s*(?P<delta_rel>[-+0-9.eE]+)\s*\|\s*\|Rk\|:\s*(?P<resid>[-+0-9.eE]+)\s*\|"
14096 r"\s*\|Rk\|/\|R0\|:\s*(?P<resid_rel>[-+0-9.eE]+)"
14097 r"(?:\s*\|\s*trial_ratio:\s*(?P<trial_ratio>[-+0-9.eE]+)"
14098 r"(?:\s*\|\s*smoothed_ratio:\s*(?P<smoothed_ratio>[-+0-9.eE]+))?"
14099 r"\s*\|\s*status:\s*(?P<status>\w+)\s*\|\s*dtau_after:\s*(?P<dtau_after>[-+0-9.eE]+)"
14100 r"(?:\s*\|\s*cfl_eff_after:\s*(?P<cfl_eff_after>[-+0-9.eE]+))?)?"
14101 )
14102
14103 # Per (step, block): track accepted/rejected counts and last committed state.
14104 _state = {}
14105
14106 for path in sorted(path for pattern in patterns for path in glob.glob(pattern)):
14107 block_match = re.search(r"Block_(\d+)\.log$", path)
14108 if not block_match:
14109 continue
14110 block = int(block_match.group(1))
14111 sources[block] = path
14112 with open(path, "r", encoding="utf-8", errors="replace") as f:
14113 for raw_line in f:
14114 match = regex.search(raw_line)
14115 if not match:
14116 continue
14117 step = int(match.group("step"))
14118 step_order.append(step)
14119 key = (step, block)
14120 if key not in _state:
14121 _state[key] = {"accepted_count": 0, "rejected_count": 0, "last_accepted": None, "last_rejected": None}
14122 entry = _state[key]
14123 status = match.group("status")
14124 row = {
14125 "block": block,
14126 "pseudo_iterations": int(match.group("pseudo_iter")),
14127 "dtau": _parse_float_loose(match.group("dtau")),
14128 "cfl_eff": _parse_float_loose(match.group("cfl_eff")),
14129 "dtau_after": _parse_float_loose(match.group("dtau_after")),
14130 "cfl_eff_after": _parse_float_loose(match.group("cfl_eff_after")),
14131 "delta_norm": float(match.group("delta")),
14132 "delta_rel": float(match.group("delta_rel")),
14133 "residual_norm": float(match.group("resid")),
14134 "residual_rel": float(match.group("resid_rel")),
14135 "trial_ratio": _parse_float_loose(match.group("trial_ratio")),
14136 "smoothed_ratio": _parse_float_loose(match.group("smoothed_ratio")),
14137 "status": status,
14138 }
14139 if status == "accepted":
14140 entry["accepted_count"] += 1
14141 entry["last_accepted"] = row
14142 else:
14143 entry["rejected_count"] += 1
14144 entry["last_rejected"] = row
14145
14146 for (step, block), entry in _state.items():
14147 display_row = entry["last_accepted"] or entry["last_rejected"]
14148 if display_row:
14149 rows_by_step.setdefault(step, {})[block] = {
14150 **display_row,
14151 "accepted_count": entry["accepted_count"],
14152 "rejected_count": entry["rejected_count"],
14153 }
14154
14155 newton_pattern = os.path.join(log_dir, "Momentum_Solver_Newton_Krylov_Summary_Block_*.log")
14156 newton_regex = re.compile(
14157 r"step:\s*(?P<step>\d+)\s*\|\s*block:\s*(?P<block>\d+)\s*\|"
14158 r"\s*solver:\s*(?P<solver>[^|]+?)\s*\|"
14159 # The runtime includes Jacobian and preconditioner descriptions here.
14160 # Keep these optional so summaries can also read the original compact logs.
14161 r"(?:\s*Jacobian:\s*[^|]+?\s*\|\s*Preconditioner:\s*[^|]+?\s*\|)?"
14162 r"\s*reason:\s*(?P<reason>\S+)\s*\|"
14163 r"\s*reason_code:\s*(?P<reason_code>-?\d+)\s*\|\s*newton:\s*(?P<newton>\d+)\s*\|"
14164 r"\s*evals:\s*(?P<evals>\d+)\s*\|\s*krylov:\s*(?P<krylov>\d+)\s*\|"
14165 r"\s*initial:\s*(?P<initial>[-+0-9.eE]+|unavailable)\s*\|"
14166 r"\s*final:\s*(?P<final>[-+0-9.eE]+)\s*\|\s*state:\s*(?P<state>\w+)"
14167 )
14168 for path in sorted(glob.glob(newton_pattern)):
14169 block_match = re.search(r"Block_(\d+)\.log$", path)
14170 if not block_match:
14171 continue
14172 file_block = int(block_match.group(1))
14173 sources[file_block] = path
14174 with open(path, "r", encoding="utf-8", errors="replace") as f:
14175 for raw_line in f:
14176 match = newton_regex.search(raw_line)
14177 if not match:
14178 continue
14179 step = int(match.group("step"))
14180 block = int(match.group("block"))
14181 initial_text = match.group("initial")
14182 step_order.append(step)
14183 rows_by_step.setdefault(step, {})[block] = {
14184 "block": block,
14185 "solver": match.group("solver").strip(),
14186 "reason": match.group("reason"),
14187 "reason_code": int(match.group("reason_code")),
14188 "newton_iterations": int(match.group("newton")),
14189 "residual_evaluations": int(match.group("evals")),
14190 "krylov_iterations": int(match.group("krylov")),
14191 "initial_norm": None if initial_text == "unavailable" else float(initial_text),
14192 "final_norm": float(match.group("final")),
14193 "state": match.group("state"),
14194 }
14195
14196 return rows_by_step, sources, step_order
14197
14198
14199def _parse_poisson_convergence_logs(log_dir: str) -> "tuple[dict, dict, list[int]]":
14200 """!
14201 @brief Parse per-block Poisson convergence logs.
14202 @param[in] log_dir Argument passed to `_parse_poisson_convergence_logs()`.
14203 @return Value returned by `_parse_poisson_convergence_logs()`.
14204 """
14205 rows_by_step = {}
14206 sources = {}
14207 step_order = []
14208 pattern = os.path.join(log_dir, "Poisson_Solver_Convergence_History_Block_*.log")
14209 regex = re.compile(
14210 r"ts:\s*(?P<step>\d+)\s*\|\s*block:\s*(?P<block>\d+)\s*\|\s*iter:\s*(?P<iter>\d+)\s*\|"
14211 r"\s*Unprecond Norm:\s*(?P<unpre>[-+0-9.eE]+)\s*\|\s*True Norm:\s*(?P<true>[-+0-9.eE]+)"
14212 r"(?:\s*\|\s*Rel Norm:\s*(?P<rel>[-+0-9.eE]+))?"
14213 )
14214
14215 for path in sorted(glob.glob(pattern)):
14216 block_match = re.search(r"Block_(\d+)\.log$", path)
14217 if not block_match:
14218 continue
14219 block = int(block_match.group(1))
14220 sources[block] = path
14221 with open(path, "r", encoding="utf-8", errors="replace") as f:
14222 for raw_line in f:
14223 match = regex.search(raw_line)
14224 if not match:
14225 continue
14226 step = int(match.group("step"))
14227 step_order.append(step)
14228 rows_by_step.setdefault(step, {})[block] = {
14229 "block": block,
14230 "iterations": int(match.group("iter")),
14231 "unpreconditioned_norm": float(match.group("unpre")),
14232 "true_norm": float(match.group("true")),
14233 "relative_norm": _parse_float_loose(match.group("rel")),
14234 }
14235 return rows_by_step, sources, step_order
14236
14237
14238def _parse_profiling_timestep_csv(filepath: str) -> "tuple[dict, list[int]]":
14239 """!
14240 @brief Parse profiling timestep CSV into latest rows by step plus observed order.
14241 @param[in] filepath Argument passed to `_parse_profiling_timestep_csv()`.
14242 @return Value returned by `_parse_profiling_timestep_csv()`.
14243 """
14244 rows_by_step = {}
14245 step_order = []
14246 active_step = None
14247 if not os.path.isfile(filepath):
14248 return rows_by_step, step_order
14249
14250 with open(filepath, "r", encoding="utf-8", errors="replace", newline="") as f:
14251 reader = csv.DictReader(f)
14252 for row in reader:
14253 step = _parse_int_loose(row.get("step"))
14254 if step is None:
14255 continue
14256 if step != active_step:
14257 active_step = step
14258 step_order.append(step)
14259 rows_by_step[step] = []
14260 rows_by_step.setdefault(step, []).append(
14261 {
14262 "function": row.get("function"),
14263 "calls": _parse_int_loose(row.get("calls")),
14264 "step_time_s": _parse_float_loose(row.get("step_time_s")),
14265 }
14266 )
14267 return rows_by_step, step_order
14268
14269
14270def _parse_runtime_memory_log(filepath: str) -> "tuple[dict, list[int], dict]":
14271 """!
14272 @brief Parse Runtime_Memory.log into latest rows by step and final status.
14273 @param[in] filepath Runtime memory log path.
14274 @return Tuple of rows by step, observed step order, and final/shutdown metadata.
14275 """
14276 rows_by_step = {}
14277 step_order = []
14278 final_row = None
14279 latest_sample_row = None
14280 max_process_change_mb = None
14281 if not os.path.isfile(filepath):
14282 return rows_by_step, step_order, {"available": False}
14283
14284 with open(filepath, "r", encoding="utf-8", errors="replace") as f:
14285 for raw_line in f:
14286 line = raw_line.strip()
14287 if not line or line.startswith("#") or line.startswith("Step"):
14288 continue
14289 parts = line.split()
14290 if len(parts) < 8:
14291 continue
14292 step = _parse_int_loose(parts[0])
14293 if step is None:
14294 continue
14295 row = {
14296 "step": step,
14297 "event": parts[1],
14298 "process_current_mb_max": _parse_float_loose(parts[2]),
14299 "process_peak_mb_max": _parse_float_loose(parts[3]),
14300 "petsc_allocated_mb_max": _parse_float_loose(parts[4]),
14301 "petsc_peak_allocated_mb_max": _parse_float_loose(parts[5]),
14302 "process_change_mb_max": _parse_float_loose(parts[6]),
14303 "reason": parts[7],
14304 }
14305 if row["process_change_mb_max"] is not None:
14306 max_process_change_mb = (
14307 row["process_change_mb_max"]
14308 if max_process_change_mb is None
14309 else max(max_process_change_mb, row["process_change_mb_max"])
14310 )
14311 if row["event"] in {"Step", "Post"}:
14312 rows_by_step[step] = row
14313 step_order.append(step)
14314 latest_sample_row = row
14315 elif row["event"] in {"Shutdown", "Final"}:
14316 final_row = row
14317
14318 meta = {
14319 "available": bool(rows_by_step or final_row),
14320 "source": filepath,
14321 "final_event": final_row.get("event") if final_row else None,
14322 "final_reason": final_row.get("reason") if final_row else None,
14323 "max_process_change_mb": max_process_change_mb,
14324 "latest_sample_row": latest_sample_row,
14325 "final_row": final_row,
14326 }
14327 return rows_by_step, step_order, meta
14328
14329
14330def _parse_solution_convergence_log(filepath: str) -> "tuple[dict, list[int]]":
14331 """!
14332 @brief Parse solution_convergence.log into latest rows by step plus observed order.
14333
14334 The log format uses pipe-delimited aligned columns. The first line of the
14335 file is a banner (starts with '=') containing the mode tag; the second line
14336 is the column header; the third line is a separator (starts with '-').
14337 Subsequent lines are one data row per timestep.
14338
14339 @param[in] filepath Path to solution_convergence.log.
14340 @return Mapping of step number to a dict of column values.
14341 """
14342 rows_by_step = {}
14343 step_order = []
14344 if not os.path.isfile(filepath):
14345 return rows_by_step, step_order
14346
14347 mode = None
14348 col_names = None
14349
14350 with open(filepath, "r", encoding="utf-8", errors="replace") as f:
14351 for raw_line in f:
14352 line = raw_line.strip()
14353 if not line:
14354 continue
14355 if line.startswith("="):
14356 m = re.search(r"\[mode:\s*([\w_]+)", line)
14357 if m:
14358 mode = m.group(1)
14359 continue
14360 if line.startswith("-"):
14361 continue
14362 if col_names is None:
14363 col_names = [p.strip() for p in raw_line.split("|")]
14364 continue
14365 parts = [p.strip() for p in raw_line.split("|")]
14366 if len(parts) < 4 or col_names is None:
14367 continue
14368 step = _parse_int_loose(parts[0]) if col_names[0] == "step" else None
14369 if step is None:
14370 continue
14371 step_order.append(step)
14372 row = {"mode": mode}
14373 for name, val in zip(col_names, parts):
14374 if not name:
14375 continue
14376 float_val = _parse_float_loose(val)
14377 int_val = _parse_int_loose(val)
14378 if float_val is not None and ("." in val or "e" in val.lower()):
14379 row[name] = float_val
14380 elif int_val is not None:
14381 row[name] = int_val
14382 else:
14383 row[name] = val
14384 rows_by_step[step] = row
14385 return rows_by_step, step_order
14386
14387
14388def _find_solver_stream_log_candidates(run_dir: str, log_dir: str) -> "list[str]":
14389 """!
14390 @brief Return plausible solver stream logs for local and Slurm runs.
14391 @param[in] run_dir Argument passed to `_find_solver_stream_log_candidates()`.
14392 @param[in] log_dir Argument passed to `_find_solver_stream_log_candidates()`.
14393 @return Value returned by `_find_solver_stream_log_candidates()`.
14394 """
14395 patterns = [
14396 os.path.join(run_dir, "scheduler", "*_solver.log"),
14397 os.path.join(run_dir, "scheduler", "solver_*.out"),
14398 os.path.join(log_dir, "*_solver.log"),
14399 ]
14400 found = []
14401 seen = set()
14402 for pattern in patterns:
14403 for path in sorted(glob.glob(pattern), key=os.path.getmtime, reverse=True):
14404 if path not in seen:
14405 seen.add(path)
14406 found.append(path)
14407 return found
14408
14409
14410def _parse_particle_snapshot_file(filepath: str) -> dict:
14411 """!
14412 @brief Parse sampled particle snapshots from a solver stream log.
14413 @param[in] filepath Argument passed to `_parse_particle_snapshot_file()`.
14414 @return Value returned by `_parse_particle_snapshot_file()`.
14415 """
14416 snapshots = {}
14417 if not os.path.isfile(filepath):
14418 return snapshots
14419
14420 with open(filepath, "r", encoding="utf-8", errors="replace") as f:
14421 lines = f.readlines()
14422
14423 idx = 0
14424 while idx < len(lines):
14425 match = re.search(r"Particle states at step\s+(\d+):", lines[idx])
14426 if not match:
14427 idx += 1
14428 continue
14429 step = int(match.group(1))
14430 idx += 1
14431 rows = []
14432 while idx < len(lines):
14433 stripped = lines[idx].strip()
14434 if re.search(r"Particle states at step\s+\d+:", lines[idx]):
14435 break
14436 if stripped.startswith("|"):
14437 parts = [part.strip() for part in stripped.split("|")[1:-1]]
14438 if len(parts) >= 6 and parts[0] != "Rank":
14439 velocity = _extract_numeric_tuple(parts[4])
14440 rows.append(
14441 {
14442 "rank": _parse_int_loose(parts[0]),
14443 "pid": _parse_int_loose(parts[1]),
14444 "cell": [int(value) for value in _extract_numeric_tuple(parts[2])],
14445 "position": _extract_numeric_tuple(parts[3]),
14446 "velocity": velocity,
14447 "weights": _extract_numeric_tuple(parts[5]),
14448 "sample_speed": math.sqrt(sum(component * component for component in velocity)) if len(velocity) == 3 else None,
14449 }
14450 )
14451 elif rows and (not stripped or stripped.startswith("Progress:")):
14452 break
14453 idx += 1
14454 if rows:
14455 snapshots[step] = rows
14456 else:
14457 snapshots.setdefault(step, [])
14458 return snapshots
14459
14460
14461def _find_previous_snapshot_step(snapshot_steps: "list[int]", step: int) -> "int | None":
14462 """!
14463 @brief Return the nearest earlier snapshot step when available.
14464 @param[in] snapshot_steps Argument passed to `_find_previous_snapshot_step()`.
14465 @param[in] step Argument passed to `_find_previous_snapshot_step()`.
14466 @return Value returned by `_find_previous_snapshot_step()`.
14467 """
14468 earlier_steps = [candidate for candidate in snapshot_steps if candidate < step]
14469 if not earlier_steps:
14470 return None
14471 return max(earlier_steps)
14472
14473
14474def _compute_particle_snapshot_delta(current_rows: "list[dict]", previous_rows: "list[dict]") -> dict:
14475 """!
14476 @brief Compute sampled deltas between two particle snapshot samples.
14477 @param[in] current_rows Argument passed to `_compute_particle_snapshot_delta()`.
14478 @param[in] previous_rows Argument passed to `_compute_particle_snapshot_delta()`.
14479 @return Value returned by `_compute_particle_snapshot_delta()`.
14480 """
14481 np = require_numpy()
14482 previous_by_pid = {
14483 row.get("pid"): row
14484 for row in previous_rows
14485 if row.get("pid") is not None
14486 }
14487 current_by_pid = {
14488 row.get("pid"): row
14489 for row in current_rows
14490 if row.get("pid") is not None
14491 }
14492 matched_pids = sorted(set(previous_by_pid) & set(current_by_pid))
14493 if not matched_pids:
14494 return {"available": False}
14495
14496 displacements = []
14497 rank_migrations = 0
14498 cell_changes = 0
14499 speed_changes = []
14500 for pid in matched_pids:
14501 current_row = current_by_pid[pid]
14502 previous_row = previous_by_pid[pid]
14503 current_pos = current_row.get("position") or []
14504 previous_pos = previous_row.get("position") or []
14505 if len(current_pos) == len(previous_pos) and current_pos:
14506 displacements.append(
14507 math.sqrt(
14508 sum(
14509 (float(current_pos[idx]) - float(previous_pos[idx])) ** 2
14510 for idx in range(len(current_pos))
14511 )
14512 )
14513 )
14514 current_speed = current_row.get("sample_speed")
14515 previous_speed = previous_row.get("sample_speed")
14516 if current_speed is not None and previous_speed is not None:
14517 speed_changes.append(float(current_speed) - float(previous_speed))
14518 if current_row.get("rank") is not None and previous_row.get("rank") is not None:
14519 if current_row["rank"] != previous_row["rank"]:
14520 rank_migrations += 1
14521 if current_row.get("cell") and previous_row.get("cell"):
14522 if current_row["cell"] != previous_row["cell"]:
14523 cell_changes += 1
14524
14525 payload = {
14526 "available": True,
14527 "matched_pids": len(matched_pids),
14528 "new_count": len(set(current_by_pid) - set(previous_by_pid)),
14529 "gone_count": len(set(previous_by_pid) - set(current_by_pid)),
14530 "rank_migrations": rank_migrations,
14531 "cell_changes": cell_changes,
14532 }
14533 if displacements:
14534 payload["mean_displacement"] = float(np.mean(displacements))
14535 payload["max_displacement"] = float(np.max(displacements))
14536 if speed_changes:
14537 payload["mean_speed_change"] = float(np.mean(speed_changes))
14538 payload["max_abs_speed_change"] = float(np.max(np.abs(speed_changes)))
14539 return payload
14540
14541
14542def _build_particle_snapshot_summary(
14543 source: str,
14544 step: int,
14545 rows: "list[dict]",
14546 preview_rows: int,
14547 particle_console_output_freq,
14548 particle_log_interval,
14549 previous_step: "int | None" = None,
14550 previous_rows: "list[dict] | None" = None,
14551) -> dict:
14552 """!
14553 @brief Build sampled diagnostics for one particle console snapshot.
14554 @param[in] source Argument passed to `_build_particle_snapshot_summary()`.
14555 @param[in] step Argument passed to `_build_particle_snapshot_summary()`.
14556 @param[in] rows Argument passed to `_build_particle_snapshot_summary()`.
14557 @param[in] preview_rows Argument passed to `_build_particle_snapshot_summary()`.
14558 @param[in] particle_console_output_freq Argument passed to `_build_particle_snapshot_summary()`.
14559 @param[in] particle_log_interval Argument passed to `_build_particle_snapshot_summary()`.
14560 @param[in] previous_step Argument passed to `_build_particle_snapshot_summary()`.
14561 @param[in] previous_rows Argument passed to `_build_particle_snapshot_summary()`.
14562 @return Value returned by `_build_particle_snapshot_summary()`.
14563 """
14564 np = require_numpy()
14565 payload = {
14566 "available": True,
14567 "sampled": True,
14568 "source": source,
14569 "step": step,
14570 "sampled_rows": len(rows),
14571 "preview_rows": rows[:preview_rows],
14572 "cadence": {
14573 "particle_console_output_frequency": particle_console_output_freq,
14574 "particle_log_interval": particle_log_interval,
14575 },
14576 }
14577 if not rows:
14578 return payload
14579
14580 rank_counts = {}
14581 duplicate_pid_count = 0
14582 duplicate_cell_count = 0
14583 nan_count = 0
14584 inf_count = 0
14585 zero_weight_count = 0
14586 negative_weight_count = 0
14587 unique_pid_count = 0
14588
14589 seen_pids = set()
14590 cell_counter = {}
14591 position_components = [[], [], []]
14592 weight_components = {}
14593 speeds = []
14594
14595 for row in rows:
14596 pid = row.get("pid")
14597 if pid is not None:
14598 if pid in seen_pids:
14599 duplicate_pid_count += 1
14600 else:
14601 seen_pids.add(pid)
14602 rank = row.get("rank")
14603 if rank is not None:
14604 rank_counts[str(rank)] = rank_counts.get(str(rank), 0) + 1
14605
14606 cell = row.get("cell") or []
14607 if cell:
14608 key = tuple(cell)
14609 cell_counter[key] = cell_counter.get(key, 0) + 1
14610
14611 position = row.get("position") or []
14612 for idx, value in enumerate(position[:3]):
14613 if not np.isfinite(value):
14614 if np.isnan(value):
14615 nan_count += 1
14616 else:
14617 inf_count += 1
14618 continue
14619 position_components[idx].append(float(value))
14620
14621 velocity = row.get("velocity") or []
14622 if any(not np.isfinite(value) for value in velocity):
14623 for value in velocity:
14624 if not np.isfinite(value):
14625 if np.isnan(value):
14626 nan_count += 1
14627 else:
14628 inf_count += 1
14629 speed = row.get("sample_speed")
14630 if speed is not None and np.isfinite(speed):
14631 speeds.append(float(speed))
14632
14633 weights = row.get("weights") or []
14634 for idx, value in enumerate(weights):
14635 if not np.isfinite(value):
14636 if np.isnan(value):
14637 nan_count += 1
14638 else:
14639 inf_count += 1
14640 continue
14641 numeric = float(value)
14642 weight_components.setdefault(idx, []).append(numeric)
14643 if abs(numeric) <= 1.0e-15:
14644 zero_weight_count += 1
14645 if numeric < 0.0:
14646 negative_weight_count += 1
14647
14648 unique_pid_count = len(seen_pids)
14649 duplicate_cell_count = sum(1 for count in cell_counter.values() if count > 1)
14650
14651 payload["sampled_distribution"] = {
14652 "unique_cells": len(cell_counter),
14653 "duplicate_cells": duplicate_cell_count,
14654 "rank_counts": rank_counts,
14655 "unique_pids": unique_pid_count,
14656 }
14657 payload["checks"] = {
14658 "duplicate_pid_count": duplicate_pid_count,
14659 "nan_count": nan_count,
14660 "inf_count": inf_count,
14661 "zero_weight_count": zero_weight_count,
14662 "negative_weight_count": negative_weight_count,
14663 }
14664
14665 if speeds:
14666 payload["speed"] = {
14667 "min": float(np.min(speeds)),
14668 "mean": float(np.mean(speeds)),
14669 "max": float(np.max(speeds)),
14670 "std": float(np.std(speeds)),
14671 "stagnant_count": sum(1 for speed in speeds if abs(speed) < 1.0e-6),
14672 }
14673
14674 fastest_rows = sorted(
14675 [row for row in rows if row.get("sample_speed") is not None],
14676 key=lambda row: row["sample_speed"],
14677 reverse=True,
14678 )[:3]
14679 payload["top_speeds"] = [
14680 {
14681 "pid": row.get("pid"),
14682 "rank": row.get("rank"),
14683 "speed": row.get("sample_speed"),
14684 "cell": row.get("cell"),
14685 }
14686 for row in fastest_rows
14687 ]
14688
14689 if any(position_components):
14690 axes = ["x", "y", "z"]
14691 payload["position_bounds"] = {}
14692 centroid = []
14693 for idx, axis in enumerate(axes):
14694 values = position_components[idx]
14695 if values:
14696 payload["position_bounds"][axis] = [float(np.min(values)), float(np.max(values))]
14697 centroid.append(float(np.mean(values)))
14698 else:
14699 centroid.append(None)
14700 payload["position_centroid"] = centroid
14701
14702 if weight_components:
14703 payload["weights"] = {}
14704 for idx, values in sorted(weight_components.items()):
14705 payload["weights"][f"component_{idx}"] = {
14706 "min": float(np.min(values)),
14707 "max": float(np.max(values)),
14708 }
14709
14710 delta_summary = {"available": False}
14711 if previous_step is not None and previous_rows:
14712 delta_summary = _compute_particle_snapshot_delta(rows, previous_rows)
14713 if delta_summary.get("available"):
14714 delta_summary["previous_step"] = previous_step
14715 payload["delta_from_previous_snapshot"] = delta_summary
14716 return payload
14717
14718
14719def _find_particle_snapshot_for_step(
14720 run_dir: str,
14721 log_dir: str,
14722 step: int,
14723 preview_rows: int,
14724 particle_console_output_freq,
14725 particle_log_interval,
14726) -> dict:
14727 """!
14728 @brief Locate and summarize a particle console snapshot for one step.
14729 @param[in] run_dir Argument passed to `_find_particle_snapshot_for_step()`.
14730 @param[in] log_dir Argument passed to `_find_particle_snapshot_for_step()`.
14731 @param[in] step Argument passed to `_find_particle_snapshot_for_step()`.
14732 @param[in] preview_rows Argument passed to `_find_particle_snapshot_for_step()`.
14733 @param[in] particle_console_output_freq Argument passed to `_find_particle_snapshot_for_step()`.
14734 @param[in] particle_log_interval Argument passed to `_find_particle_snapshot_for_step()`.
14735 @return Value returned by `_find_particle_snapshot_for_step()`.
14736 """
14737 best = None
14738 for path in _find_solver_stream_log_candidates(run_dir, log_dir):
14739 snapshots = _parse_particle_snapshot_file(path)
14740 rows = snapshots.get(step)
14741 if not rows:
14742 continue
14743 if best is None or len(rows) > len(best["rows"]):
14744 best = {"source": path, "rows": rows, "snapshots": snapshots}
14745
14746 if not best:
14747 return {"available": False}
14748
14749 previous_step = _find_previous_snapshot_step(list(best["snapshots"].keys()), step)
14750 previous_rows = best["snapshots"].get(previous_step, []) if previous_step is not None else None
14751 return _build_particle_snapshot_summary(
14752 best["source"],
14753 step,
14754 best["rows"],
14755 preview_rows,
14756 particle_console_output_freq=particle_console_output_freq,
14757 particle_log_interval=particle_log_interval,
14758 previous_step=previous_step,
14759 previous_rows=previous_rows,
14760 )
14761
14762
14763def _resolve_summary_step(
14764 requested_step,
14765 continuity_rows,
14766 particle_rows,
14767 momentum_rows,
14768 poisson_rows,
14769 profiling_rows,
14770 memory_rows=None,
14771 convergence_rows=None,
14772 step_orders=None,
14773 selection_mode: str = "latest",
14774):
14775 """!
14776 @brief Select a step to summarize from available metric artifacts.
14777 @param[in] requested_step Argument passed to `_resolve_summary_step()`.
14778 @param[in] continuity_rows Argument passed to `_resolve_summary_step()`.
14779 @param[in] particle_rows Argument passed to `_resolve_summary_step()`.
14780 @param[in] momentum_rows Argument passed to `_resolve_summary_step()`.
14781 @param[in] poisson_rows Argument passed to `_resolve_summary_step()`.
14782 @param[in] profiling_rows Argument passed to `_resolve_summary_step()`.
14783 @param[in] memory_rows Argument passed to `_resolve_summary_step()`.
14784 @param[in] convergence_rows Argument passed to `_resolve_summary_step()`.
14785 @param[in] step_orders Argument passed to `_resolve_summary_step()`.
14786 @param[in] selection_mode Argument passed to `_resolve_summary_step()`.
14787 @return Value returned by `_resolve_summary_step()`.
14788 """
14789 if memory_rows is None:
14790 memory_rows = {}
14791 if convergence_rows is None:
14792 convergence_rows = {}
14793 if step_orders is None:
14794 step_orders = []
14795 available_steps = (
14796 set(continuity_rows) | set(particle_rows) | set(momentum_rows)
14797 | set(poisson_rows) | set(profiling_rows) | set(memory_rows) | set(convergence_rows)
14798 )
14799 if not available_steps:
14800 return None, []
14801
14802 if requested_step is not None:
14803 return requested_step, sorted(available_steps)
14804
14805 if selection_mode == "max_step":
14806 return max(available_steps), sorted(available_steps)
14807
14808 for order in step_orders:
14809 if order:
14810 return order[-1], sorted(available_steps)
14811 return max(available_steps), sorted(available_steps)
14812
14813
14814def _format_summary_float(value, spec: str = ".6e", missing: str = "n/a") -> str:
14815 """!
14816 @brief Format optional numeric values for summary text output.
14817 @param[in] value Argument passed to `_format_summary_float()`.
14818 @param[in] spec Argument passed to `_format_summary_float()`.
14819 @param[in] missing Argument passed to `_format_summary_float()`.
14820 @return Value returned by `_format_summary_float()`.
14821 """
14822 if value is None:
14823 return missing
14824 return format(value, spec)
14825
14826
14827def _summary_source_mtime(paths) -> float:
14828 """!
14829 @brief Return the newest modification time among one or more summary sources.
14830 @param[in] paths Path string, iterable of paths, or mapping of paths.
14831 @return Newest modification time, or -1.0 when no source exists.
14832 """
14833 if isinstance(paths, dict):
14834 paths = paths.values()
14835 elif isinstance(paths, str):
14836 paths = [paths]
14837 newest = -1.0
14838 for path in paths or []:
14839 if path and os.path.isfile(path):
14840 newest = max(newest, os.path.getmtime(path))
14841 return newest
14842
14843
14844def _order_summary_step_orders(sources: "list[tuple[list[int], object]]") -> "list[list[int]]":
14845 """!
14846 @brief Order observed step sequences by the recency of their source files.
14847 @param[in] sources Pairs of observed steps and filesystem source path(s).
14848 @return Step-order lists sorted so active append sources are considered first.
14849 """
14850 ranked = []
14851 for priority, (order, paths) in enumerate(sources):
14852 if order:
14853 ranked.append((_summary_source_mtime(paths), priority, order))
14854 ranked.sort(key=lambda item: (-item[0], item[1]))
14855 return [order for _, _, order in ranked]
14856

14858def build_run_summary_payload(run_dir: str, step: "int | None" = None, snapshot_rows: int = 5, selection_mode: str = "latest") -> dict:
14859 """!
14860 @brief Build a read-only run-step summary from existing PICurv artifacts.
14861 @param[in] run_dir Argument passed to `build_run_summary_payload()`.
14862 @param[in] step Argument passed to `build_run_summary_payload()`.
14863 @param[in] snapshot_rows Argument passed to `build_run_summary_payload()`.
14864 @param[in] selection_mode Argument passed to `build_run_summary_payload()`.
14865 @return Value returned by `build_run_summary_payload()`.
14866 """
14867 context = _build_summary_context(run_dir)
14868 log_dir = context["log_dir"]
14869 continuity_path = os.path.join(log_dir, "Continuity_Metrics.log")
14870 particle_metrics_path = os.path.join(log_dir, "Particle_Metrics.log")
14871
14872 continuity_rows, continuity_order = _parse_continuity_metrics_log(continuity_path)
14873 particle_rows, particle_order = _parse_particle_metrics_log(particle_metrics_path)
14874 momentum_rows, momentum_sources, momentum_order = _parse_momentum_convergence_logs(log_dir)
14875 poisson_rows, poisson_sources, poisson_order = _parse_poisson_convergence_logs(log_dir)
14876
14877 profiling_rows = {}
14878 profiling_order = []
14879 profiling_path = os.path.join(log_dir, context["profiling_cfg"].get("timestep_file", "Profiling_Timestep_Summary.csv"))
14880 if context["profiling_cfg"].get("mode") != "off":
14881 profiling_rows, profiling_order = _parse_profiling_timestep_csv(profiling_path)
14882
14883 diagnostics_cfg = resolve_diagnostics_config(context["monitor_cfg"])
14884 memory_log_file = diagnostics_cfg["runtime_memory_log"].get("file", "Runtime_Memory.log")
14885 memory_path = os.path.join(log_dir, memory_log_file)
14886 memory_rows, memory_order, memory_meta = _parse_runtime_memory_log(memory_path)
14887
14888 convergence_log_path = os.path.join(log_dir, "solution_convergence.log")
14889 convergence_rows, convergence_order = _parse_solution_convergence_log(convergence_log_path)
14890 step_orders = _order_summary_step_orders(
14891 [
14892 (continuity_order, continuity_path),
14893 (particle_order, particle_metrics_path),
14894 (convergence_order, convergence_log_path),
14895 (profiling_order, profiling_path),
14896 (memory_order, memory_path),
14897 (momentum_order, momentum_sources),
14898 (poisson_order, poisson_sources),
14899 ]
14900 )
14901
14902 resolved_step, available_steps = _resolve_summary_step(
14903 step,
14904 continuity_rows,
14905 particle_rows,
14906 momentum_rows,
14907 poisson_rows,
14908 profiling_rows,
14909 convergence_rows,
14910 memory_rows,
14911 step_orders=step_orders,
14912 selection_mode=selection_mode,
14913 )
14914 if resolved_step is None:
14915 emit_structured_error(
14916 ERROR_CODE_CFG_FILE_NOT_FOUND,
14917 key="summary",
14918 file_path=log_dir,
14919 message="No summary-capable run artifacts were found under the run log directory.",
14920 hint="Run the solver first, then retry summarize on a run directory that contains continuity or solver convergence logs.",
14921 )
14922 sys.exit(1)
14923
14924 if step is not None and step not in set(available_steps):
14925 emit_structured_error(
14926 ERROR_CODE_CFG_INVALID_VALUE,
14927 key="step",
14928 file_path=context["run_dir"],
14929 message=f"Requested step {step} is not present in the available summary artifacts.",
14930 hint=f"Available steps include: {available_steps[:10]}{'...' if len(available_steps) > 10 else ''}",
14931 )
14932 sys.exit(1)
14933
14934 continuity_step_rows = sorted(continuity_rows.get(resolved_step, []), key=lambda row: row["block"])
14935 continuity_summary = {"available": bool(continuity_step_rows), "blocks": continuity_step_rows}
14936 if continuity_step_rows:
14937 divergence_values = [
14938 abs(row["max_divergence"])
14939 for row in continuity_step_rows
14940 if row["max_divergence"] is not None
14941 ]
14942 continuity_summary["max_abs_divergence"] = max(divergence_values) if divergence_values else None
14943 continuity_summary["net_flux"] = continuity_step_rows[0].get("net_flux")
14944 continuity_summary["flux_in"] = continuity_step_rows[0].get("flux_in")
14945 continuity_summary["flux_out"] = continuity_step_rows[0].get("flux_out")
14946
14947 momentum_step_rows = [row for _, row in sorted(momentum_rows.get(resolved_step, {}).items())]
14948 momentum_summary = {"available": bool(momentum_step_rows), "blocks": momentum_step_rows}
14949
14950 poisson_step_rows = [row for _, row in sorted(poisson_rows.get(resolved_step, {}).items())]
14951 poisson_summary = {"available": bool(poisson_step_rows), "blocks": poisson_step_rows}
14952
14953 particle_summary = {"available": resolved_step in particle_rows}
14954 if resolved_step in particle_rows:
14955 particle_summary.update(particle_rows[resolved_step])
14956
14957 profiling_summary = {"available": resolved_step in profiling_rows}
14958 if resolved_step in profiling_rows:
14959 functions = sorted(
14960 profiling_rows[resolved_step],
14961 key=lambda row: (row.get("step_time_s") or 0.0),
14962 reverse=True,
14963 )
14964 profiling_summary["functions"] = functions
14965 profiling_summary["total_logged_step_time_s"] = sum(
14966 row.get("step_time_s") or 0.0 for row in functions
14967 )
14968
14969 memory_summary = {"available": resolved_step in memory_rows}
14970 if resolved_step in memory_rows:
14971 memory_summary.update(memory_rows[resolved_step])
14972 memory_summary["source"] = memory_path
14973 memory_summary["max_process_change_mb"] = memory_meta.get("max_process_change_mb")
14974 memory_summary["final_event"] = memory_meta.get("final_event")
14975 memory_summary["final_reason"] = memory_meta.get("final_reason")
14976 memory_summary["selected_step"] = resolved_step
14977 memory_summary["step_match"] = True
14978 elif memory_meta.get("available"):
14979 latest_sample_row = memory_meta.get("latest_sample_row")
14980 if latest_sample_row:
14981 memory_summary.update(latest_sample_row)
14982 memory_summary.update(memory_meta)
14983 memory_summary["selected_step"] = resolved_step
14984 memory_summary["step_match"] = False
14985
14986 snapshot_summary = {"available": False}
14987 if context["particle_console_output_freq"] and context["particle_console_output_freq"] > 0:
14988 snapshot_summary = _find_particle_snapshot_for_step(
14989 context["run_dir"],
14990 log_dir,
14991 resolved_step,
14992 preview_rows=max(1, snapshot_rows),
14993 particle_console_output_freq=context["particle_console_output_freq"],
14994 particle_log_interval=context["particle_log_interval"],
14995 )
14996
14997 monitor_info = {
14998 "profiling_timestep_mode": context["profiling_cfg"].get("mode"),
14999 "profiling_timestep_file": context["profiling_cfg"].get("timestep_file"),
15000 "particle_console_output_frequency": context["particle_console_output_freq"],
15001 "particle_log_interval": context["particle_log_interval"],
15002 }
15003
15004 return {
15005 "run_id": context["manifest"].get("run_id", os.path.basename(context["run_dir"])),
15006 "run_dir": context["run_dir"],
15007 "step": resolved_step,
15008 "selected_via": "explicit" if step is not None else ("max_step" if selection_mode == "max_step" else "latest_available"),
15009 "available_steps": available_steps,
15010 "launch_mode": context["manifest"].get("launch_mode"),
15011 "created_at": context["manifest"].get("created_at"),
15012 "monitor": monitor_info,
15013 "particles_configured": context["particle_count_cfg"],
15014 "sources": {
15015 "continuity_log": continuity_path if os.path.isfile(continuity_path) else None,
15016 "particle_metrics_log": particle_metrics_path if os.path.isfile(particle_metrics_path) else None,
15017 "momentum_logs": momentum_sources,
15018 "poisson_logs": poisson_sources,
15019 "profiling_timestep_csv": profiling_path if os.path.isfile(profiling_path) else None,
15020 "solution_convergence_log": convergence_log_path if os.path.isfile(convergence_log_path) else None,
15021 "runtime_memory_log": memory_path if os.path.isfile(memory_path) else None,
15022 },
15023 "continuity": continuity_summary,
15024 "momentum": momentum_summary,
15025 "poisson": poisson_summary,
15026 "particles": particle_summary,
15027 "particle_snapshot": snapshot_summary,
15028 "profiling": profiling_summary,
15029 "memory": memory_summary,
15030 "convergence": convergence_rows.get(resolved_step) if convergence_rows else None,
15031 }
15032

15034def render_run_summary(payload: dict, output_format: str = "text"):
15035 """!
15036 @brief Render a run-step summary in human or JSON form.
15037 @param[in] payload Argument passed to `render_run_summary()`.
15038 @param[in] output_format Argument passed to `render_run_summary()`.
15039 """
15040 if output_format == "json":
15041 print(json.dumps(payload, indent=2, sort_keys=True))
15042 return
15043
15044 print("\n" + "=" * 60)
15045 print(" RUN STEP SUMMARY")
15046 print("=" * 60)
15047 print(f" Run ID : {payload.get('run_id')}")
15048 print(f" Run directory : {os.path.relpath(payload.get('run_dir'))}")
15049 print(f" Step : {payload.get('step')} ({payload.get('selected_via')})")
15050 if payload.get("launch_mode"):
15051 print(f" Launch mode : {payload.get('launch_mode')}")
15052 if payload.get("created_at"):
15053 print(f" Created at : {payload.get('created_at')}")
15054
15055 continuity = payload.get("continuity", {})
15056 print("\n Continuity:")
15057 if continuity.get("available"):
15058 if continuity.get("max_abs_divergence") is not None:
15059 print(f" max |div| : {continuity['max_abs_divergence']:.6e}")
15060 if continuity.get("net_flux") is not None:
15061 print(f" net flux : {continuity['net_flux']:.6e}")
15062 for row in continuity.get("blocks", []):
15063 print(
15064 " "
15065 f"block {row['block']}: div={_format_summary_float(row.get('max_divergence'))} "
15066 f"rhs={_format_summary_float(row.get('rhs_sum'))} location={row['max_divergence_location']}"
15067 )
15068 else:
15069 print(" unavailable")
15070
15071 momentum = payload.get("momentum", {})
15072 print("\n Momentum:")
15073 if momentum.get("available"):
15074 for row in momentum.get("blocks", []):
15075 if row.get("solver") == "Newton Krylov":
15076 print(f" block {row['block']}: solver=Newton Krylov")
15077 print(
15078 f" newton={row.get('newton_iterations')} "
15079 f"krylov={row.get('krylov_iterations')} "
15080 f"evals={row.get('residual_evaluations')}"
15081 )
15082 print(
15083 f" final={_format_summary_float(row.get('final_norm'))} "
15084 f"reason={row.get('reason')} state={row.get('state')}"
15085 )
15086 continue
15087 status = row.get("status") or "unknown"
15088 accepted = row.get("accepted_count")
15089 rejected = row.get("rejected_count")
15090 counts_str = f" accepted={accepted} rejected={rejected}" if accepted is not None else ""
15091 # Phase 3+: logged as dtau (physical time) + cfl_eff (dimensionless Courant number).
15092 dtau_val = row.get("dtau")
15093 cfl_in = row.get("cfl_eff")
15094 cfl_out = row.get("cfl_eff_after")
15095 dtau_out = row.get("dtau_after")
15096 if cfl_in is not None and cfl_out is not None:
15097 cfl_str = f"cfl_eff {cfl_in:.4f}->{cfl_out:.4f} dtau {_format_summary_float(dtau_val)}->{_format_summary_float(dtau_out)}"
15098 elif cfl_in is not None:
15099 cfl_str = f"cfl_eff={_format_summary_float(cfl_in, '.4f')} dtau={_format_summary_float(dtau_val)}"
15100 else:
15101 cfl_str = "cfl_eff=n/a"
15102 ratio = row.get("trial_ratio")
15103 smoothed = row.get("smoothed_ratio")
15104 if ratio is not None and smoothed is not None:
15105 ratio_str = f" ratio={_format_summary_float(ratio)} (ema={_format_summary_float(smoothed)})"
15106 elif ratio is not None:
15107 ratio_str = f" ratio={_format_summary_float(ratio)}"
15108 else:
15109 ratio_str = ""
15110 print(f" block {row['block']} [{status}]:{counts_str} {cfl_str}{ratio_str}")
15111 print(
15112 f" resid={_format_summary_float(row.get('residual_norm'))}"
15113 f" delta={_format_summary_float(row.get('delta_norm'))}"
15114 )
15115 else:
15116 print(" unavailable")
15117
15118 poisson = payload.get("poisson", {})
15119 print("\n Poisson:")
15120 if poisson.get("available"):
15121 for row in poisson.get("blocks", []):
15122 print(
15123 " "
15124 f"block {row['block']}: iter={row['iterations']} "
15125 f"true={_format_summary_float(row.get('true_norm'))} "
15126 f"rel={_format_summary_float(row.get('relative_norm'))}"
15127 )
15128 else:
15129 print(" unavailable")
15130
15131 convergence = payload.get("convergence")
15132 print("\n Solution Convergence:")
15133 if convergence is not None:
15134 mode = convergence.get("mode", "unknown")
15135 ref = convergence.get("ref")
15136 print(f" mode : {mode} (ref={'yes' if ref else 'no'})")
15137 if mode in ("steady_deterministic", "transient"):
15138 print(f" u_abs_l2 : {_format_summary_float(convergence.get('u_abs_l2'))}")
15139 print(f" mean_speed : {_format_summary_float(convergence.get('mean_speed'))} drift={_format_summary_float(convergence.get('spd_abs'))}")
15140 print(f" mean_ke : {_format_summary_float(convergence.get('mean_ke'))} drift={_format_summary_float(convergence.get('ke_abs'))}")
15141 elif mode == "periodic_deterministic":
15142 ph = convergence.get("ph")
15143 per = convergence.get("per")
15144 print(f" phase : {ph}/{per}")
15145 print(f" u_abs_l2 : {_format_summary_float(convergence.get('u_abs_l2'))}")
15146 print(f" mean_speed : {_format_summary_float(convergence.get('mean_speed'))} drift={_format_summary_float(convergence.get('spd_abs'))}")
15147 print(f" mean_ke : {_format_summary_float(convergence.get('mean_ke'))} drift={_format_summary_float(convergence.get('ke_abs'))}")
15148 elif mode == "statistical_steady":
15149 print(f" mean_speed : {_format_summary_float(convergence.get('mean_speed'))} win={_format_summary_float(convergence.get('spd_win'))} win_drift={_format_summary_float(convergence.get('spd_win_abs'))}")
15150 print(f" mean_ke : {_format_summary_float(convergence.get('mean_ke'))} win={_format_summary_float(convergence.get('ke_win'))} win_drift={_format_summary_float(convergence.get('ke_win_abs'))}")
15151 else:
15152 print(" unavailable")
15153
15154 particles = payload.get("particles", {})
15155 print("\n Particles:")
15156 if particles.get("available"):
15157 loss_summary = f"lost={particles.get('lost_particles')}"
15158 if particles.get("lost_particles_cumulative") is not None:
15159 loss_summary = (
15160 f"lost(step/total)={particles.get('lost_particles')}/"
15161 f"{particles.get('lost_particles_cumulative')}"
15162 )
15163 print(
15164 " "
15165 f"total={particles.get('total_particles')} {loss_summary} "
15166 f"migrated={particles.get('migrated_particles')} occupied={particles.get('occupied_cells')} "
15167 f"imbalance={_format_summary_float(particles.get('load_imbalance'), '.2f')}"
15168 )
15169 else:
15170 print(" unavailable")
15171
15172 memory = payload.get("memory", {})
15173 print("\n Runtime Memory:")
15174 if memory.get("available"):
15175 if memory.get("source"):
15176 print(f" source : {os.path.relpath(memory.get('source'))}")
15177 if memory.get("step") is not None and not memory.get("step_match", True):
15178 print(f" memory step : {memory.get('step')} (latest memory row; selected step {memory.get('selected_step')} has no row yet)")
15179 if memory.get("event"):

15182 print(f" PETSc max : {_format_summary_float(memory.get('petsc_allocated_mb_max'), '.3f')} MB allocated, {_format_summary_float(memory.get('petsc_peak_allocated_mb_max'), '.3f')} MB peak")
15183 print(f" max change : {_format_summary_float(memory.get('max_process_change_mb'), '.3f')} MB")

15189 snapshot = payload.get("particle_snapshot", {})

15296
15297def _summary_display_value(value) -> str:
15298 """!
15299 @brief Format one configuration-summary value for compact text output.
15300 @param[in] value Value to format.
15301 @return Compact human-readable value.
15302 """
15303 if value is None:
15304 return "-"
15305 if isinstance(value, bool):
15306 return "enabled" if value else "disabled"
15307 if isinstance(value, float):
15308 return f"{value:.6g}"
15309 if isinstance(value, (list, tuple)):
15310 return ", ".join(_summary_display_value(item) for item in value) if value else "none"
15311 if isinstance(value, dict):
15312 if not value:
15313 return "none"
15314 return ", ".join(f"{key}={_summary_display_value(item)}" for key, item in value.items())
15315 return str(value)

15331def _print_config_group(title: str, rows: list):
15332 """!
15333 @brief Print an aligned configuration-summary field group.
15334 @param[in] title Group title.
15335 @param[in] rows Sequence of `(label, value)` pairs.
15336 """
15337 visible_rows = [(label, value) for label, value in rows if value is not None]
15338 if not visible_rows:
15339 return
15340 print(f"\n {title}")
15341 print(f" {'-' * (len(title) + 1)}")
15342 for label, value in visible_rows:
15343 print(f" {label:<32} {_summary_display_value(value)}")

15346def _flatten_summary_mapping(mapping: dict, prefix: str = "") -> list:
15347 """!
15348 @brief Flatten nested summary mappings into readable dotted field rows.
15349 @param[in] mapping Mapping to flatten.
15350 @param[in] prefix Optional parent-field prefix.
15351 @return Sequence of `(field, value)` pairs.
15352 """
15353 rows = []
15354 for key, value in mapping.items():
15355 label = f"{prefix}.{key}" if prefix else str(key)
15356 if isinstance(value, dict) and value:
15357 rows.extend(_flatten_summary_mapping(value, label))
15358 else:
15359 rows.append((label, value))
15360 return rows

15553def render_selected_summary(payload: dict, output_format: str = "text"):

15689def _humanize_plot_identifier(value: str) -> str:
15690 """!
15691 @brief Convert one machine-oriented identifier into a readable plot label.
15692 @param[in] value Dotted path or snake-case identifier.
15693 @return Human-readable label.
15694 """
15695 text = str(value).split(".")[-1].replace("_", " ").strip()
15696 replacements = {
15697 "l2": "L²", "linf": "L∞", "msd": "mean-squared displacement",
15698 "pct": "percentage", "p95": "95th percentile", "cfl": "CFL",
15699 "ke": "kinetic energy", "rms": "RMS",
15700 }
15701 words = [replacements.get(word.lower(), word) for word in text.split()]
15702 return " ".join(words[:1]).capitalize() + (" " + " ".join(words[1:]) if len(words) > 1 else "")
15703
